meaning: 'm
translation_zh: am 的缩写（常用于 I'm）
example: The 'm was important for everyone.

meaning: 're
translation_zh: are 的缩写（常用于 you're, we're, they're）
example: The 're was important for everyone.

meaning: 's
translation_zh: is / has 的缩写，或名词所有格
example: The 's was important for everyone.

meaning: a
translation_zh: art. 一（个，件…）；任一
example: The a was important for everyone.

meaning: s. on the move; r. all around or on all sides; r. in the area or vicinity; r. used of movement to or among many different places or in no particular direction
translation_zh: prep. 在...周围, 大约, 有关, 关于；adv. 大约, 四处, 在附近, 周围
example: She spoke about during the meeting.

meaning: v. make an addition (to); join or combine or unite with others; increase the quality, quantity, size or scope of; v. state or say further; v. make an addition by combining numbers; v. constitute an addition
translation_zh: vt. 增加, 添加, 附带说明, 计算...总和；vi. 做加法, 积累而成, 增添；[计] 加法
example: Please add sugar to my coffee.

meaning: n an aircraft that has a fixed wing and is powered by propellers or jets
translation_zh: n. 飞机；[机] 飞机
example: The aeroplane was carrying 350 people.

meaning: n. the part of the day between noon and evening
translation_zh: n. 午后, 下午
example: I will meet you in the afternoon.

meaning: r. anew
translation_zh: adv. 再一次, 又, 到原处
example: Please say that again.

meaning: n. how long something has existed; n. a time of life (usually defined in years) at which some particular qualification or power arises; v. begin to seem older; get older; v. make older
translation_zh: n. 年龄, 老年, 成年, 寿命, 时代, 时期；v. 变老, 成熟
example: What is your age?

meaning: s. gone by; or in the past; r. in the past
translation_zh: adv. 以前
example: I saw him two days ago.

meaning: n. an aircraft that has a fixed wing and is powered by propellers or jets
translation_zh: n. 飞机；[机] 飞机
example: We traveled by airplane to our vacation destination.

meaning: n. an airfield equipped with control tower and hangars as well as accommodations for passengers and cargo
translation_zh: n. 飞机场；[机] 航空站, 机场
example: I need to go to the airport to catch my flight.

meaning: all right
translation_zh: 好, 顺利, 良好的, 正确的
example: This is a very all right situation.

meaning: r (of actions or states) slightly short of or not quite accomplished; all but
translation_zh: adv. 几乎, 差不多
example: I almost forgot my keys.

meaning: r in addition
translation_zh: adv. 也, 并且, 同样地
example: She is a doctor, and also a writer.

meaning: r. at all times; all the time and on every occasion; r. at any time or in any event; r. forever; throughout all time
translation_zh: adv. 总是, 始终
example: I always drink coffee in the morning.

meaning: n a radioactive transuranic metallic element; discovered by bombarding uranium with helium atoms; n a master's degree in arts and sciences; n modulation of the amplitude of the (radio) carrier wave; v have the quality of being; (copula, used with an adjective or a predicate noun); v be identical to; be someone or something; v occupy a certain position or area; be somewhere; v have an existence, be extant; v happen, occur, take place; this was during the visit to my parents' house"; v be identical or equivalent to; v form or compose; v work in a specific place, with a specific subject, or in a specific function; v represent, as of a character on stage; v spend or use time; v have life, be alive; v to remain unmolested, undisturbed, or uninterrupted -- used only in infinitive form; v be priced at
translation_zh: be的单数第一人称；[计] 存取管理程序, 寻址方式, 地址标记, 变址数, 调幅, 辅助存储器
example: She spoke am during the meeting.

meaning: n an associate degree in nursing
translation_zh: art. 一
example: The an was important for everyone.

meaning: conj. A particle which expresses the relation of connection or; addition. It is used to conjoin a word with a word, a clause with a; clause, or a sentence with a sentence.; conj. In order to; -- used instead of the infinitival to,; especially after try, come, go.; conj. It is sometimes, in old songs, a mere expletive.; conj. If; though. See An, conj.
translation_zh: conj. 和, 与；[计] 与
example: Sue and I left early.

meaning: a. feeling or showing anger; s. (of the elements) as if showing violent anger; s. severely inflamed and painful
translation_zh: a. 生气的, 愤怒的
example: She was very angry about the delay.

meaning: n. a living organism characterized by voluntary movement; s. marked by the appetites and passions of the body
translation_zh: n. 动物；[医] 动物
example: My favorite animal is a dog.

meaning: n. a statement (either spoken or written) that is made to reply to a question or request or criticism or accusation; n. the speech act of replying to a question; n. the principal pleading by the defendant in response to plaintiff's complaint; in criminal law it consists of the defendant's plea of `guilty' or `not guilty' (or nolo contendere); in civil law it must contain denials of all allegations in the plaintiff's complaint that the defendant hopes to controvert and it can contain affirmative defenses or counterclaims; n. a nonverbal reaction
translation_zh: n. 答案, 回答, 回报, 答辩；vt. 回答, 反驳, 适应, 响应, 符合；vi. 回答, 答应, 负责, 符合, 成功；[计] 用户问题及答案新闻组
example: Do you know the answer to the question?

meaning: s. one or some or every or all without specification; r. to any degree or extent
translation_zh: a. 任何的；pron. 任何
example: Do you have any questions?

meaning: n. Any one out of an indefinite number of persons; anyone;; any person.; n. A person of consideration or standing.
translation_zh: pron. 任何人；n. 重要人物
example: Anybody can use the pool—you don't need to be a member.

meaning: n. One taken at random rather than by selection; anybody.; [Commonly written as two words.]
translation_zh: pron. 任何人
example: Hardly anyone came.

meaning: n. Any object, act, state, event, or fact whatever; thing of; any kind; something or other; aught; as, I would not do it for; anything.; n. Expressing an indefinite comparison; -- with as or like.; adv. In any measure; anywise; at all.
translation_zh: pron. 任何事
example: There's never anything worth watching on TV.

meaning: n. fruit with red or yellow or green skin and sweet to tart crisp whitish flesh; n. native Eurasian tree widely cultivated in many varieties for its firm rounded edible fruits
translation_zh: n. 苹果, 家伙；[医] 苹果
example: She ate a red apple for a snack.

meaning: n. the month following March and preceding May
translation_zh: n. 四月
example: She was born in April.

meaning: n. a garment of cloth or leather or plastic that is tied about the waist and worn to protect your clothing; n. (golf) the part of the fairway leading onto the green; n. a paved surface where aircraft stand while not being used
translation_zh: n. 围裙；[医] 围裙
example: The British prime minister is too apt to cling to Washington's apron strings.

meaning: n. a unit of surface area equal to 100 square meters
translation_zh: be的现在时复数或第二人称单数
example: They're (= they are) very late.

meaning: v. reach a destination; arrive by movement or progress; v. succeed in a big way; get to the top
translation_zh: vi. 到达, 抵达
example: What time will you arrive?

meaning: v. inquire about; v. make a request or demand for something to somebody; v. direct or put; seek an answer to; v. consider obligatory; request and expect
translation_zh: vi. 问, 要求；vt. 问, 要求, 邀请, 需要
example: I need to ask you a question.

meaning: n. 100 at equal 1 kip in Laos
translation_zh: prep. 在, 向, 对；[计] 地址转换器, 异常传输, 自动订票
example: We changed at Crewe.

meaning: n. the month following July and preceding September; s. of or befitting a lord; s. profoundly honored
translation_zh: n. 八月；a. 威严的, 令人敬畏的
example: He had dared to challenge the views of an august body of imperial historians.

meaning: n. the sister of your father or mother; the wife of your uncle
translation_zh: n. 阿姨, 姨妈, 舅妈, 姑妈, 伯母
example: My aunt lives in Canada.

meaning: n the season when the leaves fall from the trees
translation_zh: n. 秋天, 成熟期
example: The leaves turn beautiful colors in autumn.

meaning: a. not in a state of sleep; completely conscious
translation_zh: a. 醒着的；vt. 唤醒, 唤起, 使意识到；vi. 醒来, 被唤起, 意识到
example: I was still awake when he came to bed.

meaning: n. a very young child (birth to 1 year) who has not yet begun to walk or talk; n. the youngest member of a group (not necessarily young); n. an unborn child; a human fetus; n. (slang) sometimes used as a term of address for attractive young women
translation_zh: n. 婴孩；[医] 婴儿
example: The baby is sleeping.

meaning: n. that which is below standard or expectations as of ethics or decency; a. having undesirable or negative qualities; s. very intense; s. feeling physical discomfort or pain (`tough' is occasionally used colloquially for `bad')
translation_zh: a. 坏的；n. 坏；adv. 坏地
example: That was a bad idea.

meaning: n. a flexible container with a single opening; n. the quantity of game taken in a particular period (usually by one person); n. a container used for carrying money and small personal items or accessories (especially by women); n. the quantity that a bag will hold
translation_zh: n. 袋子, 袋状物；vt. 使膨大, 装袋, 猎获
example: She carried a small bag.

meaning: n. round object that is hit or thrown or kicked in games; n. an object with a spherical shape; n. the people assembled at a lavish formal dance; n. a spherical object used as a plaything
translation_zh: n. 球, 舞会, 球状物；v. 捏成球形
example: The child played with a red ball.

meaning: n. any of several tropical and subtropical treelike herbs of the genus Musa having a terminal crown of large entire leaves and usually bearing hanging clusters of elongated fruits; n. elongated crescent-shaped yellow fruit with soft sweet flesh
translation_zh: n. 香蕉
example: I like to eat a banana for breakfast.

meaning: n. a game played on a court by two opposing teams of 5 players; points are scored by throwing the ball through an elevated horizontal hoop; n. an inflated ball used in playing basketball
translation_zh: n. 篮球
example: Do you want to play basketball?

meaning: n. a vessel containing liquid in which something is immersed (as to process it or to maintain it at a constant temperature or to lubricate it); n. you soak and wash your body in a bathtub; n. an ancient Hebrew liquid measure equal to about 10 gallons; n. a town in southwestern England on the River Avon; famous for its hot springs and Roman remains
translation_zh: n. 沐浴, 浴室；[医] 浴
example: I like to take a hot bath after work.

meaning: n. a room (as in a residence) containing a bathtub or shower and usually a washbasin and toilet
translation_zh: n. 浴室, 厕所
example: Where is the bathroom?

meaning: v. have the quality of being; (copula, used with an adjective or a predicate noun); v. be identical to; be someone or something; v. occupy a certain position or area; be somewhere; v. happen, occur, take place; this was during the visit to my parents' house"
translation_zh: v. 是, 表示, 在；[计] 后端, 总线允许
example: I want to be a doctor.

meaning: n. an area of sand sloping down to the water of a sea or lake; v. land on a beach
translation_zh: n. 海滩
example: We spent the day at the beach.

meaning: n. any of various edible seeds of plants of the family Leguminosae used for food; n. any of various seeds or fruits that are beans or resemble beans; n. any of various leguminous plants grown for their edible seeds and pods; v. hit on the head, especially with a pitched baseball
translation_zh: n. 豆子；[化] 油嘴; 豆
example: I like to add black beans to my chili.

meaning: a. delighting the senses or exciting intellectual or emotional admiration; s. (of weather) highly enjoyable
translation_zh: a. 美丽的
example: She has a beautiful smile.

meaning: conj. By or for the cause that; on this account that; for the; reason that.; conj. In order that; that.
translation_zh: conj. 因为
example: I did it because he told me to.

meaning: v. enter or assume a certain state or condition; v. undergo a change or development; v. come into existence; v. enhance the appearance of
translation_zh: vi. 变成, 变得；vt. 适合
example: He wants to become a doctor.

meaning: n. a piece of furniture that provides a place to sleep; n. a plot of ground in which plants are growing; n. a depression forming the ground under a body of water; n. (geology) a stratum of rock (especially sedimentary rock)
translation_zh: n. 床, 睡眠处, 河床, 底座, 路基, 一层；vt. 提供宿处, 栽种, 安装；vi. 睡, 形成坚实的一层
example: I'm going to bed now.

meaning: n. a room used primarily for sleeping
translation_zh: n. 卧室
example: My bedroom is on the second floor.

meaning: n. any of numerous hairy-bodied insects including social and solitary species; n. a social gathering to carry out some communal task or to hold competitions
translation_zh: n. 蜜蜂, 聚会
example: Bees were buzzing in the clover.

meaning: n. cattle that are reared for their meat; n. meat from an adult domestic bovine
translation_zh: n. 牛肉, 肌肉；vt. 养(牛), 宰(牛)；vi. 抱怨, 告发
example: The spaghetti sauce is made with ground (UK minced) beef.

meaning: n. Israeli statesman (born in Russia) who (as prime minister of Israel) negotiated a peace treaty with Anwar Sadat (then the president of Egypt) (1913-1992); v. have a beginning, in a temporal, spatial, or evaluative sense; v. set in motion, cause to start; v. begin to speak or say
translation_zh: v. 开始；[计] 开始
example: The movie begins at 7 PM.

meaning: n. a hollow device made of metal that makes a ringing sound when struck; n. the sound of a bell being struck; n. (nautical) each of the eight half-hour units of nautical time signaled by strokes of a ship's bell; eight bells signals 4:00, 8:00, or 12:00 o'clock, either a.m. or p.m.; n. the shape of a bell
translation_zh: n. 铃, 钟；[计] 响铃命令
example: The school bell rang.

meaning: r. in or to a place that is lower; r. at a later place; r. (in writing) see below
translation_zh: prep. 在下面；adv. 在下面
example: She spoke below during the meeting.

meaning: n. At the side of; on one side of.; n. Aside from; out of the regular course or order of; in a; state of deviation from; out of.; n. Over and above; distinct from; in addition to.; adv. On one side.; adv. More than that; over and above; not included in the; number, or in what has been mentioned; moreover; in addition.
translation_zh: prep. 在旁边
example: He sat beside her all night.

meaning: n. the supreme effort one can make; n. the person who is most outstanding or excellent; someone who tops all others; n. Canadian physiologist (born in the United States) who assisted F. G. Banting in research leading to the discovery of insulin (1899-1978)
translation_zh: a. 最好的；adv. 最好地；n. 最好的人
example: He wrote his best songs before he was 25.

meaning: r. in the interval; r. in between
translation_zh: prep. 在...之间
example: Q comes between P and R in the English alphabet.

meaning: n. a wheeled vehicle that has two wheels and is moved by foot pedals; v. ride a bicycle
translation_zh: n. 自行车
example: He rides his bicycle to work every day.

meaning: s. significant; s. loud and firm; s. conspicuous in position or importance; s. prodigious
translation_zh: a. 大的, 重要的；adv. 大量地
example: That's a very big dog.

meaning: n a motor vehicle with two wheels and a strong frame; n a wheeled vehicle that has two wheels and is moved by foot pedals; v ride a bicycle
translation_zh: n. 自行车, 脚踏车
example: I ride my bike to work every day.

meaning: n. warm-blooded egg-laying vertebrates characterized by feathers and forelimbs modified as wings; n. the flesh of a bird or fowl (wild or domestic) used as food; v. watch and study birds in their natural habitat
translation_zh: n. 鸟, 羽毛球；vi. 打鸟
example: A small bird landed on the window sill.

meaning: n. an anniversary of the day on which a person was born (or the celebration of it); n. the date on which a person was born
translation_zh: n. 生日
example: Happy birthday! I hope you have a great day.

meaning: n. small round bread leavened with baking-powder or soda
translation_zh: n. 饼干；[化] 素坯; 饼干
example: Would you like a biscuit with your tea?

meaning: n. the quality or state of the achromatic color of least lightness (bearing the least resemblance to white); n. British chemist who identified carbon dioxide and who formulated the concepts of specific heat and latent heat (1728-1799); n. popular child actress of the 1930's (born in 1928); n. a person with dark skin who comes from Africa (or whose ancestors came from Africa)
translation_zh: n. 黑色, 黑颜料；a. 黑色的
example: My cat is black.

meaning: n. a piece of material ready to be made into something; n. a cartridge containing an explosive charge but no bullet; v. keep the opposing (baseball) team from winning; s. (of a surface) not written or printed on
translation_zh: n. 空格, 空白；a. 空白的, 空虚的, 完全的, 无色的；vi. 消失, 成为空白；vt. 使无效, 取消, 封锁；[计] 空白
example: Sign your name in the blank space below.

meaning: n. blue color or pigment; resembling the color of the clear sky in the daytime; n. blue clothing; n. any organization or party whose uniforms or badges are blue; n. any of numerous small butterflies of the family Lycaenidae
translation_zh: n. 蓝色；a. 蓝色的, 下流的, 忧郁的；vt. 染成蓝色；vi. 变蓝
example: The sky is blue.

meaning: n. a small vessel for travel on water; v. ride in a boat on water
translation_zh: n. 船；vi. 乘船；vt. 以船运
example: We went for a ride on the boat.

meaning: n. the entire structure of an organism (an animal, plant, or human being); n. a group of persons associated by some common tie or occupation and regarded as an entity; n. a natural object consisting of a dead animal or person; n. an individual 3-dimensional object that has mass and that is distinguishable from other objects
translation_zh: n. 身体, 人, 尸体, 主要部分, 团体；vt. 赋以形体；[计] 体
example: The human body is amazing.

meaning: n a shop where books are sold
translation_zh: n. 书店
example: The bookstore was important for everyone.

meaning: n. the act of drilling a hole in the earth in the hope of producing petroleum; s. so lacking in interest as to cause mental weariness
translation_zh: a. 烦人的, 无聊的, 无趣的；[机] 成孔期, 搪孔
example: The movie was dreadfully dull and incredibly boring.

meaning: v. get temporarily
translation_zh: vt. 借, 借入, 借用；vi. 借；[计] 借位; 借位数
example: We need to borrow this carefully.

meaning: s. (used with count nouns) two considered together; the two
translation_zh: a. 两者的；adv. 两者都；pron. 两者
example: She spoke both during the meeting.

meaning: n. a (usually rectangular) container; may have a lid; n. private area in a theater or grandstand where a small group can watch the performance; n. the quantity contained in a box; n. a rectangular drawing
translation_zh: n. 盒子, 箱, 方框, 一巴掌；vt. 装...入盒中, 装箱, 打耳光；vi. 拳击；[计] 方框
example: He put the gift in a small box.

meaning: n. a friendly informal reference to a grown man; n. (ethnic slur) offensive and disparaging term for Black man
translation_zh: n. 男孩；[法] 男孩, 少年, 儿子
example: The boy is playing in the park.

meaning: n. food made from dough of flour or meal and usually raised with yeast or baking powder and then baked; v. cover with bread crumbs
translation_zh: n. 面包, 生计, 食物；vt. 裹以面包屑
example: I bought a loaf of bread.

meaning: n. the first meal of the day (usually in the morning); v. eat an early morning meal; v. provide breakfast for
translation_zh: n. 早餐
example: What do you usually have for breakfast?

meaning: v. draw air into, and expel out of, the lungs; v. be alive; v. impart as if by breathing; v. allow the passage of air through
translation_zh: vi. 呼吸, 生存, 低语；vt. 呼吸, 使喘息, 发散, 低声说
example: It's important to breathe deeply when you exercise.

meaning: v. take something or somebody with oneself somewhere; v. cause to come into a particular state or condition; v. cause to happen or to occur as a consequence; v. go or come after and bring or take back
translation_zh: vt. 带来, 产生, 促使, 提出；vi. 生产
example: Please bring your book tomorrow.

meaning: a. physically and forcibly separated into pieces or cracked or split; a. not continuous in space, time, or sequence or varying abruptly; s. subdued or brought low in condition or status; a. (especially of promises or contracts) having been violated or disregarded
translation_zh: a. 坏掉的, 打破的, 断掉的；break的过去分词
example: The TV's broken.

meaning: n. a male with the same parents as someone else; n. a male person who is a fellow member (of a fraternity or religion or other group); n. used as a term of address for those male persons engaged in the same movement; n. (Roman Catholic Church) a title given to a monk and used as form of address
translation_zh: n. 兄弟
example: My brother is older than me.

meaning: n. a dense growth of bushes; n. an implement that has hairs or bristles firmly set into a handle; n. momentary contact; n. conducts current between rotating and stationary parts of a generator or motor
translation_zh: n. 刷子, 毛笔, 争吵；vt. 刷；vi. 擦过, 掠过；[计] 电刷
example: A tiled floor is easy to brush clean.

meaning: n. a roughly cylindrical vessel that is open at the top; n. the quantity contained in a bucket; v. put into a bucket; v. carry in a bucket
translation_zh: n. 桶；[计] 存储桶; 桶
example: They were playing on the beach with their buckets and spades.

meaning: n. performance of duties or provision of space and equipment helpful to others
translation_zh: n. 服务；服务项目（service复数形式）
example: The services plays an important role.

meaning: n. a structure that has a roof and walls and stands more or less permanently in one place; n. the occupants of a building
translation_zh: n. 建筑物, 建筑；[法] 营造, 建筑, 建筑物
example: That tall building is an office.

meaning: n. United States jurist appointed chief justice of the United States Supreme Court by Richard Nixon (1907-1995)
translation_zh: n. 汉堡包（等于hamburger）
example: I ordered a cheeseburger and fries for lunch.

meaning: n. a vehicle carrying many passengers; used for public transport; n. a car that is old and unreliable; v. send or move around by bus; v. ride in a bus
translation_zh: n. 公共汽车；[计] 总线; 汇流条; 母线
example: I take the bus to work every day.

meaning: v. keep busy with; a. actively or fully engaged or occupied; s. overcrowded or cluttered with detail; s. crowded with or characterized by much activity
translation_zh: a. 忙碌的, 热闹的, 没空的；vt. 使忙；vi. 忙碌；[计] 忙; 忙碌
example: I'm too busy to talk right now.

meaning: n. an edible emulsion of fat globules made by churning milk or cream; for cooking and table use; n. a fighter who strikes the opponent with his head; v. spread butter on
translation_zh: n. 奶油, 黄油；vt. 涂黄油于
example: Please pass the butter for the toast.

meaning: n. diurnal insect typically having a slender body with knobbed antennae and broad colorful wings; n. a swimming stroke in which the arms are thrown forward together out of the water while the feet kick up and down; v. flutter like a butterfly; v. cut and spread open, as in preparation for cooking
translation_zh: n. 蝴蝶；[医] 蝶式棉块, 翼形皮癣, 纸蝶
example: She's like a butterfly. She flits in and out of people's lives.

meaning: n. a round fastener sewn to shirts and coats etc to fit through buttonholes; n. any of various plant parts that resemble buttons; n. a round flat badge displaying information and suitable for pinning onto a garment; n. any artifact that resembles a button
translation_zh: n. 钮扣, 按钮；vi. 扣住；vt. 钉钮扣于, 扣紧；[计] 按钮
example: Press the red button to start.

meaning: v. obtain by purchase; acquire by means of a financial transaction; v. be worth or be capable of buying; v. acquire by trade or sacrifice or exchange; v. accept as true
translation_zh: vt. 买, 获得；vi. 买；n. 购买, 买得的东西
example: I need to buy some groceries.

meaning: r. so as to pass a given point
translation_zh: prep. 被, 经, 由, 在...之旁；adv. 经过, 在近处
example: The house is heated by gas.

meaning: n. you advance to the next round in a tournament without playing an opponent
translation_zh: interj. 再会, 回头见；[计] 结束命令
example: The bye was important for everyone.

meaning: caf
translation_zh: abbr. 加拿大武装部队（Canadian Armed Forces）；成本加运费价格（Cost And Freight）
example: The caf was important for everyone.

meaning: n. a small restaurant where drinks and snacks are sold
translation_zh: n. 咖啡馆, 酒店
example: There are small shops and pavement cafes around every corner.

meaning: n. a block of solid substance (such as soap or wax); n. baked goods made from or based on a mixture of flour, sugar, eggs, and fat
translation_zh: n. 蛋糕, 块, 饼；vt. 使结块, 加块状物于；vi. 结块
example: She baked a delicious chocolate cake.

meaning: n. equipment for taking photographs (usually consisting of a lightproof box with a lens at one end and light-sensitive film at the other)
translation_zh: n. 照相机, 摄影机, 密谈室, 暗箱；[计] 摄影
example: He took a picture with his new camera.

meaning: n. a rich sweet made of flavored sugar and often combined with fruit or nuts
translation_zh: n. 糖果, 冰糖；vt. 用糖煮, 使结晶为砂糖；vi. 结晶为砂糖
example: Children love to eat candy.

meaning: n. a motor vehicle with four wheels; usually propelled by an internal combustion engine; n. a wheeled vehicle adapted to the rails of railroad; n. the compartment that is suspended from an airship and that carries personnel and the cargo and the power plant; n. where passengers ride up and down
translation_zh: n. 汽车, 客车；[机] 车
example: I bought a new car.

meaning: n. one of a set of small pieces of stiff paper marked in various ways and used for playing games or for telling fortunes; n. a card certifying the identity of the bearer; n. a rectangular piece of stiff paper used to send messages (may have printed greetings or pictures); n. thin cardboard, usually rectangular
translation_zh: n. 卡片, 纸牌, 节目单, 明信片, 梳棉机；vt. 备置卡片, 记于卡片上, 梳理；[计] 卡片, 卡
example: I sent her a birthday card.

meaning: r. taking care or paying attention
translation_zh: adv. 小心地, 谨慎地
example: She spoke carefully during the meeting.

meaning: n. the act of carrying something; v. have with oneself; have on one's person; v. serve as a means for expressing something; v. bear or be able to bear the weight, pressure,or responsibility of
translation_zh: n. 进位, 射程, 运载；vt. 携带, 运送, 支持, 传送, 包含；vi. 被携带, 能达到；[计] 进位; 进位数
example: Can you help me carry these bags?

meaning: n. a humorous or satirical drawing published in a newspaper or magazine; n. a film made by photographing a series of cartoon drawings to give the illusion of movement when projected in rapid sequence; v. draw cartoons of
translation_zh: n. 卡通画, 漫画；v. 画漫画
example: The funniest contributions to the magazine are the cartoons.

meaning: n. feline mammal usually having thick soft fur and no ability to roar: domestic cats; wildcats; n. a spiteful woman gossip; v. beat with a cat-o'-nine-tails
translation_zh: n. 猫, 恶妇；vi. 呕吐；计算机辅助教育, 计算机辅助测试, 计算机辅助翻译, 计算机辅助排版；[计] 计算机辅助教学, 计算机辅助翻译, 计算机辅助排字, 计算机辅助测试
example: My cat loves to sleep.

meaning: n a soft bluish-white ductile malleable toxic bivalent metallic element; occurs in association with zinc ores; n the basic unit of luminous intensity adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites; equal to 1/60 of the luminous intensity per square centimeter of a black body radiating at the temperature of 2,046 degrees Kelvin; n a debt instrument issued by a bank; usually pays interest; n a digitally encoded recording on an optical disk that is smaller than a phonograph record; played back by a laser; s being one hundred more than three hundred
translation_zh: n. 镭射碟, 镭射唱片；[计] 光盘, 压缩盘, 载波检测, DOS内部命令:显示或改变当前目录
example: His albums are available on CD and online.

meaning: cd player
translation_zh: 激光唱机；CD播放器
example: The cd player was important for everyone.

meaning: n. a joyful occasion for special festivities to mark some happy event; n. any joyous diversion; n. the public performance of a sacrament or solemn ceremony with all appropriate ritual
translation_zh: n. 庆祝, 庆典
example: The occasion was the 40th anniversary celebrations of the orchestra.

meaning: n. a seat for one person, with a support for the back; n. a particular seat in an orchestra; v. act or preside as chair, as of an academic department in a university
translation_zh: n. 椅子, 显要的席位, 主席；vt. 使入座, 使就任要职
example: Please sit on the chair.

meaning: n. a solid food prepared from the pressed curd of milk; v. used in the imperative (get away, or stop it); v. wind onto a cheese
translation_zh: n. 乳酪；[化] 干酪
example: Would you like some cheese with your bread?

meaning: n. the flesh of a chicken used for food; n. a domestic fowl bred for flesh or eggs; believed to have been developed from the red jungle fowl; n. a foolhardy competition; a dangerous activity that is continued until one competitor becomes afraid and stops; s. easily frightened
translation_zh: n. 小鸡, 鸡肉
example: We had roasted chicken for dinner.

meaning: n. the syllable naming the second (supertonic) note of any major scale in solmization
translation_zh: prep. 关于；n. 不动产, 房地产；[计] 赖斯编码
example: The re plays an important role.

meaning: n. a young person of either sex; n. a human offspring (son or daughter) of any age; n. an immature childish person; n. a member of a clan or tribe
translation_zh: n. 孩子, 产物, 追随者；[医] 儿童
example: She is a happy child.

meaning: n. any of the Sino-Tibetan languages spoken in China; regarded as dialects of a single language (even though they are mutually unintelligible) because they share an ideographic writing system; n. a native or inhabitant of Communist China or of Nationalist China; a. of or pertaining to China or its peoples or cultures
translation_zh: n. 中文, 中国话, 中国人；a. 中国的, 中国话的
example: She is learning Chinese culture.

meaning: n. a food made from roasted ground cacao beans; n. a medium brown to dark-brown color
translation_zh: n. 巧克力；a. 巧克力制的
example: I love eating chocolate.

meaning: n. a theater where films are shown
translation_zh: n. 电影院, 电影
example: The film has just opened in cinemas across the UK.

meaning: n. a large and densely populated urban area; may include several independent administrative districts; n. an incorporated administrative district established by state charter; n. people living in a large densely populated municipality
translation_zh: n. 城市, 市；[法] 都市, 城市, 市
example: London is a big city.

meaning: n an acquaintance that you go to school with
translation_zh: n. 同班同学
example: Trish is taller than most of her classmates.

meaning: n. a room in a school where lessons take place
translation_zh: n. 教室
example: The students gathered in the classroom for their lesson.

meaning: n commodities offered for sale; n an artifact that has been created by someone or some process; n a quantity obtained by multiplication; n a chemical substance formed as a result of a chemical reaction; n a consequence of someone's efforts or of a particular set of circumstances; n the set of elements common to two or more sets
translation_zh: n. 产品；商品（product的复数）
example: The products plays an important role.

meaning: v. make clean by removing dirt, filth, or unwanted substances from; v. remove unwanted substances from, such as feathers or pits; v. be cleanable; v. deprive wholly of money in a gambling game, robbery, etc.
translation_zh: a. 干净的, 清白的, 简洁的；adv. 清洁地, 完全地；vt. 清理, 使干净, 出空；vi. 被搞干净；n. 打扫
example: Please keep your room clean.

meaning: s. showing inventiveness and skill
translation_zh: a. 聪明的, 精明的
example: He's too clever by half, if you ask me (= it annoys me or makes me suspicious).

meaning: n. a timepiece that shows the time of day; v. measure the time or duration of an event or action or the person who performs an action in a certain period of time
translation_zh: n. 时钟, 计时器, (袜子上的)绣花边花；vt. 绣花样, 记时, 记录；vi. 记录时间；[计] 时钟
example: The clock on the wall shows the time.

meaning: v. move so that an opening or passage is obstructed; make shut; v. become closed; v. finish or terminate (meetings, speeches, etc.); v. complete a business deal, negotiation, or an agreement
translation_zh: n. 结束, 完结；a. 靠近的, 亲近的, 亲密的, 严密的, 关闭的, 狭窄的, 秘密的；vt. 关, 结束, 使靠近, 封闭, 使接近；vi. 关闭, 结束, 靠近；adv. 接近地, 紧密地；[计] 关闭
example: The store is very close to my house.

meaning: a. not open or affording passage or access; a. (set theory) of an interval that contains both its endpoints; a. used especially of mouth or eyes; s. requiring union membership
translation_zh: a. 关闭的, 限于少数人的；[计] 关闭指令
example: Keep the door closed.

meaning: n artifact made by weaving or felting or knitting or crocheting natural or synthetic fibers
translation_zh: n. 布料, 织品, 布；[建] 布
example: His bandages had been made from strips of cloth.

meaning: n clothing in general; v provide with clothes or put clothes on; v furnish with power or authority; of kings or emperors; v cover as if with clothing
translation_zh: n. 衣服
example: I need to buy some new clothes.

meaning: n. any collection of particles (e.g., smoke or dust) or gases that is visible; n. a visible mass of water or ice particles suspended at a considerable altitude; n. out of touch with reality; n. a cause of worry or gloom or trouble
translation_zh: n. 云, 阴暗, 烟雾, 疑团；vt. 以云遮敝, 笼罩, 使黯然；vi. 乌云密布, 阴沉
example: There isn't a single cloud in the sky today.

meaning: s. lacking definite form or limits; a. full of or covered with clouds; s. (of liquids) clouded as with sediment
translation_zh: a. 多云的, 有愁容的, 云的, 浑浊的；[建] (混)浊的
example: The water looked cloudy and not fit to drink.

meaning: n. an outer garment that has sleeves and covers the body from shoulder down; worn outdoors; n. growth of hair or wool or fur covering the body of an animal; v. put a coat on; cover the surface of; furnish with a surface; v. cover or provide with a coat
translation_zh: n. 外套；vt. 外面覆盖, 给...穿外套
example: It's cold, put on your coat.

meaning: n. a beverage consisting of an infusion of ground coffee beans; n. any of several small trees and shrubs native to the tropical Old World yielding coffee beans
translation_zh: n. 咖啡, 咖啡色；[医] 咖啡, 咖啡豆
example: Would you like a cup of coffee?

meaning: n. carbon fuel produced by distillation of coal; n. street names for cocaine; v. become coke
translation_zh: n. 可口可乐, 焦炭；v. (使)成焦炭
example: The coke was important for everyone.

meaning: n. a mild viral infection involving the nose and respiratory passages (but not the lungs); n. the sensation produced by low temperatures; a. having a low or inadequate temperature or feeling a sensation of coldness or having been made cold by e.g. ice or refrigeration; a. extended meanings; especially of psychological coldness; without human warmth or emotion
translation_zh: n. 感冒, 寒冷；a. 寒冷的, 冷淡的, 冷静的；adv. 完全地
example: It's very cold outside today.

meaning: n. a visual attribute of things that results from the light they emit or transmit or reflect; n. interest and variety and intensity; n. the timbre of a musical sound
translation_zh: n. 颜色, 面色, 颜料, 外貌；vt. 把...涂上颜色, 粉饰, 使脸红, 歪曲；vi. 变色
example: Red is my favorite color.

meaning: n any material used for its color; n a race with skin pigmentation different from the white race (especially Blacks); n (physics) the characteristic of quarks that determines their role in the strong interaction; n interest and variety and intensity; n the timbre of a musical sound; n a visual attribute of things that results from the light they emit or transmit or reflect; n an outward or token appearance or form that is deliberately misleading; n the appearance of objects (or light sources) described in terms of a person's perception of their hue and lightness (or brightness) and saturation; v modify or bias; v decorate with colors; v give a deceptive explanation or excuse for; v affect as in thought or feeling; v add color to; v change color, often in an undesired manner; a having or capable of producing colors
translation_zh: n. 颜色, 面色, 颜料, 外貌；vt. 把...涂上颜色, 粉饰, 使脸红, 歪曲；vi. 变色
example: She always wears dark colours.

meaning: v. move toward, travel toward something or somebody or approach something or somebody; v. come to pass; arrive, as in due course; v. reach or enter a state, relation, condition, use, or position; v. to be the product or result
translation_zh: vi. 过来, 来, 到达, 出现, 开始；interj. 喂
example: Please come here.

meaning: n. a machine for performing calculations automatically
translation_zh: n. 电脑, 电子计算机；[计] 计算机
example: I use my computer for work.

meaning: n. someone who cooks food; n. English navigator who claimed the east coast of Australia for Britain and discovered several Pacific islands (1728-1779); v. prepare a hot meal; v. prepare for eating by applying heat
translation_zh: n. 厨子, 厨师；vt. 烹调, 煮饭, 加热；vi. 在煮着
example: I like to cook dinner every evening.

meaning: n. any of various small flat sweet cakes (`biscuit' is the British term); n. the cook on a ranch or at a camp; n. a short line of text that a web site puts on your computer's hard drive when you access the web site
translation_zh: n. 饼干, 小甜点；[建] 糕点
example: I baked some chocolate chip cookies.

meaning: n uncomplimentary terms for a policeman; v take by theft; v take into custody
translation_zh: n. 警官；vt. 抓住
example: He's not much cop as a singer.

meaning: n. tall annual cereal grass bearing kernels on large ears: widely cultivated in America in many varieties; the principal cereal in Mexico and Central and South America since pre-Columbian times; n. the dried grains or kernels or corn used as animal feed or ground for meal; n. ears of corn that can be prepared and served for human food; n. a hard thickening of the skin (especially on the top or sides of the toes) caused by the pressure of ill-fitting shoes
translation_zh: n. 玉蜀黍, 谷类, 谷粒, 鸡眼；vt. 使成颗粒, 腌
example: The corn is still green.

meaning: n. a place off to the side of an area; n. the point where two lines meet or intersect; n. an interior angle formed by two meeting walls; n. the intersection of two streets
translation_zh: n. 角落, 转角, 窘境；vt. 迫至一隅, 垄断, 使陷入绝境；vi. 相交成角, 垄断；[计] 边角
example: The book fell off the corner of the table.

meaning: n. a flat coat of paint or varnish used by artists as a primer; n. a narrow bed on which a patient lies during psychiatric or psychoanalytic treatment
translation_zh: n. 长沙发, 睡椅, 卧榻；vt. 横躺, 表达；vi. 躺下, 蹲伏
example: He was sprawled on the living-room couch watching TV.

meaning: imp. of Can; imp. Was, should be, or would be, able, capable, or; susceptible. Used as an auxiliary, in the past tense or in the; conditional present.
translation_zh: aux. 可以, 能
example: She said that she couldn't come.

meaning: n. the child of your aunt or uncle
translation_zh: n. 堂兄弟姊妹, 表兄弟姊妹；[法] 同辈表亲或堂亲
example: She's my cousin.

meaning: n the first month of the year; begins 10 days after the winter solstice
translation_zh: n. 一月
example: The jan plays an important role.

meaning: n a message received and understood
translation_zh: n. 信息；[计] 信息
example: 这个〈非正〉消息为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. female of domestic cattle: "`moo-cow' is a child's term"; n. mature female of mammals of which the male is called `bull'; n. a large unpleasant woman
translation_zh: n. 母牛, 母兽；vt. 威胁
example: The cow grazed peacefully in the field.

meaning: credit card
translation_zh: [计] 信用卡, 记帐卡；[经] 信用卡片, 赊购证, 购物信用卡
example: All major credit cards are accepted at our hotels.

meaning: n. a small open container usually used for drinking; usually has a handle; n. the quantity a cup will hold; n. any cup-shaped concavity; n. a United States liquid unit equal to 8 fluid ounces
translation_zh: n. 杯子, 茶杯, 优胜杯；vt. 使成杯状, 为...拔火罐
example: Would you like a cup of tea?

meaning: n. an informal term for a father; probably derived from baby talk
translation_zh: n. 爸爸, 爹爹
example: My dad is a great cook.

meaning: n an informal term for a father; probably derived from baby talk
translation_zh: n. 爸爸
example: My daddy reads me a story every night.

meaning: n. an artistic form of nonverbal communication; n. a party of people assembled for dancing; n. a party for social dancing; v. move in a graceful and rhythmical way
translation_zh: n. 跳舞, 舞蹈, 舞会；v. 跳舞
example: Let's go to the dance tonight.

meaning: n an abstract idea of that which is due to a person or governmental body by law or tradition or nature; it is something that nobody can take away"; n location near or direction toward the right side; i.e. the side to the south when a person or object faces east; n the piece of ground in the outfield on the catcher's right; n those who support political or social or economic conservatism; those who believe that things are better left unchanged; n the hand that is on the right side of the body; n a turn toward the side of the body that is on the south when the person is facing east; n anything in accord with principles of justice; n (frequently plural) the interest possessed by law or custom in some intangible thing; v make reparations or amends for; v put in or restore to an upright position; v regain an upright or proper position; v make right or correct
translation_zh: n. 正当权利；[计] 权限, 权限程序
example: The rights plays an important role.

meaning: n. taking a series of rhythmical steps (and movements) in time to music
translation_zh: n. 舞蹈；[建] 跳动的
example: The dancing was important for everyone.

meaning: n. absence of light or illumination; n. an unenlightened state; a. devoid of or deficient in light or brightness; shadowed or black; a. (used of color) having a dark hue
translation_zh: n. 黑暗, 夜, 黄昏, 模糊；a. 黑暗的, 暗的, 深色的, 隐密的, 模糊的, 无知的
example: It gets dark early in winter.

meaning: n a written work or composition that has been published (printed on pages bound together); n physical objects consisting of a number of pages bound together; n a compilation of the known facts regarding something or someone; n a written version of a play or other dramatic composition; used in preparing for a performance; n a record in which commercial accounts are recorded; n a collection of playing cards satisfying the rules of a card game; n a collection of rules or prescribed standards on the basis of which decisions are made; n the sacred writings of Islam revealed by God to the prophet Muhammad during his life at Mecca and Medina; n the sacred writings of the Christian religions; n a major division of a long written composition; n a number of sheets (ticket or stamps etc.) bound together on one edge; v engage for a performance; v arrange for and reserve (something for someone else) in advance; v record a charge in a police register; v register in a hotel booker
translation_zh: n. 书评；书籍（book的复数）
example: The books plays an important role.

meaning: n. a female human offspring
translation_zh: n. 女儿；a. 女儿的
example: My daughter is learning to read.

meaning: n. time for Earth to make a complete rotation on its axis; n. some point or period in time; n. a day assigned to a particular purpose or observance; n. the time after sunrise and before sunset while it is light outside
translation_zh: n. 天, 日子, 白天, 工作日；[医] 日(一昼夜), 昼, 白天
example: Have a good day!

meaning: n. the last (12th) month of the year
translation_zh: n. 十二月
example: Christmas is in December.

meaning: n. variety of sweet eating apples
translation_zh: a. 美味的
example: Who cooked this? It's absolutely delicious.

meaning: n. a piece of furniture with a writing surface and usually drawers or other compartments
translation_zh: n. 书桌, 办公桌, 工作台
example: She sat at her desk to work.

meaning: n. a golf course that is built on sandy ground near a shore
translation_zh: n. 高尔夫球场
example: The links plays an important role.

meaning: n. a reference book containing an alphabetical list of words with information about them
translation_zh: n. 字典, 词典；[计] 词典
example: If you don't know the meaning of a word, look it up in the dictionary.

meaning: v engage in; v carry out or perform an action; v get (something) done; v proceed or get along; v give rise to; cause to happen or occur, not always intentionally; v carry out or practice; as of jobs and professions; v be sufficient; be adequate, either in quality or quantity; v create or design, often in a certain way; v behave in a certain manner; show a certain behavior; conduct or comport oneself; v spend time in prison or in a labor camp; v carry on or function; v arrange attractively; v travel or traverse (a distance)
translation_zh: do的过去式
example: The did was important for everyone.

meaning: a. not easy; requiring great physical or mental effort to accomplish or comprehend or endure
translation_zh: a. 困难的
example: This math problem is very difficult.

meaning: n a late time of life; n a prolonged period of time; n the time during which someone's life continues; n a period of time containing 365 (or 366) days; n a period of time occupying a regular part of a calendar year that is used for some particular activity; n the period of time that it takes for a planet (as, e.g., Earth or Mars) to make a complete revolution around the sun; n a body of students who graduate together
translation_zh: n. 年代；岁月；年；年龄
example: The years plays an important role.

meaning: dining room
translation_zh: 饭厅
example: The house has a kitchen, living room and dining room downstairs and three bedrooms and a bathroom upstairs.

meaning: n. the main meal of the day served in the evening or at midday; n. a party of people assembled to have dinner together
translation_zh: n. 晚餐, 正餐, 宴会
example: What's for dinner tonight?

meaning: v. make soiled, filthy, or dirty; a. soiled or likely to soil with dirt or grime; a. (of behavior or especially language) characterized by obscenity or indecency; s. vile; despicable
translation_zh: a. 肮脏的, 卑鄙的；vt. 弄脏；vi. 变脏
example: Your hands are very dirty.

meaning: n. a piece of dishware normally used as a container for holding or serving food; n. a particular item of prepared food; n. the quantity that a dish will hold; n. directional antenna consisting of a parabolic reflector for microwave or radio frequency radiation
translation_zh: n. 盘子, 碟, 菜肴；[医] 皿, 碟
example: Please put the dirty dishes in the sink.

meaning: n. the syllable naming the first (tonic) note of any major scale in solmization; v. get (something) done; v. proceed or get along; v. create or design, often in a certain way
translation_zh: v. 做, 进行, 完成
example: What do you do for a living?

meaning: n a distinct part that can be specified separately in a group of things that could be enumerated on a list; n a small part that can be considered separately from the whole; n a whole individual unit; especially when included in a list or collection; n an isolated fact that is considered separately from the whole; n an individual instance of a type of symbol
translation_zh: n. 项目；名目；所有物品（item的复数形式）
example: The items plays an important role.

meaning: n. a licensed medical practitioner; n. children take the roles of physician or patient or nurse and pretend they are at the physician's office; n. a person who holds Ph.D. degree (or the equivalent) from an academic institution; v. give medical treatment to
translation_zh: n. 医生, 博士；vt. 授以博士学位, 诊断, 修改；vi. 行医
example: I need to see a doctor.

meaning: n the federal department responsible for maintaining a national energy policy of the United States; created in 1977; n mature female of mammals of which the male is called `buck'; v engage in; v carry out or perform an action; v get (something) done; v proceed or get along; v give rise to; cause to happen or occur, not always intentionally; v carry out or practice; as of jobs and professions; v be sufficient; be adequate, either in quality or quantity; v create or design, often in a certain way; v behave in a certain manner; show a certain behavior; conduct or comport oneself; v spend time in prison or in a labor camp; v carry on or function; v arrange attractively; v travel or traverse (a distance)
translation_zh: v. 做；工作；有用（do的第三人称单数形式）
example: The does was important for everyone.

meaning: n. a member of the genus Canis (probably descended from the common wolf) that has been domesticated by man since prehistoric times; occurs in many breeds; n. informal term for a man
translation_zh: n. 狗, 坏蛋；vt. 跟踪, 尾随
example: My dog loves to play fetch.

example: She was born in July.

meaning: n. the month following May and preceding July
translation_zh: n. 六月
example: She was born in June.

meaning: n the position where someone (as a guard or sentry) stands or is assigned to stand; n military installation at which a body of troops is stationed; n a job in an organization; n an upright consisting of a piece of timber or metal fixed firmly in an upright position; n United States aviator who in 1933 made the first solo flight around the world (1899-1935); n United States female author who wrote a book and a syndicated newspaper column on etiquette (1872-1960); n United States manufacturer of breakfast cereals and Postum (1854-1914); n any particular collection of letters or packages that is delivered; n a pole or stake set up to mark something (as the start or end of a race track); n the system whereby messages are transmitted via the post office; n the delivery and collection of letters and packages; v affix in a public place or for public notice; v publicize with, or as if with, a poster; v assign to a post; put into a post; v assign to a station; v display, as of records in sports games; v enter on a public list; v transfer (entries) from one account book to another; v ride Western style and bob up and down in the saddle in rhythm with a horse's trotting gait; v mark with a stake; v place so as to be noticed; v cause to be directed or transmitted to another place; v mark or expose as infamous
translation_zh: n. 标杆；岗位；帖子；邮件（post的复数）
example: The posts plays an important role.

meaning: n. metal device shaped in such a way that when it is inserted into the appropriate lock the lock's mechanism can be rotated; n. something crucial for explaining; n. pitch of the voice; n. any of 24 major or minor diatonic scales that provide the tonal framework for a piece of music
translation_zh: n. 钥匙, 键, 解答, 关键, 要害, 基调, 线索, 答案, 暗礁；vt. 调音, 锁上, 提供线索；vi. 使用钥匙；[计] 键, 密钥
example: I lost my house key.

meaning: n. a room equipped for preparing meals
translation_zh: n. 厨房, 全套炊具；[医] 厨房
example: The kitchen is the heart of the home.

meaning: n. a bank check that has been fraudulently altered to increase its face value; n. a bank check drawn on insufficient funds at another bank in order to take advantage of the float; n. plaything consisting of a light frame covered with tissue paper; flown in wind at end of a string; n. any of several small graceful hawks of the family Accipitridae having long pointed wings and feeding on insects and small animals
translation_zh: n. 风筝, 筝帆, 空头支票, 骗子；vi. 象风筝一样飞, 轻快地移动, 使用空头支票；vt. 使上升, 骗钱
example: The child flew a colorful kite in the park.

meaning: n. hinge joint in the human leg connecting the tibia and fibula with the femur and protected in front by the patella; n. the part of a trouser leg that provides the cloth covering for the knee
translation_zh: n. 膝, 膝盖；vt. 膝行, 用膝盖碰
example: He hurt his knee playing football.

meaning: n. edge tool used as a cutting instrument; has a pointed blade with a sharp edge and a handle; n. a weapon with a handle and blade with a sharp point; v. use a knife on
translation_zh: n. 小刀, 匕首；vt. 切割, 伤害, 切, 戳；vi. 劈开, 穿过
example: The aim is to deter young people from carrying knives.

meaning: n. the fact of being aware of information that is known to few people; v. be cognizant or aware of a fact or a specific piece of information; possess knowledge or information about; v. know how to do or perform something; v. be aware of the truth of something; have a belief or faith in something; regard as true beyond any doubt
translation_zh: v. 知道, 了解, 认识, 确信
example: I know the answer.

meaning: n. a systematic means of communicating by the use of sounds or conventional symbols; n. the mental faculty or power of vocal communication
translation_zh: n. 语言, 文字, 措辞；[计] 语言
example: English is a global language.

meaning: n a visual representation (of an object or scene or person or abstraction) produced on a surface; n graphic art consisting of an artistic composition made by applying paints to a surface; n a clear and telling mental image; n a situation treated as an observable object; n illustrations used to decorate or explain a text; n a form of entertainment that enacts a story by sound and a sequence of images giving the illusion of continuous movement; n the visible part of a television transmission; n a graphic or vivid verbal description; n a typical example of some state or quality; n a representation of a person or scene in the form of a print or transparent slide; recorded by a camera on light-sensitive material; v imagine; conceive of; see in one's mind; v show in, or as in, a picture
translation_zh: n. 电影院
example: The pictures plays an important role.

meaning: n. a garment size for a large person; a. above average in size or number or quantity or magnitude or extent; s. fairly large or important in effect; influential; s. having broad power and range and scope
translation_zh: a. 大的, 大量的, 宽大的, 广博的；adv. 大大地, 夸大地
example: That's a large dog.

meaning: last name
translation_zh: 姓
example: The last name was important for everyone.

meaning: a. being or occurring at an advanced period of time or after a usual or expected time; s. of the immediate past or just previous to the present time; s. having died recently; a. of a later stage in the development of a language or literature; used especially of dead languages
translation_zh: a. 迟的, 晚的, 已故的；adv. 很晚, 很迟, 晚
example: He was late for the meeting.

meaning: s. moving slowly and gently
translation_zh: a. 懒惰的, 怠惰的, 缓慢的；vi. 懒散
example: He was not stupid, just lazy.

meaning: v. gain knowledge or skills; v. get to know or become aware of, usually accidentally; v. be a student of a certain subject
translation_zh: vt. 学习；认识到；得知
example: I want to learn a new language.

meaning: n. a human limb; commonly used to refer to a whole limb but technically only the part of the limb between the knee and ankle; n. a structure in animals that is similar to a human leg and used for locomotion; n. one of the supports for a piece of furniture; n. the limb of an animal used for food
translation_zh: n. 腿, 假腿, 路程；vi. 走, 跑
example: My leg hurts after running.

meaning: n. a unit of instruction; n. a task assigned for individual study
translation_zh: n. 课, 课业, 教训
example: We had a math lesson this morning.

meaning: n. a serve that strikes the net before falling into the receiver's court; the ball must be served again; v. make it possible through a specific action or lack of action for something to happen; v. actively cause something to happen; v. leave unchanged
translation_zh: vt. 让, 假设, 出租, 排放, 妨碍；vi. 出租, 被承包；n. 出租屋, 障碍
example: Let me help you.

meaning: n. an alphabetical list of names and addresses; n. (computer science) a listing of the files stored in memory (usually on a hard disk)
translation_zh: n. 目录, 工商名录, 指南；[计] 目录
example: There's a store directory over there.

meaning: n. a written message addressed to a person or organization; n. the conventional characters of the alphabet used to represent speech; n. owner who lets another person use something (housing usually) for hire; n. a strictly literal interpretation (as distinct from the intention)
translation_zh: n. 信, 字母, 证书, 字面意义, 铅字, 学问, 出租人；vt. 写字母于, 在...上刻字母, 用字母标明；vi. 写印刷体字；[计] 字母
example: I received a letter from my friend.

meaning: n. a room where books are kept; n. a collection of literary documents or records kept for reference or borrowing; n. a depository built to contain books and other materials for reading and study; n. (computing) a collection of standard programs and subroutines that are stored and available for immediate use
translation_zh: n. 图书馆, 藏书, 库；[计] 库
example: I borrowed a book from the library.

meaning: n. a characteristic state or mode of living; n. the experience of being alive; the course of human events and activities; n. the course of existence of an individual; the actions and events that occur in living; n. the period during which something is functional (as between birth and death)
translation_zh: n. 生活, 生命, 人生, 世事, 生物, 寿命, 一生, 生命力, 灵魂, 无期徒刑；[医] 生活, 生存, 生命, 寿命
example: Life is beautiful.

meaning: n. any liliaceous plant of the genus Lilium having showy pendulous flowers
translation_zh: n. 百合, 百合花；a. 洁白的, 纯白色的, 纯洁的
example: Some people add a little brandy to the recipe but I feel this is gilding the lily.

meaning: n. large gregarious predatory feline of Africa and India having a tawny coat with a shaggy mane in the male; n. a celebrity who is lionized (much sought after)
translation_zh: n. 狮子, 狮子(星)座, 国际狮子会会员
example: The lion roared loudly in the savanna.

meaning: v. hear with intention; v. listen and pay attention
translation_zh: vi. 听, 倾听, 听从；n. 听, 倾听
example: Please listen carefully to the instructions.

meaning: living room
translation_zh: 客厅, 起居室
example: The living room was important for everyone.

meaning: s. marked by dejection from being alone; s. devoid of creatures
translation_zh: a. 孤单的, 孤寂的, 荒凉的
example: She lives alone and often feels lonely.

meaning: n. the act of directing the eyes toward something and perceiving it visually; n. physical appearance; v. perceive with attention; direct one's gaze towards; v. give a certain impression or have a certain outward aspect
translation_zh: n. 一看, 神色, 样子, 面容；vi. 看, 注意, 朝着, 显得；vt. 打量, 看上去与...一样, 以眼色(或脸色)显示, 期待
example: Look at that beautiful bird!

meaning: n. a strong positive emotion of regard and affection; n. any object of warm affection or devotion;; n. a deep feeling of sexual desire and attraction; n. a score of zero in tennis or squash
translation_zh: n. 爱, 恋爱, 爱情, 爱好, 性爱；vt. 爱, 爱好, 爱慕；vi. 爱
example: I love to read books.

meaning: n a young person of either sex; n a human offspring (son or daughter) of any age; n an immature childish person; n a member of a clan or tribe
translation_zh: pl. 孩子, 孩子们
example: The children plays an important role.

meaning: n. a midday meal; v. take the midday meal; v. provide a midday meal for
translation_zh: n. 午餐
example: What are you having for lunch?

meaning: n. informal terms for a mother
translation_zh: n. 妈；[计] 存储器地址, 多路存取
example: My ma always bakes the best cookies.

meaning: n North American republic containing 50 states - 48 conterminous states in North America plus Alaska in northwest North America and the Hawaiian Islands in the Pacific Ocean; achieved independence in 1776; n the army of the United States of America; the agency that organizes and trains soldiers for land warfare
translation_zh: 美国, 美利坚合众国, 美国陆军
example: The usa plays an important role.

meaning: a. a quantifier that can be used with count nouns and is often preceded by `as' or `too' or `so' or `that'; amounting to a large but indefinite number
translation_zh: n. 多数, 多数人；a. 许多的；pron. 许多
example: I have many friends.

meaning: n. a diagrammatic representation of the earth's surface (or part of it); v. make a map of; show or establish the features of details of; v. explore or survey for the purpose of making a map; v. locate within a specific region of a chromosome in relation to known DNA or gene sequences
translation_zh: n. 地图, 天体图, 映像；vt. 映射, 绘制...地图, 计划；[计] 实用程序, 映射, 制造自动化协议
example: We used a map to find our way.

meaning: n a learner who is enrolled in an educational institution; n a learned person (especially in the humanities); someone who by long study has gained mastery in one or more disciplines
translation_zh: n. （尤指大专院校的）学生（student的复数）
example: The students plays an important role.

meaning: n a science (or group of related sciences) dealing with the logic of quantity and shape and arrangement
translation_zh: n. 数学
example: Do the math before you take on more debt.

meaning: n a science (or group of related sciences) dealing with the logic of quantity and shape and arrangement; n a science (or group of related sciences) dealing with the logic of quantity and shape and arrangement
translation_zh: n. 数学
example: The core subjects are English, maths and science.

meaning: n. the month following April and preceding June
translation_zh: n. 五月；aux. 愿能, 可以, 愿意
example: That may or may not be true.

meaning: n a state in New England
translation_zh: pron. 我
example: Don't hit me.

meaning: n the piece of land on which something is located (or is to be located); n physical position in relation to the surroundings; n a computer connected to the internet that maintains a series of web pages on the World Wide Web; v assign a location to; v be seated; v be around, often idly or without specific purpose; v take a seat; v be in session; v assume a posture as for artistic purposes; v sit and travel on the back of animal, usually while controlling its motions; v be located or situated somewhere; v work or act as a baby-sitter; I have too much homework to do"; v show to a seat; assign a seat for; v serve in a specific professional capacity
translation_zh: n. 遗址, 举办地点；网站（site的复数）
example: The sites plays an important role.

meaning: n. the food served and eaten at one time; n. any of the occasions for eating food that occur by custom or habit at more or less fixed times; n. coarsely ground foodstuff; especially seeds of various cereal grasses or pulse
translation_zh: n. 一餐, 膳食, 粗粉；vi. 进餐
example: We had a delicious meal for dinner.

meaning: n. the flesh of animals (including fishes and birds and snails) used as food
translation_zh: n. 肉, 餐, 食物；[经] 肉类
example: I don't eat meat.

meaning: n. a meeting at which a number of athletic contests are held; v. come together; v. get together socially or for a specific purpose; v. fill or meet a want or need
translation_zh: n. 会, 集会；a. 适宜的, 合适的；vt. 遇见, 引见, 认识, 满足, 对付；vi. 相遇, 接触
example: Nice to meet you.

meaning: s full of or showing high-spirited merriment; s offering fun and gaiety; s quick and energetic
translation_zh: a. 快乐的, 愉快的, 嬉戏作乐的
example: I was merry after only a glass of champagne.

meaning: n. a white nutritious liquid secreted by mammals and used as food by human beings; n. produced by mammary glands of female mammals for feeding their young; n. a river that rises in the Rockies in northwestern Montana and flows eastward to become a tributary of the Missouri River; n. any of several nutritive milklike liquids
translation_zh: n. 奶, 乳状物；vt. 挤乳, 榨取；vi. 产乳
example: Would you like some milk in your coffee?

meaning: n. a unit of time equal to 60 seconds or 1/60th of an hour; n. a unit of angular distance equal to a 60th of a degree; n. a short note; s. characterized by painstaking care and detailed examination
translation_zh: n. 分, 分钟, 片刻, 备忘录, 笔记；vt. 记录, 摘录, 测定时间；a. 微小的, 详细的
example: I'll be ready in a minute.

meaning: n something that happens at a given place and time; n a special set of circumstances; n a phenomenon located at a single point in space-time; the fundamental observational entity in relativity theory; n a phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon
translation_zh: n. 事件；[体育]项目（event的复数）
example: The events plays an important role.

meaning: mobile phone
translation_zh: 移动电话
example: Please make sure all mobile phones are switched off during the performance.

meaning: n informal terms for a mother
translation_zh: n. 妈妈
example: My mom is a great cook.

meaning: mommie
translation_zh: 姆米
example: The mommie was important for everyone.

meaning: n. youngest son of Henry II; King of England from 1199 to 1216; succeeded to the throne on the death of his brother Richard I; lost his French possessions; in 1215 John was compelled by the barons to sign the Magna Carta (1167-1216); n. (New Testament) disciple of Jesus; traditionally said to be the author of the 4th Gospel and three epistles and the book of Revelation; n. the last of the four Gospels in the New Testament
translation_zh: n. 盥洗室, 厕所, 嫖客
example: The john plays an important role.

meaning: n informal terms for a mother
translation_zh: n. 妈咪
example: The little girl ran to her mommy.

meaning: n. the second day of the week; the first working day
translation_zh: n. 星期一
example: She started work last Monday.

meaning: n. the most common medium of exchange; functions as legal tender; n. wealth reckoned in terms of money; n. the official currency issued by a government or national bank
translation_zh: n. 金钱, 一笔款, 财富, 货币, 金额；[经] 货币, 金钱, 财产
example: I need some money for the bus.

meaning: n. a period of time assigned for work; n. an indefinite period of time
translation_zh: n. 小时（hour的复数形式）
example: The hours plays an important role.

meaning: n. any of various long-tailed primates (excluding the prosimians)
translation_zh: n. 猴子, 猿, 打桩锤；vi. 淘气, 胡闹；vt. 嘲弄
example: Like humans, apes and monkeys live in complex social groupings.

meaning: n. a time unit of approximately 30 days
translation_zh: n. 月；[经] 月
example: There are twelve months in a year.

meaning: n. the time period between dawn and noon
translation_zh: n. 早晨, 早上, 初期
example: I wake up early every morning.

meaning: n. a woman who has given birth to a child (also used as a term of address to your mother); n. a stringy slimy substance consisting of yeast cells and bacteria; forms during fermentation and is added to cider or wine to produce vinegar; n. a term of address for an elderly woman; n. a term of address for a mother superior
translation_zh: n. 母亲, 修女院长；vt. 产生, 照看, 收养
example: My mother is a teacher.

meaning: n. a land mass that projects well above its surroundings; higher than a hill
translation_zh: n. 山, 山脉, 大堆
example: We climbed to the top of the mountain.

meaning: r negation of a word or group of words
translation_zh: adv. 非, 不
example: The non plays an important role.

meaning: n. any of numerous small rodents typically resembling diminutive rats having pointed snouts and small ears on elongated bodies with slender usually hairless tails; n. person who is quiet or timid; n. a hand-operated electronic device that controls the coordinates of a cursor on your computer screen as you move it around on a pad; on the bottom of the device is a ball that rolls on the surface of the pad; v. manipulate the mouse of a computer
translation_zh: n. 老鼠, 胆小羞怯的人, 鼠标；vi. 捕鼠, 窥探；vt. 探出；[计] 鼠标
example: The cat chased the mouse.

meaning: n. the opening through which food is taken in and vocalizations emerge; n. the externally visible part of the oral cavity on the face and the system of organs surrounding the opening; n. an opening that resembles a mouth (as of a cave or a gorge); n. the point where a stream issues into a larger body of water
translation_zh: n. 嘴, 口, 口腔, 口状物；vi. 装腔作势说话, 做鬼脸；vt. 说出, 做作地说
example: Open your mouth wide.

meaning: n. a form of entertainment that enacts a story by sound and a sequence of images giving the illusion of continuous movement
translation_zh: n. 电影
example: Let's watch a movie tonight.

meaning: n a form of address for a man
translation_zh: 先生；[计] 存储器回收程序, 多重请求
example: Mr. Smith is our new teacher.

meaning: n. a form of address for a married woman
translation_zh: 太太
example: The mrs was important for everyone.

meaning: n. a great amount or extent; a. (quantifier used with mass nouns) great in quantity or degree or extent; r. to a great degree or extent; r. very
translation_zh: n. 大量, 许多, 重要的事；a. 很多的, 重要的；adv. 多, 甚, 几乎
example: I don't have much time.

meaning: n. secrecy; s. failing to speak or communicate etc when expected to
translation_zh: n. 菊花, 沉默；a. 沉默的；vi. 演哑剧；interj. 别说话
example: My mum always bakes a cake for my birthday.

meaning: n. an artistic form of auditory communication incorporating instrumental or vocal tones in a structured and continuous manner; n. any agreeable (pleasing and harmonious) sounds; n. musical activity (singing or whistling etc.); n. (music) the sounds produced by singers or musical instruments (or reproductions of such sounds)
translation_zh: n. 音乐, 乐曲
example: I like listening to music.

meaning: n. someone who plays a musical instrument (as a profession); n. artist who composes or conducts music as a profession
translation_zh: n. 音乐家, 乐师, 作曲家
example: She has been a professional musician for over 25 years.

meaning: n. a necessary or essential thing; n. grape juice before or during fermentation; s. highly recommended
translation_zh: n. 必须, 未发酵葡萄汁, 绝对必要的事物；aux. 必须
example: All visitors must report to reception.

meaning: a. Of or belonging to me; -- used always attributively; as, my; body; my book; -- mine is used in the predicate; as, the book is mine.; See Mine.
translation_zh: pron. 我的；[医] 迈尔(热容单位)
example: My feet are cold.

meaning: n. people having common origins or traditions and often comprising a nation; n. the status of belonging to a particular nation by birth or naturalization
translation_zh: n. 国籍, 国家, 民族性；[法] 国家, 民族, 国民
example: All applicants will be considered regardless of age, sex, religion or nationality.

meaning: n. the act of making a list of items
translation_zh: [计] 列表, 清单, 编目；[经] 挂牌, 上市, 编表
example: We must listing this carefully.

meaning: n. a person who lives (or is located) near another; n. a nearby object of the same kind; v. live or be located as a neighbor
translation_zh: n. 邻居；vt. 邻接；vi. 毗邻而居, 友好；a. 邻近的
example: Some of the neighbors complained about the noise from our party.

meaning: n a person who lives (or is located) near another; n a nearby object of the same kind; v live or be located as a neighbor; v be located near or adjacent to
translation_zh: n. 邻居, 邻接的东西, 邻国, 邻座, 邻人, 世人；a. 邻接的, 邻近的；vi.vt. 邻近, 与...结邻, 邻接
example: Our neighbour helped us with our garden.

meaning: r. not ever; at no time in the past or future; r. not at all; certainly not; not in any circumstances
translation_zh: adv. 从不, 决不, 不曾；[法] 永不, 决不, 从来没有
example: I never eat meat.

meaning: a. not of long duration; having just (or relatively recently) come into being or been made or acquired or discovered; s. having no previous example or precedent or parallel; s. other than the former one(s); different; a. unaffected by use or exposure
translation_zh: a. 新的, 陌生的, 最近的, 不熟悉的；[法] 新发现的, 新的, 重新开始的
example: I bought a new car.

meaning: n. information about recent and important events; n. information reported in a newspaper or news magazine; n. informal information of any kind that is not previously known to someone
translation_zh: n. 新闻, 消息, 报导；[法] 新闻, 消息, 新闻报导
example: Did you hear the news?

meaning: n. a daily or weekly publication on folded sheets; contains news and articles and advertisements; n. a business firm that publishes newspapers; n. the physical object that is the product of a newspaper publisher; n. cheap paper made from wood pulp and used for printing newspapers
translation_zh: n. 报纸
example: I read the newspaper every morning.

meaning: n. a city in southeastern France on the Mediterranean; the leading resort on the French Riviera; a. pleasant or pleasing or agreeable in nature or appearance; s. done with delicacy and skill
translation_zh: a. 美好的, 和蔼的, 正派的, 做得好的, 精密的, 细微的, 挑剔的, 谨慎的
example: Have a nice day!

meaning: n an implement used in the practice of a vocation; n the means whereby some act is accomplished; n a person who is controlled by others and is used to perform unpleasant or dishonest tasks for someone else; n obscene terms for penis; v drive; v ride in a car with no particular goal and just for the pleasure of it; v furnish with tools; v work with a tool
translation_zh: n. 工具, 工具菜单；工具箱（tool的复数形式）
example: The tools plays an important role.

meaning: n. the time after sunset and before sunrise while it is dark outside; n. a period of ignorance or backwardness or gloom; n. the period spent sleeping; n. the dark part of the diurnal cycle considered a time unit
translation_zh: n. 夜, 夜晚, 晚上, 黑暗, 夜晚的工作；[法] 夜, 黑夜, 黑暗
example: I like to read at night.

meaning: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of eight and one; s. denoting a quantity consisting of one more than eight and one less than ten
translation_zh: num. 九, 九个
example: There are nine apples in the basket.

meaning: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of eighteen and one; s. being one more than eighteen
translation_zh: num. 十九, 十九个
example: There are nineteen students in the class.

meaning: n. the cardinal number that is the product of ten and nine; s. being ten more than eighty
translation_zh: num. 九十, 九十个
example: She will be ninety years old next month.

meaning: n. a negative; a. quantifier; used with either mass nouns or plural count nouns for indicating a complete or almost complete lack or zero quantity of; r. referring to the degree to which a certain quality is present; r. not in any degree or manner; not at all
translation_zh: n. 不, 拒绝, 否决票；a. 没有, 不是, 绝非；adv. 不
example: There is no milk left.

meaning: n. sound of any kind (especially unintelligible or dissonant sound); n. the auditory experience of sound that lacks musical quality; sound that is a disagreeable auditory experience; n. electrical or acoustic activity that can disturb communication; n. a loud outcry of protest or complaint
translation_zh: n. 噪音, 杂音, 响声, 喧闹；vt. 谣传；vi. 喧闹；[计] 噪声
example: There was a loud noise outside.

meaning: n a form of entertainment that enacts a story by sound and a sequence of images giving the illusion of continuous movement
translation_zh: n. 电影
example: The movies plays an important role.

meaning: n. the organ of smell and entrance to the respiratory tract; the prominent part of the face of man or other mammals; n. a front that resembles a human nose (especially the front of an aircraft); n. the front or forward projection of a tool or weapon; n. a small distance
translation_zh: n. 鼻子, 突出部分, 嗅觉；vt. 嗅到, 探出, 用鼻子触；vi. 闻, 嗅, 探听, 告密
example: He has a small nose.

meaning: r. negation of a word or group of words
translation_zh: adv. 不, 非, 未；[计] 非
example: I am not hungry.

meaning: n. a book with blank pages for recording notes or memoranda; n. a small compact portable computer
translation_zh: n. 笔记本, 手册, 期票簿
example: Please write your answers in your notebook.

meaning: n. a quantity of no importance; r. in no respect; to no degree
translation_zh: n. 无, 不关紧要之事, 零；adv. 毫不, 决不；interj. 什么也没有, 无
example: There was nothing in her bag.

meaning: n. the month following October and preceding December
translation_zh: n. 十一月
example: My birthday is in November.

meaning: n. the English royal house (a branch of the Plantagenet line) that reigned from 1461 to 1485; its emblem was a white rose
translation_zh: n. 约克郡；约克王朝
example: The york plays an important role.

meaning: n. the property possessed by a sum or total or indefinite quantity of units or individuals; n. a concept of quantity involving zero and units; n. a select company of people; n. a numeral or string of numerals that is used for identification
translation_zh: n. 数, 数字, 数目, 号码；vt. 数, 计算, 共计；vi. 计算, 报数；[计] 数字
example: What's your phone number?

meaning: used after a number from one to twelve to indicate the hour of the day
translation_zh: abbr. …点钟（等于of the clock）
example: The meeting starts at nine o'clock.

meaning: n. the month following September and preceding November
translation_zh: n. 十月
example: She was born in October.

meaning: n the principal activity in your life that you do to earn money; n a specific piece of work required to be done as a duty or for a specific fee; n a workplace; as in the expression "on the job";; n an object worked on; a result produced by working; n the responsibility to do something; n the performance of a piece of work; n a damaging piece of work; n a state of difficulty that needs to be resolved; n a Jewish hero in the Old Testament who maintained his faith in God in spite of afflictions that tested him; n any long-suffering person who withstands affliction without despairing; n (computer science) a program application that may consist of several steps but is a single logical unit; n a book in the Old Testament containing Job's pleas to God about his afflictions and God's reply; n a crime (especially a robbery); v profit privately from public office and official business; v arranged for contracted work to be done by others; v work occasionally; v invest at a risk
translation_zh: n. 工作（job的复数形式）
example: The jobs plays an important role.

meaning: prep. In a general sense, from, or out from; proceeding from;; belonging to; relating to; concerning; -- used in a variety of; applications; as:; prep. Denoting that from which anything proceeds; indicating; origin, source, descent, and the like; as, he is of a race of kings; he; is of noble blood.; prep. Denoting possession or ownership, or the relation of subject; to attribute; as, the apartment of the consul: the power of the king; a; man of courage; the gate of heaven.; prep. Denoting the material of which anything is composed, or that; which it contains; as, a throne of gold; a sword of steel; a wreath of; mist; a cup of water.; prep. Denoting part of an aggregate or whole; belonging to a; number or quantity mentioned; out of; from amongst; as, of this little; he had some to spare; some of the mines were unproductive; most of the; company.; prep. Denoting that by which a person or thing is actuated or; impelled; also, the source of a purpose or action; as, they went of; their own will; no body can move of itself; he did it of necessity.; prep. Denoting reference to a thing; about; concerning; relating; to; as, to boast of one's achievements.; prep. Denoting nearness or distance, either in space or time;; from; as, within a league of the town; within an hour of the appointed; time.; prep. Denoting identity or equivalence; -- used with a name or; appellation, and equivalent to the relation of apposition; as, the; continent of America; the city of Rome; the Island of Cuba.; prep. Denoting the agent, or person by whom, or thing by which,; anything is, or is done; by.; prep. Denoting relation to place or time; belonging to, or; connected with; as, men of Athens; the people of the Middle Ages; in; the days of Herod.; prep. Denoting passage from one state to another; from.; prep. During; in the course of.
translation_zh: prep. 的, 属于
example: We would often have a walk of an evening.

meaning: n. place of business where professional or clerical duties are performed; n. (of a government or government official) holding an office means being in power; n. professional or clerical workers in an office; n. a religious rite or service prescribed by ecclesiastical authorities
translation_zh: n. 办公室, 部, 公职, 职责；[化] 办公室
example: I go to the office every day.

meaning: r. in many cases or instances
translation_zh: adv. 时常, 常常
example: I often go for a walk.

meaning: n a state in south central United States; k an endorsement; s being satisfactory or in satisfactory condition; r an expression of agreement normally occurring at the beginning of a sentence
translation_zh: a. 好, 不错, 可以；adv. 好, 不错, 可以；n. 批准, 认可；[计] 确定
example: Okay, let's go.

meaning: r. in a satisfactory or adequate manner; (`alright' is a nonstandard variant of `all right')
translation_zh: a. 好, 可以, 行, 对, 好吗, 很好；adv. 好, 可以, 行, 对, 好吗, 很好；n. 同意, 签认, 批准, 认可；vt. 同意, 签认, 批准, 认可
example: This is a very okay situation.

meaning: n. past times (especially in the phrase `in days of old'); a. (used especially of persons) having lived for a relatively long time or attained a specific age; a. of long duration; not new; s. (used for emphasis) very familiar
translation_zh: n. 以前, 往昔；a. 老的, 旧的, 古老的, 年长的, 老练的
example: My grandfather is old.

meaning: n the modern revival of the ancient games held once every 4 years in a selected country
translation_zh: n. 奥林匹克运动会
example: The olympics was important for everyone.

meaning: r. with nevertheless the final result; r. in the final outcome; r. except that; only this time she came out better"; r. never except when
translation_zh: a. 唯一的, 仅有的, 最佳的；adv. 只有, 仅仅, 只能；conj. 但是, 不过
example: I only have five dollars.

meaning: n. a clear or unobstructed space or expanse of land or water; n. a tournament in which both professionals and amateurs may play; n. information that has become public; v. cause to open or to become open
translation_zh: n. 公开, 户外, 空旷；a. 开着的, 开放的, 开阔的, 营业着的, 公开的, 悬而未决的；vt. 打开, 公开, 开放；vi. 展开, 开始, 展现；[计] 打开指令; 打开语句
example: The door is open.
