meaning: n. a drama set to music; consists of singing with orchestral accompaniment and an orchestral overture and interludes; n. a commercial browser; n. a building where musical dramas are performed
translation_zh: n. 歌剧
example: "Carmen" is my favorite opera.

meaning: n a state in northwestern United States on the Pacific; n a room in a hospital equipped for the performance of surgical operations
translation_zh: conj. 或, 或者；[计] 或
example: He can't read or write.

meaning: n. round yellow to orange fruit of any of several citrus trees; n. orange color or pigment; any of a range of colors between red and yellow; n. any citrus tree bearing oranges; n. any pigment producing the orange color
translation_zh: n. 柑橘, 桔子, 橘色；a. 橘色的
example: She wore an orange dress.

meaning: pl.  of I; possessive pron. Of or pertaining to us; belonging to us; as, our; country; our rights; our troops; our endeavors. See I.
translation_zh: pron. 我们的
example: We showed them some of our photos.

meaning: n. a nation in northern North America; the French were the first Europeans to settle in mainland Canada
translation_zh: n. 加拿大
example: The canada plays an important role.

meaning: pl.  of I; possessive pron. See Note under Our.
translation_zh: pron. 我们的
example: Their house is very similar to ours, but ours is bigger.

meaning: n. (baseball) a failure by a batter or runner to reach a base safely in baseball; v. reveal (something) about somebody's identity or lifestyle; v. be made known; be disclosed or revealed; a. not allowed to continue to bat or run
translation_zh: a. 外面的, 熄灭的, 结束的；adv. 在外, 熄灭, 出现；prep. 出自, 离去, 向
example: She went out to buy milk.

meaning: n. one side of one leaf (of a book or magazine or newspaper or letter etc.) or the written or pictorial matter it contains; n. English industrialist who pioneered in the design and manufacture of aircraft (1885-1962); n. United States diplomat and writer about the Old South (1853-1922); n. a boy who is employed to run errands
translation_zh: n. 页, 记录, 事件, 专栏, 男侍；vt. 标明...的页数, 翻...的书页, 分页排版, 呼叫, 侍候；vi. 翻书页, 侍侯；[计] 页; 页面
example: Please turn to page 20.

meaning: n. a large and stately mansion; n. the governing group of a kingdom; n. a large ornate exhibition hall; n. official residence of an exalted person (as a sovereign)
translation_zh: n. 宫, 宫殿, 华丽大厦
example: He spent his early days at the Palace of Versailles.

meaning: n underpants worn by women; n the noise made by a short puff of steam (as from an engine); n (usually in the plural) a garment extending from the waist to the knee or ankle, covering each leg separately; n a short labored intake of breath with the mouth open; v breathe noisily, as when one is exhausted; v utter while panting, as if out of breath
translation_zh: n. 裤子, 长裤, 短衬裤, 女式运动短裤
example: I start patting at my pants pockets.

meaning: n. a material made of cellulose pulp derived mainly from wood or rags or certain grasses; n. a medium for written communication; n. a scholarly article describing the results of observations or stating hypotheses; v. cover with paper
translation_zh: n. 纸, 文件, 文章, 报纸, 证券, 证件；vt. 用纸糊, 贴壁纸于, 用纸包装；vi. 贴壁纸；a. 纸做的, 纸上的
example: Please write your name on the paper.

meaning: n. one of several distinct subdivisions of a text intended to separate ideas; the beginning is usually marked by a new indented line; v. divide into paragraphs, as of text; v. write about in a paragraph; v. write paragraphs; work as a paragrapher
translation_zh: n. 段落, 短评；vt. 将...分段, 分段落；vi. 写短讯；[计] 段落
example: Write a paragraph on each of the topics given below.

meaning: n. a father or mother; one who begets or one who gives birth to or nurtures and raises a child; a relative who plays the role of guardian; n. an organism (plant or animal) from which younger ones are obtained
translation_zh: n. 父母, 父母亲, 根源；[法] 父亲, 母亲, 根源
example: My parents are visiting next week.

meaning: v. give money, usually in exchange for goods or services; v. do or give something to somebody in return; v. be worth it; v. render
translation_zh: n. 薪资, 付款, 补偿；vt. 支付, 付清, 补偿, 偿还, 对...有利, 为...涂防水物；vi. 付款, 付出代价, 偿还, 得到报应, 获得好处
example: I need to pay for the groceries.

meaning: n. a writing implement with a point from which ink flows; n. an enclosure for confining livestock; n. female swan
translation_zh: n. 钢笔, 笔, 笔调, 笔杆子, 作家, 围栏, 栅栏, 禽畜；vt. 写, 关入栏中, 囚禁；vi. 动笔, 写作
example: Can I borrow your pen?

meaning: n. a thin cylindrical pointed writing implement; a rod of marking substance encased in wood; n. graphite (or a similar substance) used in such a way as to be a medium of communication; n. a figure formed by a set of straight lines or light rays meeting at a point; n. a cosmetic in a long thin stick; designed to be applied to a particular part of the face
translation_zh: n. 铅笔, 色笔, 眉笔, 画笔, 光线束；vt. 用铅笔写或涂, 草拟
example: Can I borrow your pencil?

meaning: n the force of workers available; n an adult person who is male (as opposed to a woman); n someone who serves in the armed forces; a member of a military force; n the generic use of the word to refer to any human being; n any living or extinct member of the family Hominidae characterized by superior intelligence, articulate speech, and erect carriage; n a male subordinate; n an adult male person who has a manly character (virile and courageous competent); n a manservant who acts as a personal attendant to his employer; n a male person who plays a significant role (husband or lover or boyfriend) in the life of a particular woman; n one of the British Isles in the Irish Sea; n game equipment consisting of an object used in playing certain board games; n all of the living human inhabitants of the earth
translation_zh: pl. man的复数
example: Two men were waiting at the bus stop.

meaning: n. (plural) any group of human beings (men or women or children) collectively; n. members of a family line; v. fill with people; v. furnish with people
translation_zh: n. 人, 人民, 民族, 平民；vt. 使住满人, 居住于
example: Many people attended the event.

meaning: n a collection of things sharing a common attribute; n a general concept that marks divisions or coordinations in a conceptual scheme
translation_zh: n. 分类；类别（category的复数）
example: The categories plays an important role.

meaning: n. a human being; n. a human body (usually including the clothing); n. a grammatical category used in the classification of pronouns, possessive determiners, and verb forms according to whether they indicate the speaker, the addressee, or a third party
translation_zh: n. 人, 人身, 人称；[法] 人, 法人, 人身
example: She is a kind person.

meaning: n. a domesticated animal kept for companionship or amusement; n. a fit of petulance or sulkiness (especially at what is felt to be a slight); v. stroke or caress gently; v. stroke or caress in an erotic manner, as during lovemaking
translation_zh: n. 宠物, 受宠爱的人, 宠坏的孩子, 不悦, 生气；a. 宠爱的, 表示亲昵的, 养着观赏的, 特别珍爱的, 格外的；vt. 宠爱, 溺爱, 抚摸；vi. 拥抱, 爱抚, 生气, 发脾气
example: Do you have any pets at home.

meaning: n. (phonetics) an individual sound unit of speech without concern as to whether or not it is a phoneme of some language
translation_zh: n. 电话, 受话器, 耳机；vt. 打电话给；vi. 打电话
example: Can I use your phone?

meaning: n income (at invoice values) received for goods and services over some given period of time; n a particular instance of selling; n the general activity of selling; n an occasion (usually brief) for buying at specially reduced prices; n the state of being purchasable; offered or exhibited for selling; n an agreement (or contract) in which property is transferred from the seller (vendor) to the buyer (vendee) for a fixed price in money (paid or agreed to be paid by the buyer)
translation_zh: a. 销售的；[计] 销售
example: The sales plays an important role.

meaning: n a representation of a person or scene in the form of a print or transparent slide; recorded by a camera on light-sensitive material
translation_zh: n. 相片, 照片, 逼真的描绘；v. 照相；a. 照相的, 摄影用的, 详细记录的, 逼真的, 酷似的
example: She took a beautiful photo of the sunset.

meaning: n. a keyboard instrument that is played by depressing keys that cause hammers to strike tuned strings and produce sounds; n. (music) low loudness; a. used chiefly as a direction or description in music; r. used as a direction in music; to be played relatively softly
translation_zh: n. 钢琴
example: She plays the piano very well.

meaning: n. an Indo-European language belonging to the West Germanic branch; the official language of Britain and the United States and most of the commonwealth countries; n. the people of England; n. the discipline that studies the English language and literature
translation_zh: n. 英语；a. 英文的, 英国人的
example: She speaks good English.

meaning: n. any informal meal eaten outside or on an excursion; v. eat alfresco, in the open air
translation_zh: n. 野餐, 远足, 愉快的经历；vi. 去野餐, 远足
example: It's a nice day. Let's go for a picnic.

meaning: n. a crude block of metal (lead or iron) poured from a smelting furnace; v. live like a pig, in squalor
translation_zh: n. 猪, 猪肉, 贪婪的人, 猪一样的人；v. 生小猪, 象猪般地生活
example: The pig rolled in the mud.

meaning: n. Italian open pie made of thin bread dough spread with a spiced mixture of e.g. tomato sauce and cheese
translation_zh: n. 比萨饼
example: Let's order a large pizza for dinner.

meaning: n. a dramatic work intended for performance by actors on a stage; n. a theatrical performance of a drama; n. a preset plan of action in team sports; n. a state in which action is feasible
translation_zh: n. 游戏, 游玩, 玩笑, 运动, 比赛, 赌博, 跳动, 表演, 剧本；v. 玩, 游戏, 假装, 开玩笑, 比赛, 扮演, 演奏, 演戏, 传摇曳, (使)跳动；[计] 播放
example: Let's play a game.

meaning: n an examination and dissection of a dead body to determine cause of death or the changes produced by disease; n a soft silvery metallic element of the rare earth group having no stable isotope; was discovered in radioactive form as a fission product of uranium; n the person who holds the position of head of the government in the United Kingdom; n modulation of the phase of the carrier wave
translation_zh: 出纳员, 军需官；[计] 调相, 性能管理, 处理模块, 程序存储器
example: She spoke pm during the meeting.

meaning: n. the prevailing context that influences the performance or the outcome of a process; n. the set of circumstances that affect someone's welfare
translation_zh: n. 形势, 情况, 环境
example: The conditions plays an important role.

meaning: n. a composition written in metrical feet forming rhythmical lines
translation_zh: n. 诗, 诗般美的事物
example: His collected poems were published after the war.

meaning: n. undesirable state of the natural environment being contaminated with harmful substances as a consequence of human activities
translation_zh: n. 污染, 玷污；[化] 污染
example: The new buses emit no more pollution than the average car.

meaning: n. (trademark) an operating system with a graphical user interface
translation_zh: n. 微软公司生产的“视窗”操作系统
example: The windows plays an important role.

meaning: n. a sign posted in a public place as an advertisement
translation_zh: n. 海报, 招贴, 驿马
example: They put up a poster advertising the concert.

meaning: n a representation of a person or scene in the form of a print or transparent slide; recorded by a camera on light-sensitive material
translation_zh: n. 照片, 图片；相册（photo的复数形式）
example: The photos plays an important role.

meaning: n. an edible tuber native to South America; a staple food of Ireland; n. annual native to South America having underground stolons bearing edible starchy tubers; widely cultivated as a garden vegetable; vines are poisonous
translation_zh: n. 马铃薯
example: I like to eat baked potato with cheese.

meaning: v engage in a rehearsal (of); v carry out or practice; as of jobs and professions; v learn by repetition
translation_zh: v. 实践, 实行, 练习, 实习, 从事(职业)
example: We need to practise this carefully.

meaning: v. address a deity, a prophet, a saint or an object of worship; say a prayer
translation_zh: v. 祈祷, 恳求, 请
example: We need to pray this carefully.

meaning: n. a state of difficulty that needs to be resolved; n. a question raised for consideration or solution
translation_zh: n. 问题, 难题；a. 成问题的, 难处理的
example: We have a big problem to solve.

meaning: v. put into a certain place or abstract location; v. cause to be in a certain state; cause to be in a certain relation; v. attribute or give; v. cause (someone) to undergo something
translation_zh: vt. 放, 摆, 安置, 移动, 发射, 投掷, 写上, 表达, 使从事, 使受到, 驱使, 赋予；vi. 出发, 航行, 发芽；n. 掷, 股票出售权, 笨蛋；a. 固定不动的；[计] 发送文件
example: Please put the book on the table.

meaning: n. any of various burrowing animals of the family Leporidae having long ears and short tails; some domesticated and raised for pets or food; n. flesh of any of various rabbits or hares (wild or domesticated) eaten as food; v. hunt rabbits
translation_zh: n. 兔子；vi. 猎兔；vt. 让...见鬼去
example: A rabbit hopped across the garden.

meaning: n. medium for communication; n. a communication system based on broadcasting electromagnetic waves; v. transmit messages via radio waves; a. indicating radiation or radioactivity
translation_zh: n. 无线电, 收音机, 无线电报, 无线电广播, 无线电台；v. 用无线电发送
example: I listen to the radio in the car.

meaning: n. water falling in drops from vapor condensed in the atmosphere; n. drops of fresh water that fall as precipitation from clouds; n. anything happening rapidly or in quick successive; v. precipitate as rain
translation_zh: n. 雨, 下雨, 雨天；vi. 下雨；vt. 使大量落下
example: The rain started falling heavily.

meaning: s (of weather) wet by periods of rain
translation_zh: a. 下雨的, 多雨的
example: We had three rainy days on vacation, but otherwise it was sunny.

meaning: n. any of various long-tailed rodents similar to but larger than a mouse; n. a pad (usually made of hair) worn as part of a woman's coiffure; v. desert one's party or group of friends, for example, for one's personal advantage; v. employ scabs or strike breakers in
translation_zh: n. 鼠, 卑鄙的人, 破坏者, 变节者；vi. 捕鼠, 变节；vt. 弄蓬松
example: The police are all over town. He's caught, like a rat in a trap.

meaning: n. something that is read; v. interpret something that is written or printed; v. have or contain a certain wording or form; v. look at, interpret, and say out loud something that is written or printed
translation_zh: v. 读, 阅读, 理解；a. 有学问的；n. 读取, 阅读；[计] 读取
example: I love to read books.

meaning: n. a person who enjoys reading; n. a person who can read; a literate person; n. one of a series of texts for students learning to read
translation_zh: n. 读者, 读物, 文选, 校对人, 讲师；[计] 阅读程序; 阅读器
example: And so, dear reader, our tale comes to its end.

meaning: n. the cognitive process of understanding a written linguistic message; n. a particular interpretation or performance; n. a datum about some physical state that is presented to a user by a meter or similar instrument; n. written material intended to be read
translation_zh: n. 阅读, 知识, 读物；a. 阅读的
example: Reading is a great way to learn new things.

meaning: n. poised for action; a. completely prepared or in condition for immediate action or use or progress; s. (of especially money) immediately available; s. mentally disposed
translation_zh: n. 预备好的状态, 现款；a. 准备好的, 备用的, 可以使用的；adv. 预先, 迅速；vt. 使准备好
example: Are you ready to go?

meaning: r in accordance with truth or fact or reality; r in actual fact; r in fact (used as intensifiers or sentence modifiers); r used as intensifiers; `real' is sometimes used informally for `really'; `rattling' is informal
translation_zh: adv. 实际上, 真实地, 实在
example: I really like this song.

meaning: v. recall knowledge from memory; have a recollection; v. keep in mind for attention or consideration; v. recapture the past; indulge in memories; v. show appreciation to
translation_zh: vt. 记得, 回忆起, 记住, 铭记, 纪念；vi. 记得
example: I can't remember his name.

meaning: n. a person who investigates and reports or edits news stories
translation_zh: n. 记者, 报告者；[化] 指示器
example: He leaked the story to a news reporter.

meaning: n. a building where people go to eat
translation_zh: n. 餐馆, 饭店
example: Let's eat at the new restaurant.

meaning: n. any long object resembling a thin line; n. a long strip of inked material for making characters on paper with a typewriter; n. notion consisting of a narrow strip of fine material used for trimming
translation_zh: n. 缎带, 色带, 带状物；vt. 用丝带装饰, 把...撕成条状；vi. 形成带状；[计] 带状条, 格式栏
example: Her present was tied with yellow ribbon.

meaning: n. grains used as food either unpolished or more often polished; n. annual or perennial rhizomatous marsh grasses; seed used for food; straw used for paper; n. English lyricist who frequently worked with Andrew Lloyd Webber (born in 1944); n. United States playwright (1892-1967)
translation_zh: n. 米, 米饭, 稻；vt. 将...压成米粒状
example: We had rice with our dinner.

meaning: n. a large natural stream of water (larger than a creek)
translation_zh: n. 河, 江；[法] 河流, 江河, 内河
example: The city is located by a big river.

meaning: s socially incorrect in behavior; s (of persons) lacking in refinement or grace; a lacking civility or good manners; s (used especially of commodities) being unprocessed or manufactured using only simple or minimal processes; s belonging to an early stage of technical development; characterized by simplicity and (often) crudeness
translation_zh: a. 粗鲁无礼的, 粗陋的, 粗暴的, 原始的, 未开化的, 大略的, 崎岖不平的, 狂暴的
example: He started swearing and using rude words.

meaning: n a prominent attribute or aspect of something; n the characteristic parts of a person's face: eyes and nose and mouth and chin; n the principal (full-length) film in a program at a movie theater; n a special or prominent article in a newspaper or magazine; n (linguistics) a distinctive characteristic of a linguistic unit that serves to distinguish it from other units of the same kind; n an article of merchandise that is displayed or advertised more than other articles; v have as a feature; v wear or display in an ostentatious or proud manner
translation_zh: n. 容貌；产品特点, 特征；嘴脸（feature的复数）
example: The features plays an important role.

meaning: n. a person who rules or commands
translation_zh: n. 统治者, 管理者, 尺, 直尺；n. 划线板；[计] 标尺
example: Can I borrow your ruler to draw a straight line?

meaning: n. a score in baseball made by a runner touching all four bases safely; n. (American football) a play in which a player attempts to carry the ball through or past the opposing team; n. a regular trip; n. the act of running; traveling on foot at a fast pace
translation_zh: n. 跑, 赛跑, 奔跑, 奔跑的路程, 趋向, 流出, 运转时间, 连续；vi. 跑, 奔跑, 跑步, 赛跑, 竞赛, 行驶, 运转, 进行, 蔓延；vt. 使跑, 参赛, 追究, 驾驶, 开动, 管理, 经营, 使流出, 运行；a. 熔化的, 融化的, 浇铸的；run的过去式和过去分词；[计] 运行
example: I like to run in the park.

meaning: n. a native or inhabitant of Russia; n. the Slavic language that is the official language of Russia; a. of or pertaining to or characteristic of Russia or its people or culture or language
translation_zh: n. 俄国人, 俄语；a. 俄国的, 俄语的
example: She is studying Russian history.

meaning: a. experiencing or showing sorrow or unhappiness; s. of things that make you feel sad
translation_zh: a. 忧愁的, 悲哀的
example: She felt sad when her pet left.

meaning: n. any member of a ship's crew
translation_zh: n. 水手, 船员, 海员；[法] 水手, 船员, 海员
example: The vessels are manned by 1  300 sailors.

meaning: n. food mixtures either arranged on a plate or tossed and served with a moist dressing; usually consisting of or including greens
translation_zh: n. 色拉
example: I had a fresh salad for lunch.

meaning: a. same in identity; a. closely similar or comparable in kind or quality or quantity or degree; s. unchanged in character or nature
translation_zh: a. 相同的, 同样的；pron. 相同的人(或事物)；adv. 同样地
example: We have the same idea.

meaning: n. two (or more) slices of bread with a filling between them; v. make into a sandwich; v. insert or squeeze tightly between two people or objects
translation_zh: n. 三明治, 夹心面包, 夹层板；vt. 插入, 夹入, 把...制成三明治
example: I'll have a ham sandwich for lunch.

meaning: v require as useful, just, or proper; v consider obligatory; request and expect; v make someone do something; v have need of; s necessary for relief or supply; s required by rule
translation_zh: a. 必需的
example: We must required this carefully.

meaning: n. the seventh and last day of the week; observed as the Sabbath by Jews and some Christians
translation_zh: n. 星期六
example: We usually go shopping on Saturday.

meaning: n. an educational institution; n. a building where young people receive education; n. the process of being formally educated at a school; n. a body of creative artists or writers or thinkers linked by a similar style or by similar teachers
translation_zh: n. 学校, 鱼群, 门派, 学派；vt. 教育, 训练, 培养；vi. 成群地游
example: I go to school every day.

meaning: n. a division of an ocean or a large body of salt water partially enclosed by land; n. turbulent water with swells of considerable size
translation_zh: n. 海, 海洋, 海浪, 大量；[法] 海, 海洋
example: We went for a swim in the sea.

meaning: n clothing that is worn or carried, but not part of your main clothing; n a supplementary component that improves capability; n someone who helps another person commit a crime
translation_zh: n. 辅助程序；[计]附件（accessory的复数形式）
example: The accessories plays an important role.

meaning: n. a space reserved for sitting (as in a theater or on a train or airplane); n. furniture that is designed for sitting on; n. any support where you can sit (especially the part of a chair or bench etc. on which you sit); n. a center of authority (as a city from which authority is exercised)
translation_zh: n. 座, 座位, 位子, 席位, 所在地；vt. 使坐下, 使就座, 为...设座于, 使就职；vi. 安装在底座上
example: Take a seat, please.

meaning: n. the seat within a bishop's diocese where his cathedral is located; v. perceive by sight or have the power to perceive by sight; v. deem to be; v. be careful or certain to do something; make certain of something
translation_zh: vt. 看见, 查看, 参观, 游览, 理解, 知道, 同意；vi. 看, 观看, 注意, 知道, 考虑；n. 主教的职位
example: Can you see the mountain?

meaning: n. the month following August and preceding October
translation_zh: n. 九月
example: My birthday is in September.

meaning: n a public meeting or assembly for open discussion; n a public facility to meet for open discussion
translation_zh: pl. 论坛, 讨论会, 座谈会, 广播专题讲话节目, 电视专题讲话节目, 法庭
example: The forums plays an important role.

meaning: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of six and one; s. being one more than six
translation_zh: num. 七, 七个
example: There are seven days in a week.

meaning: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of sixteen and one; s. being one more than sixteen
translation_zh: num. 十七, 十七个
example: I'm almost seventeen so I should be able to do what I want.

meaning: n. the syllable naming the sixth (submediant) note of a major or minor scale in solmization
translation_zh: [医] 镧(57号元素)
example: The la plays an important role.

meaning: n. the cardinal number that is the product of ten and seven; s. being ten more than sixty
translation_zh: num. 七十, 七十个
example: This house was built seventy years ago.

meaning: obj. This or that female; the woman understood or referred to;; the animal of the female sex, or object personified as feminine, which; was spoken of.; obj. A woman; a female; -- used substantively.
translation_zh: pron. 她
example: She's a big country.

meaning: n. woolly usually horned ruminant mammal related to the goat; n. a timid defenseless simpleton who is readily preyed upon; n. a docile and vulnerable person who would rather follow than make an independent decision
translation_zh: n. 羊, 胆小者
example: Sheep were grazing in the fields.

meaning: n. a support that consists of a horizontal surface for holding objects
translation_zh: n. 架子, 搁板；[化] 架子
example: I helped him put up some shelves in his bedroom.

meaning: n an instance of questioning; n the subject matter at issue; n a sentence of inquiry that asks for a reply; n uncertainty about the truth or factuality or existence of something; n a formal proposal for action made to a deliberative assembly for discussion and vote; n an informal reference to a marriage proposal; v challenge the accuracy, probity, or propriety of; v pose a series of questions to; v pose a question; v conduct an interview in television, newspaper, and radio reporting; v place in doubt or express doubtful speculation
translation_zh: n. 问题（question的复数）
example: The questions plays an important role.

meaning: n. a garment worn on the upper half of the body; v. put a shirt on
translation_zh: n. 衬衫, 内衣, 汗衫
example: He put on a clean shirt.

meaning: n. footwear shaped to fit the foot (below the ankle) with a flexible upper of leather or plastic and a sole and heel of heavier material; n. (card games) a case from which playing cards are dealt one at a time; v. furnish with shoes
translation_zh: n. 鞋, 靴, 外胎；vt. 给...穿鞋, 为马钉蹄铁
example: I need a new pair of shoes.

meaning: n. one of a race of brutes resembling men but subject to the Houyhnhnms in a novel by Jonathan Swift; n. a widely used search engine for the web that finds information, news, images, products, finance
translation_zh: n. 人面兽心的人, 乡愚, 粗汉
example: The yahoo plays an important role.

meaning: n. searching for or buying goods or services; n. the commodities purchased from stores
translation_zh: n. 买东西, 购物；[经] 购物, 买东西
example: We do our shopping on Saturdays.

meaning: n. advancing toward a goal; s. in full operation
translation_zh: n. 去, 离去, 工作情况, 地面状况, 行为；a. 进行中的, 流行的, 成功的, 现存的
example: The going plays an important role.

meaning: imp. of Shall; imp. Used as an auxiliary verb, to express a conditional or; contingent act or state, or as a supposition of an actual fact; also,; to express moral obligation (see Shall); e. g.: they should have come; last week; if I should go; I should think you could go.
translation_zh: aux. 应该, 将要
example: You shouldn't drink and drive.

meaning: n. a quick throw; v. start suddenly, as from fright; v. throw quickly; s. short
translation_zh: n. 惊跳, 惊避；a. 胆怯的, 畏缩的, 迟疑的, 羞怯的；vi. 惊退, 乱投, 乱掷, 厌恶, 避开；vt. 乱投, 乱掷
example: He is not exactly the shy and retiring type.

meaning: n. people who are sick; s. deeply affected by a strong feeling
translation_zh: n. 病人；a. 不舒服, 有病的, 恶心的, 厌恶的, 渴望的, 病态的；vt. 呕吐, 追击, 使(狗)去攻击
example: She felt sick after eating too much candy.

meaning: v. deliver by singing; v. produce tones with the voice; v. to make melodious sounds
translation_zh: vi. 唱, 唱歌, 演唱, 鸣, 啼；vt. 唱, 歌颂；n. 嗖嗖声
example: She loves to sing in the shower.

meaning: n. a person who sings; n. United States inventor of an improved chain-stitch sewing machine (1811-1875); n. United States writer (born in Poland) of Yiddish stories and novels (1904-1991)
translation_zh: n. 歌手
example: My favorite singer is performing tonight.

meaning: n the last (12th) month of the year; n (astronomy) the angular distance of a celestial body north or to the south of the celestial equator; expressed in degrees; used with right ascension to specify positions on the celestial sphere
translation_zh: 美国数字电子公司；[计] 数字设备公司
example: The dec plays an important role.

meaning: n. term of address for a man; n. a title used before the name of knight or baronet
translation_zh: n. 先生, 阁下
example: Excuse me, sir, can you help me?

meaning: n. a female person who has the same parents as another person; n. (Roman Catholic Church) a title given to a nun (and used as a form of address); n. a female person who is a fellow member of a sorority or labor union or other group
translation_zh: n. 姐妹, 姐, 妹, 护士, 修女；vt. 姐妹般对待
example: My sister lives in another city.

meaning: v. be seated; v. be around, often idly or without specific purpose; v. be in session; v. be located or situated somewhere
translation_zh: vi. 坐, 就座, 坐落；vt. 使就座, 骑；n. 坐, 衣服合身
example: Please sit down.

meaning: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of five and one; s. denoting a quantity consisting of six items or units
translation_zh: num. 六, 六个
example: There are six cookies left.

meaning: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of fifteen and one; s. being one more than fifteen
translation_zh: num. 十六, 十六个
example: There are sixteen students in the class.

meaning: n. a heavy open wagon usually having two wheels and drawn by an animal; v. transport something in a cart
translation_zh: n. 二轮运货马车；vi. 驾运货马车；vt. 用车装载
example: Milk was delivered by horse and cart in those days.

meaning: n. the cardinal number that is the product of ten and six; s. being ten more than fifty
translation_zh: num. 六十, 六十个
example: She plans to retire at sixty (= when she is 60 years old).

meaning: n. the physical magnitude of something (how big it is); n. the property resulting from being one of a series of graduated measurements (as of clothing); n. any glutinous material used to fill pores in surfaces or to stiffen fabrics; n. the actual state of affairs
translation_zh: n. 大小, 尺寸, 规模, 尺码, 能力, 浆料；vt. 上浆, 依大小排列；vi. 可比拟；a. 一定大小的, 一定尺寸的
example: What size shoes do you wear?

meaning: n nonfictional prose forming an independent part of a publication; n one of a class of artifacts; n a separate section of a legal document (as a statute or contract or will); n (grammar) a determiner that may indicate the specificity of reference of a noun phrase; v bind by a contract; especially for a training period
translation_zh: n. 文章；冠词；物品；条款（article的复数）
example: The articles plays an important role.

meaning: n. cloth covering that forms the part of a garment below the waist; n. a garment hanging from the waist; worn mainly by girls and women; v. pass around or about; move along the border; v. form the edge of
translation_zh: n. 裙子, 下摆, 边缘, 郊区；vt. 位于...边缘, 绕过, 回避；vi. 位于边缘
example: I never wear skirts.

meaning: san
translation_zh: abbr. 存储区域网（Storage Area Networking）
example: The san plays an important role.

meaning: n. the atmosphere and outer space as viewed from the earth
translation_zh: n. 天空, 天色, 天堂；vt. 击向空中, 挂在高处；vi. 高涨
example: The sky was clear and blue.

meaning: n. the slender part of the back; n. a garment size for a small person; a. limited or below average in number or quantity or magnitude or extent; s. slight or limited; especially in degree or intensity or scope
translation_zh: a. 小的, 少的, 小型的, 低微的, 小气的, 细微的；adv. 些微地；n. 狭小部分
example: I live in a small house.

meaning: n. Rhodesian statesman who declared independence of Zimbabwe from Great Britain (born in 1919); n. United States sculptor (1906-1965); n. United States singer noted for her rendition of patriotic songs (1909-1986)
translation_zh: n. 铁匠, 金属品工匠；[机] 锻造工, 上手
example: The smith was important for everyone.

meaning: s. emitting smoke in great volume
translation_zh: n. 抽烟, 冒烟；[医] 烟熏; 吸烟
example: The smoking was important for everyone.

meaning: n. the act of searching visually; s. appearing to be as specified; usually used as combining forms
translation_zh: a. 有…相貌的；有…样子的
example: We must looking this carefully.

meaning: n. limbless scaly elongate reptile; some are venomous; n. a deceitful or treacherous person; n. a tributary of the Columbia River that rises in Wyoming and flows westward; discovered in 1805 by the Lewis and Clark Expedition; n. something long, thin, and flexible that resembles a snake
translation_zh: n. 蛇, 阴险的人；vi. 曲折行进；vt. 迂回, 拉, 急抽
example: Venomous snakes spit and hiss when they are cornered.

meaning: n an important question that is in dispute and must be settled; n one of a series published periodically; n some situation or event that is thought about; n the act of providing an item for general use or for official purposes (usually in quantity); n supplies (as food or clothing or ammunition) issued by the government; n the income or profit arising from such transactions as the sale of land or other property; n a phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon; n the immediate descendants of a person; n the becoming visible; n an opening that permits escape or release; n the act of issuing printed materials; v prepare and issue for public distribution or sale; v circulate or distribute or equip with; v bring out an official document (such as a warrant); v come out of; v make out and issue
translation_zh: n. 议题, 问题；争点；债券（issue的复数）
example: The issues plays an important role.

meaning: s marked by the presence of snow; s covered with snow; s of the white color of snow
translation_zh: a. 多雪的, 雪的, 被雪所覆盖着的, 下雪的
example: The weather in January is often cold and snowy.

meaning: n. a football game in which two teams of 11 players try to kick or head a ball into the opponents' goal
translation_zh: n. 英式足球
example: My favorite sport is soccer.

meaning: n. an upholstered seat for more than one person
translation_zh: n. 沙发
example: I like to relax on the sofa after work.

meaning: n a person who makes use of a thing; someone who uses or employs something; n a person who uses something or someone selfishly or unethically; n a person who takes drugs
translation_zh: n. 使用者；受限用户（user的复数）
example: The users plays an important role.

meaning: v. find the solution to (a problem or question) or understand the meaning of
translation_zh: vt. 解决, 付给, 溶解；vt. 求解；vi. 求解；[计] 求解
example: We need to solve this carefully.

meaning: a. quantifier; used with either mass nouns or plural count nouns to indicate an unspecified number or quantity; s. relatively much but unspecified in amount or extent; s. relatively many but unspecified in number; s. remarkable
translation_zh: pron. 一些, 一部分, 若干；adv. 大约；a. 一些的, 少许的, 某一的
example: I need some sugar.

meaning: n a human being
translation_zh: pron. 有人, 某人
example: There's someone at the door.

meaning: n. Anything unknown, undetermined, or not specifically; designated; a certain indefinite thing; an indeterminate or unknown; event; an unspecified task, work, or thing.; n. A part; a portion, more or less; an indefinite quantity; or degree; a little.; n. A person or thing importance.; adv. In some degree; somewhat; to some extent; at some; distance.
translation_zh: pron. 某事, 某物
example: We stopped for something to eat.

meaning: n. a male human offspring; n. the divine word of God; the second person in the Trinity (incarnate in Jesus)
translation_zh: n. 儿子, 女婿, 子孙；[法] 儿子, 女婿, 养子
example: My son is five years old.

meaning: n. a short musical composition with words; n. a distinctive or characteristic sound; n. the act of singing; n. a very small sum
translation_zh: n. 歌, 曲, 鸣声, 歌唱, 歌曲, 诗歌
example: She sang a beautiful song.

meaning: n. any movable possession (especially articles of clothing)
translation_zh: n. 所有物, 财产, 用具, 用品, 局面, 形势, 情况；[法] 物
example: The things plays an important role.

meaning: r. in the near future
translation_zh: adv. 不久, 早, 快, 宁可
example: I'll be there soon.

meaning: a feeling or expressing regret or sorrow or a sense of loss over something done or undone; s bad; unfortunate; s without merit; s causing dejection
translation_zh: a. 难过的, 悲哀的, 遗憾的
example: I'm sorry for the delay.

meaning: n. liquid food especially of meat or fish or vegetable stock often containing pieces of solid food; n. any composition having a consistency suggestive of soup; n. an unfortunate situation; v. dope (a racehorse)
translation_zh: n. 汤, 马力；vt. 加速, 增加马力
example: I like to eat hot soup on a cold day.

meaning: v. use language; v. make a characteristic or natural sound
translation_zh: vi. 说, 说话, 演说, 发言；vt. 说, 讲, 说出
example: Can you speak louder?

meaning: v. pass time in a specific way; v. pay out; v. spend completely
translation_zh: vt. 花费, 浪费, 度过, 消耗, 消磨；vi. 花费, 用尽
example: I like to spend time with my family.

meaning: n. an active diversion requiring physical exertion and competition; n. the occupation of athletes who compete for pay; n. (Maine colloquial) a temporary summer resident of Maine; n. a person known for the way she (or he) behaves when teased or defeated or subjected to trying circumstances
translation_zh: n. 运动, 游戏, 娱乐, 消遣, 玩笑；a. 运动的, 户外穿戴的；vi. 游戏, 参加体育运动, 戏弄, 产生变种；vt. 炫耀, 使产生变种
example: My favorite sport is basketball.

meaning: n. (military) a secret agent hired by a state to obtain information about its enemies or by a business to obtain industrial secrets from competitors; n. a secret watcher; someone who secretly watches other people; v. watch, observe, or inquire secretly; v. catch sight of; to perceive with the eyes
translation_zh: n. 间谍, 侦探, 侦察；vt. 侦察, 找出, 发现；vi. 做密探, 侦查
example: He was denounced as a foreign spy.

meaning: n. the beginning of anything; n. a turn to be a starter (in a game at the beginning); n. a line indicating the location of the start of a race or a game; n. the advantage gained by beginning early (as in a race)
translation_zh: n. 惊起, 出发, 开端, 起点, 吃惊, 有利条件；vi. 开始, 出发, 启动, 跳起, 吃惊, 出现, 松动, 脱落, 起价, 参赛；vt. 使惊起, 开动, 发动, 启动, 开始, 创办, 提议, 使松动, 使脱落, 起用；[计] 起始
example: Let's start the meeting.

meaning: n. a facility equipped with special equipment and personnel for a particular purpose; n. (nautical) the location to which a ship or fleet is assigned for duty; n. the frequency assigned to a broadcasting station; v. assign to a station
translation_zh: n. 车站, 站, 局, 驻地, 位置, 身分, 地位；vt. 安置, 配置, 驻扎；[计] 站
example: We met at the train station.

meaning: v come into the possession of something concrete or abstract; v enter or assume a certain state or condition; v cause to move; cause to be in a certain position or condition; v receive a specified treatment (abstract); v reach a destination; arrive by movement or progress; v go or come after and bring or take back; v go through (mental or physical states or experiences); v take vengeance on or get even; v achieve a point or goal; v cause to do; cause to act in a specified manner; v succeed in catching or seizing, especially after a chase; v come to have or undergo a change of (physical features and attributes); v be stricken by an illness, fall victim to an illness; v communicate with a place or person; establish communication with, as if by telephone; v give certain properties to something; v move into a desired direction of discourse; v grasp with the mind or develop an understanding of; v attract and fix; v reach with a blow or hit in a particular spot; v reach by calculation; v acquire as a result of some effort or action; v purchase; v perceive by hearing; v suffer from the receipt of; v receive as a retribution or punishment; v leave immediately; used usually in the imperative form; v reach and board; v irritate; v evoke an emotional response; v apprehend and reproduce accurately; v earn or achieve a base by being walked by the pitcher; v overcome or destroy; v be a mystery or bewildering to; v take the first step or steps in carrying out an action; v undergo (as of injuries and illnesses); v make children
translation_zh: get的过去式和过去分词；[化] 谷草转氨酶; 谷氨酸草酰乙酸转氨酶
example: I got a new phone yesterday.

meaning: n. the event of something ending; n. the act of stopping something; n. a brief stay in the course of a journey; n. a spot where something halts or pauses
translation_zh: n. 停止, 车站, 逗留, 填塞, 障碍, (风琴的)音栓；vi. 停止, 被塞住；vt. 塞住, 堵塞, 阻止, 击落, 停止, 终止, 断绝
example: Please stop talking.

meaning: n. a piece of fiction that narrates a chain of related events
translation_zh: n. 故事, 小说, 传奇, 描述, 阅历, 经历, 层
example: Tell me a story.

meaning: n. a thoroughfare (usually including sidewalks) that is lined with buildings; n. the part of a thoroughfare between the sidewalks; the part of the thoroughfare on which vehicles travel; n. the streets of a city viewed as a depressed environment in which there is poverty and crime and prostitution and dereliction; n. a situation offering opportunities
translation_zh: n. 街道, 马路, 街区；a. 街道的
example: The shop is on the main street.

meaning: s rigidly accurate; allowing no deviation from a standard; s (of rules) stringently enforced; a characterized by strictness, severity, or restraint; s incapable of compromise or flexibility; s severe and unremitting in making demands
translation_zh: a. 严厉的, 绝对的, 详尽的, 严格的, 精确的；[法] 严格的, 精确的, 绝对的
example: There are strict guidelines on how the work is to be carried out.

meaning: n. a learner who is enrolled in an educational institution
translation_zh: n. 学生, 研究者, 学者
example: I am a student.

meaning: login
translation_zh: [计] 注册(程序), 登记, 用户注册程序
example: The login plays an important role.

meaning: n an electric railway operating below the surface of the ground (usually in a city); n an underground tunnel or passage enabling pedestrians to cross a road or railway
translation_zh: n. 地铁, 地道；vi. 乘地铁
example: In Boston the subway is known as the "T"; in Washington DC it's the"Metro".

meaning: n. a white crystalline carbohydrate used as a sweetener and preservative; v. sweeten with sugar
translation_zh: n. 糖, 糖块, 甜言蜜语；vt. 加糖于, 使甜蜜, 粉饰, 美化；vi. 制成糖
example: Do you take sugar in your coffee?

meaning: n. an idea that is suggested; n. a proposal offered for acceptance or rejection; n. persuasion formulated as a suggestion; n. the sequential mental process in which one thought leads to another by association
translation_zh: n. 提议, 意见；[医] 暗示
example: I would like to offer a suggestion.

meaning: n a series of steps to be carried out or goals to be accomplished; n a system of projects or services intended to meet a public need; n a radio or television show; n a document stating the aims and principles of a political party; n an announcement of the events that will occur as part of a theatrical or sporting event; n an integrated course of academic studies; n (computer science) a sequence of instructions that a computer can interpret and execute; n a performance (or series of performances) at a public presentation; v arrange a program of or for; v write a computer program
translation_zh: n. 程序, 程序集；所有程式（program的复数）
example: The programs plays an important role.

meaning: n. a quantity of money; n. a quantity obtained by the addition of a group of numbers; n. the final aggregate; n. the whole amount
translation_zh: n. 总数, 总和, 金额, 概要, 顶点；vt. 总计, 概括；vi. 合计；[计] 系统实用程序和维护
example: You will be fined the sum of £200.

meaning: n the verbal act of offering; n something offered (as a proposal or bid); n a usually brief attempt; v make available or accessible, provide or furnish; v present for acceptance or rejection; v agree freely; v put forward for consideration; v offer verbally; v make available for sale; v propose a payment; v produce or introduce on the stage; v present as an act of worship; v mount or put up; v make available; provide; v ask (someone) to marry you; v threaten to do something
translation_zh: n. 提议；出价；求婚；试图（offer的复数）
example: The offers plays an important role.

meaning: n. the warmest season of the year; in the northern hemisphere it extends from the summer solstice to the autumnal equinox; n. the period of finest development, happiness, or beauty; v. spend the summer
translation_zh: n. 夏季, 全盛时期；vi. 避暑, 过夏天；[计] 加法器
example: We go on holiday in the summer.

meaning: n. the star that is the source of light and heat for the planets in the solar system; n. a person considered as a source of warmth or energy or glory etc; n. any star around which a planetary system revolves; v. expose one's body to the sun
translation_zh: n. 太阳, 日, 日光, 阳光；vt. 晒；vi. 晒太阳
example: The sun is shining brightly today.

meaning: n. first day of the week; observed as a day of rest and worship by most Christians; n. United States evangelist (1862-1935)
translation_zh: n. 星期日；a. 星期日的, 业余的；vi. 度星期日
example: She went to a cooking class last Sunday.

meaning: s bright and pleasant; promoting a feeling of cheer
translation_zh: a. 阳光充足的, 乐观的, 快乐的, 像太阳的
example: It's a beautiful sunny day.

meaning: n the rays of the sun; n moderate weather; suitable for outdoor activities; n the quality of being cheerful and dispelling gloom
translation_zh: n. 阳光, 光明, 晴天
example: We enjoyed the warm sunshine on the beach.

meaning: n a mercantile establishment for the retail sale of goods or services; n a supply of something available for future use; n an electronic memory device; n a depository for goods; v keep or lay aside for future use; v find a place for and put away for storage
translation_zh: n. (英)百货商店；a. 贮藏的, 用作贮藏处的, 贮存的
example: The stores plays an important role.

meaning: n. a large self-service grocery store selling groceries and dairy products and household goods
translation_zh: n. 超级市场；[经] 超级市场, 自助售货商店
example: I need to go to the supermarket to buy groceries.

meaning: v. travel through water; v. be dizzy or giddy; v. be covered with or submerged in a liquid; v. move as if gliding through water
translation_zh: n. 游泳, 漂浮, 潮流, 眩晕；vi. 游泳, 游, 漂浮, 浸, 覆盖, 充溢, 大量拥有, 旋转, 眩晕；vt. 游过, 使浮起
example: I love to swim in the ocean during summer.

meaning: n. the act of swimming
translation_zh: n. 游泳, 眩晕
example: Swimming is a good form of exercise.

meaning: swimming pool
translation_zh: n. 游泳池
example: She trained five times a week at her local swimming pool.

meaning: n a close-fitting pullover shirt
translation_zh: n. 圆领汗衫, T恤
example: The t-shirt was important for everyone.

meaning: n. a set of data arranged in rows and columns; n. a piece of furniture having a smooth flat top that is usually supported by one or more vertical legs; n. a piece of furniture with tableware for a meal laid out on it; n. a company of people assembled at a table for a meal or game
translation_zh: n. 桌子, 餐桌, 工作台, 铭文, 表格, 表, 高原, 平地层；vt. 搁置, 嵌合, 制表, 把...列入议事日程；[计] 表格, 模拟运算表
example: Please put the books on the table.

meaning: n. a garment size for a tall person; a. great in vertical dimension; high in stature; s. impressively difficult
translation_zh: a. 高的, 长的, 夸大的；adv. 夸大地
example: He is a very tall man.

meaning: v. travel slowly; v. ride in a taxicab
translation_zh: n. 出租车；vi. 乘出租车；vt. 用出租车送
example: Let's take a taxi to the airport.

meaning: n. a beverage made by steeping tea leaves in water; n. a light midafternoon meal of tea and sandwiches or cakes; n. a tropical evergreen shrub or small tree extensively cultivated in e.g. China and Japan and India; source of tea leaves; n. a reception or party at which tea is served
translation_zh: n. 茶, 茶叶；[医] 茶, 茶剂, 浸剂
example: Would you like a cup of tea?

meaning: n. an English pirate who operated in the Caribbean and off the Atlantic coast of North America (died in 1718); v. impart skills or knowledge to; v. accustom gradually to some action or attitude
translation_zh: vt. 教, 讲授, 教导, 教育；vi. 教书, 教学, 可以教
example: She wants to teach English abroad.

meaning: n. a person whose occupation is teaching; n. a personified abstraction that teaches
translation_zh: n. 教师, 老师, 导师
example: My favorite teacher taught us about history.

meaning: tee-shirt
translation_zh: na. 圆领短袖汗衫；“T-shirt”的变体；[网络] T恤；体恤；T恤衫
example: The tee-shirt was important for everyone.

meaning: n. broadcasting visual images of stationary or moving objects; n. a telecommunication system that transmits images of objects (stationary or moving) between distant points
translation_zh: n. 电视；[电] 电视
example: We watched a movie on television.

meaning: n. a Swiss patriot who lived in the early 14th century and who was renowned for his skill as an archer; according to legend an Austrian governor compelled him to shoot an apple from his son's head with his crossbow (which he did successfully without mishap); v. let something be known; v. narrate or give a detailed account of; v. discern or comprehend
translation_zh: vt. 告诉, 说, 吩咐, 断定, 知道；vi. 讲述, 泄密, 告发, 表明
example: Please tell me your name.

meaning: n the right to buy or sell property at an agreed price; the right is purchased and if it is not exercised by a stated date the money is forfeited; n one of a number of things from which only one can be chosen; n the act of choosing or selecting
translation_zh: n. 选择；期权；选择项（option的复数）
example: The options plays an important role.

meaning: n. place of worship consisting of an edifice for the worship of a deity; n. the flat area on either side of the forehead; n. an edifice devoted to special or exalted purposes
translation_zh: n. 圣堂, 庙宇, 教堂, 礼拜堂, 太阳穴, 鬓角；[医] 颞颥, 颞部
example: He had black hair, greying at the temples.

meaning: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of nine and one; the base of the decimal system; s. being one more than nine
translation_zh: num. 十, 十个
example: There are ten apples in the basket.

meaning: n. a local tax on property (usually used in the plural)
translation_zh: n. 比率；价格；等级（rate的复数形式）
example: The rates plays an important role.

meaning: n. a game played with rackets by two or four players who hit a ball back and forth over a net that divides the court
translation_zh: n. 网球
example: Do you want to play tennis this weekend?

meaning: conj. A particle expressing comparison, used after certain; adjectives and adverbs which express comparison or diversity, as more,; better, other, otherwise, and the like. It is usually followed by the; object compared in the nominative case. Sometimes, however, the object; compared is placed in the objective case, and than is then considered; by some grammarians as a preposition. Sometimes the object is expressed; in a sentence, usually introduced by that; as, I would rather suffer; than that you should want.; adv. Then. See Then.
translation_zh: conj. 比, 除...外；prep. 比
example: I'm older than her.

meaning: v. express gratitude or show appreciation to
translation_zh: n. 谢意, 感谢；vt. 谢谢, 感谢
example: I want to thank you for your help.

meaning: n. an acknowledgment of appreciation; n. with the help of or owing to
translation_zh: n. 感谢, 谢意, 谢忱；interj. 谢谢, 谢谢你
example: Thanks for lending me the money.

meaning: v. i. See Thee.; definite article. A word placed before nouns to limit or; individualize their meaning.; adv. By that; by how much; by so much; on that account; -- used; before comparatives; as, the longer we continue in sin, the more; difficult it is to reform.
translation_zh: art. 那
example: There were three questions. The first two were relatively easy but the third one was hard.

meaning: n. North America and South America and Central America
translation_zh: n. 美洲, 美国
example: The america plays an important role.

meaning: n. a building where theatrical performances or motion-picture shows can be presented
translation_zh: n. 戏院, 电影院, 剧场, 全体观众, 戏剧, 戏剧效果, 阶梯式讲堂, 场所
example: The movie opens Wednesday in theaters across the country.

meaning: pron. & a. The possessive case of the personal pronoun they;; as, their houses; their country.
translation_zh: pron. 他们的
example: Their parties are always fun.

meaning: pron. The objective case of they. See They.
translation_zh: pron. 他们, 她们, 它们
example: Tell them the news.

meaning: n. that time; that moment; s. at a specific prior time; r. subsequently or soon afterward (often used as sentence connectors); r. in that case or as a consequence
translation_zh: adv. 然后, 当时；conj. 然后, 当时；n. 那时
example: First, we eat, then we go home.

meaning: n. a location other than here; that place; r. in or at that place; r. in that matter; r. to or toward that place; away from the speaker
translation_zh: adv. 在那里
example: The book is over there.

meaning: pron. The plural of this. See This.; pl.  of This
translation_zh: pron. 这些
example: The these was important for everyone.

meaning: obj. The plural of he, she, or it. They is never used; adjectively, but always as a pronoun proper, and sometimes refers to; persons without an antecedent expressed.
translation_zh: pron. 他们, 它们
example: They (= the things you are carrying) go on the bottom shelf.

meaning: n the cardinal number that is the sum of one and one or a numeral representing this number; s being one more than one
translation_zh: abbr. 微光（Image Intensification）
example: The ii plays an important role.

meaning: a. not thin; of a specific thickness or of relatively great extent from one surface to the opposite usually in the smallest of the three solid dimensions; s. having component parts closely crowded together; a. relatively dense in consistency; s. (of darkness) very intense
translation_zh: a. 厚的, 粗壮的, 浓的, 迟钝的, 浑浊的, 多雾的, 过分的, 口齿不清的；adv. 厚地, 密地, 浓浓地；n. 最浓处, 最厚处, 最密集处；[计] 暗, 粗线
example: Everything was covered with a thick layer of dust.

meaning: v. lose thickness; become thin or thinner; v. make thin or thinner; a. of relatively small extent from one surface to the opposite or in cross section; a. lacking excess flesh
translation_zh: a. 薄的, 细的, 瘦的, 稀疏的, 稀薄的, 淡的, 弱的, 空洞的；vt. 使变薄, 使变细, 使稀少, 使淡；vi. 变薄, 变细, 变少, 变淡；adv. 薄地, 稀疏地, 微弱地；n. 细小部分
example: Cut the vegetables into thin strips.

meaning: n any specific behavior; n the state of being active; n an organic process that takes place in the body; n (chemistry) the capacity of a substance to take part in a chemical reaction; n a process existing in or produced by nature (rather than by the intent of human beings); n the trait of being active; moving or acting rapidly and energetically
translation_zh: n. （activity复数形式）活动；活动区；活动性
example: The activities plays an important role.

meaning: n. a special situation; n. an action; n. a special abstraction; n. an artifact
translation_zh: n. 事物, 东西, 物, 用品, 事, 事件, 情况, 行为, 特征
example: What is that thing?

meaning: n. an instance of deliberate thinking; v. judge or regard; look upon; judge; v. expect, believe, or suppose; v. use or exercise the mind or one's power of reason in order to make inferences, decisions, or arrive at a solution or judgments
translation_zh: vt. 想, 考虑, 想起, 想像, 打算, 认为；vi. 思考, 料想；n. 想法；a. 思想的
example: I think it's a good idea.

meaning: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of twelve and one; s. being one more than twelve
translation_zh: num. 十三, 十三个
example: There are thirteen students in the class.

meaning: n a young woman; n a youthful female person; n a female human offspring; n a girl or young woman with whom a man is romantically involved; n a friendly informal reference to a grown woman
translation_zh: n. 女孩（girl的复数）
example: The girls plays an important role.

meaning: n. the cardinal number that is the product of ten and three; s. being ten more than twenty
translation_zh: num. 三十, 三十个
example: She got married when she was thirty (years old).

meaning: pron. & a. As a demonstrative pronoun, this denotes something; that is present or near in place or time, or something just mentioned,; or that is just about to be mentioned.; pron. & a. As an adjective, this has the same demonstrative; force as the pronoun, but is followed by a noun; as, this book; this; way to town.
translation_zh: pron. 这, 本；a. 这, 本；adv. 这么
example: I think you'll find these more comfortable than those.

meaning: pron. The plural of that. See That.
translation_zh: pron. 那些
example: Those of you who would like to come with us should sign up now.

meaning: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of one and one and one; s. being one more than two
translation_zh: num. 三, 三个
example: There are only three cookies left.

meaning: n. the fifth day of the week; the fourth working day
translation_zh: n. 星期四
example: We have a meeting every Thursday morning.

meaning: n. a commercial document showing that the holder is entitled to something (as to ride on public transportation or to enter a public entertainment); n. a summons issued to an offender (especially to someone who violates a traffic regulation); n. the appropriate or desirable thing; v. issue a ticket or a fine to as a penalty
translation_zh: n. 票, 券, 车票, 标签, 入场券, 证明书；vt. 加标签于, 为...购票
example: Do you have your train ticket?

meaning: n. a fierce or audacious person; n. large feline of forests in most of Asia having a tawny coat with black stripes; endangered
translation_zh: n. 老虎, 虎, 凶暴的人
example: The tiger is a powerful predator.

meaning: a. depleted of strength or energy
translation_zh: a. 疲累的, 疲乏的, 厌倦的
example: I'm too tired even to think.

meaning: n an event that occurs when something passes from one state or phase to another; n a relational difference between states; especially between states before and after some event; n the action of changing something; n the result of alteration or modification; n the balance of money received when the amount you tender is greater than the amount due; n a thing that is different; n a different or fresh set of clothes; n coins of small denomination regarded collectively; n money received in return for its equivalent in a larger denomination or a different currency; n a difference that is usually pleasant; v cause to change; make different; cause a transformation; v undergo a change; become different in essence; losing one's or its original nature; v become different in some particular way, without permanently losing one's or its former characteristics or essence; v lay aside, abandon, or leave for another; v change clothes; put on different clothes; v exchange or replace with another, usually of the same kind or category; v give to, and receive from, one another; v change from one vehicle or transportation line to another; v become deeper in tone; v remove or replace the coverings of
translation_zh: n. 变化, 改变（change的复数）
example: The changes plays an important role.

meaning: prep. The preposition to primarily indicates approach and arrival,; motion made in the direction of a place or thing and attaining it,; access; and also, motion or tendency without arrival; movement toward;; -- opposed to from.; prep. Hence, it indicates motion, course, or tendency toward a; time, a state or condition, an aim, or anything capable of being; regarded as a limit to a tendency, movement, or action; as, he is going; to a trade; he is rising to wealth and honor.; prep. In a very general way, and with innumerable varieties of; application, to connects transitive verbs with their remoter or; indirect object, and adjectives, nouns, and neuter or passive verbs; with a following noun which limits their action. Its sphere verges upon; that of for, but it contains less the idea of design or appropriation;; as, these remarks were addressed to a large audience; let us keep this; seat to ourselves; a substance sweet to the taste; an event painful to; the mind; duty to God and to our parents; a dislike to spirituous; liquor.; prep. As sign of the infinitive, to had originally the use of last; defined, governing the infinitive as a verbal noun, and connecting it; as indirect object with a preceding verb or adjective; thus, ready to; go, i.e., ready unto going; good to eat, i.e., good for eating; I do my; utmost to lead my life pleasantly. But it has come to be the almost; constant prefix to the infinitive, even in situations where it has no; prepositional meaning, as where the infinitive is direct object or; subject; thus, I love to learn, i.e., I love learning; to die for one's; country is noble, i.e., the dying for one's country. Where the; infinitive denotes the design or purpose, good usage formerly allowed; the prefixing of for to the to; as, what went ye out for see? (Matt.; xi. 8).; prep. In many phrases, and in connection with many other words, to; has a pregnant meaning, or is used elliptically.; prep. Extent; limit; degree of comprehension; inclusion as far as;; as, they met us to the number of three hundred.; prep. Effect; end; consequence; as, the prince was flattered to; his ruin; he engaged in a war to his cost; violent factions exist to; the prejudice of the state.; prep. Apposition; connection; antithesis; opposition; as, they; engaged hand to hand.; prep. Accord; adaptation; as, an occupation to his taste; she has; a husband to her mind.; prep. Comparison; as, three is to nine as nine is to twenty-seven;; it is ten to one that you will offend him.; prep. Addition; union; accumulation.; prep. Accompaniment; as, she sang to his guitar; they danced to; the music of a piano.; prep. Character; condition of being; purpose subserved or office; filled.
translation_zh: prep. 到, 向, 趋于；adv. 向前
example: I walked to the office.

meaning: n. the present time or age; n. the day that includes the present moment (as opposed to yesterday or tomorrow); r. on this day as distinct from yesterday or tomorrow
translation_zh: n. 今天, 当今, 现在；adv. 今天, 当今
example: What are you doing today?

meaning: n a white metallic element that burns with a brilliant light; the fifth most abundant element in the earth's crust; an important component of most plants and animals; n a state in the western United States on the Pacific; the 3rd largest state; known for earthquakes
translation_zh: [医] 钙(20号元素); 阴极, 负极
example: The ca plays an important role.

meaning: n. a room or building equipped with one or more toilets; n. a plumbing fixture for defecation and urination; n. the act of dressing and preparing yourself
translation_zh: n. 厕所, 梳妆；vi. 梳妆, 打扮, 上厕所；vt. 给...梳妆打扮
example: I need to go to the toilet (= use the toilet).

meaning: n. mildly acid red or yellow pulpy fruit eaten as a vegetable; n. native to South America; widely cultivated in many varieties
translation_zh: n. 番茄, 西红柿
example: I like to eat tomatoes in my salad.

meaning: n. the second largest state; located in southwestern United States on the Gulf of Mexico
translation_zh: n. 德克萨斯
example: The texas plays an important role.

meaning: n. the day after today; n. the near future; r. the next day, the day after, following the present day
translation_zh: n. 明天, 未来；adv. 明天, 未来地
example: I will see you tomorrow.

meaning: n the month following September and preceding November
translation_zh: abbr. 十月（October）
example: The oct plays an important role.

meaning: r to a degree exceeding normal or proper limits; r in addition
translation_zh: adv. 也, 非常, 太
example: I want to come too.

meaning: n. hard bonelike structures in the jaws of vertebrates; used for biting and chewing or for attack and defense; n. something resembling the tooth of an animal; n. toothlike structure in invertebrates found in the mouth or alimentary canal or on a shell; n. a means of enforcement
translation_zh: n. 牙齿, 齿状物, 爱好；vt. 装以齿, 将...切成齿状；vi. 啮合
example: My baby is getting a new tooth.

meaning: n. a rectangular piece of absorbent cloth (or paper) for drying or wiping; v. wipe with a towel
translation_zh: n. 手巾, 毛巾；v. 擦干身子
example: Please grab a clean towel from the cupboard.

meaning: n. fire iron consisting of a metal rod with a handle; used to stir a fire; n. any of various card games in which players bet that they hold the highest-ranking hand
translation_zh: n. 戳的人, 拨火棍, 纸牌戏；vt. 烙制
example: The poker plays an important role.

meaning: n. an urban area with a fixed boundary that is smaller than a city; n. the people living in a municipality smaller than a city; n. United States architect who was noted for his design and construction of truss bridges (1784-1844)
translation_zh: n. 城镇, 市, 镇；[法] 城镇, 城市, 闹市
example: We live in a small town.

meaning: n. a nonfunctional replica of something else (frequently used as a modifier); n. a device regarded as providing amusement; v. manipulate manually or in one's mind or imagination
translation_zh: n. 玩具, 小玩艺儿, 小型的东西, 消遣；a. 供玩耍的, 作为玩具的；vi. 玩弄, 戏弄, 调情
example: The child played with his new toy car.

meaning: n. a tall perennial woody plant having a main trunk and branches forming a distinct elevated crown; includes both gymnosperms and angiosperms; n. a figure that branches from a single root; n. English actor and theatrical producer noted for his lavish productions of Shakespeare (1853-1917); v. plant with trees
translation_zh: n. 树, 木料, 树状物；vt. 把...赶上树；[计] 树; DOS外部命令:显示指定磁盘驱动器的目录结构
example: There is a big tree in the garden.

meaning: n (usually in the plural) a garment extending from the waist to the knee or ankle, covering each leg separately; n a garment (or part of a garment) designed for or relating to trousers
translation_zh: pl. 裤子, 长裤
example: Doug was wearing black trousers and a blue shirt.

meaning: n. an automotive vehicle suitable for hauling; v. convey (goods etc.) by truck
translation_zh: n. 卡车, 货车, 对...进行交易, 来往, 实物工资, (供应市场的)蔬菜, 废物, 废话；vt. 对...进行交易, 交往, 以卡车运输；vi. 驾驶卡车, 以物易物
example: The delivery truck arrived early this morning.

meaning: n. proper alignment; the property possessed by something that is in correct or proper alignment; v. make level, square, balanced, or concentric; a. consistent with fact or reality; not false; s. accurately placed or thrown
translation_zh: a. 真实的, 正确的, 忠诚的, 可靠的, 纯粹的, 正式的；n. 真实, 准确；adv. 真实地, 准确地
example: Is that story true?

meaning: n. conduit consisting of a long hollow object (usually cylindrical) used to hold and conduct objects or liquids or gases; n. electronic device consisting of a system of electrodes arranged in an evacuated glass or metal envelope; n. (anatomy) any hollow cylindrical body structure; v. provide with a tube or insert a tube into
translation_zh: n. 管, 软管, 隧道；vt. 把...装管, 使通过管子；[计] 管子
example: He had to be fed through a feeding tube for several months.

meaning: n. the third day of the week; the second working day
translation_zh: n. 星期二
example: We have a meeting on Tuesday.

meaning: n. the act of changing or reversing the direction of the course; n. (game) the activity of doing something in an agreed succession; n. an unforeseen development; n. the act of turning away or in the opposite direction
translation_zh: n. 转弯, 转动, 旋转, 翻转, 一圈, 顺次, 改动, 变化, 性格, 特色, 形状, 转折；vt. 使旋转, 转弯, 转动, 使转向, 驱赶, 阻挡, 兑换, 改写, 使作对, 绕过, 使流通；vi. 转动, 转弯, 转向, 翻转, 回转, 改变, 转身, 变成, 变质, 晕眩, 易脱手
example: Turn left at the next corner.

meaning: n broadcasting visual images of stationary or moving objects; n an electronic device that receives television signals and displays them on a screen
translation_zh: 电视；[计] 电视, 转移向量
example: I like to watch TV in the evenings.

meaning: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of eleven and one; s. denoting a quantity consisting of 12 items or units
translation_zh: num. 十二, 十二个
example: There are only twelve of these rare animals left.

meaning: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of nineteen and one; s. denoting a quantity consisting of 20 items or units
translation_zh: num. 二十, 二十个
example: She's twenty years old.

meaning: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of one and one or a numeral representing this number; s. being one more than one
translation_zh: num. 二, 二个
example: I have two cats.

meaning: a. displeasing to the senses
translation_zh: a. 丑陋的, 邪恶的, 险恶的, 不祥的；n. 丑陋的人(或物)
example: The witch was hideously ugly.

meaning: n. a lightweight handheld collapsible canopy; n. a formation of military planes maintained over ground operations or targets; n. having the function of uniting a group of similar things; s. covering or applying simultaneously to a number of similar items or elements or groups
translation_zh: n. 伞, 雨伞, 保护伞；a. 伞的, 包罗万象的；vt. 用伞遮掩
example: I put up my umbrella.

meaning: n the month following October and preceding December
translation_zh: abbr. 十一月（November）
example: The meeting is scheduled for Nov 15th.

meaning: n. the brother of your father or mother; the husband of your aunt; n. a source of help and advice and encouragement
translation_zh: n. 叔父, 伯父, 姨丈
example: My uncle lives in New York.

meaning: s. lower in rank, power, or authority; r. down to defeat, death, or ruin; r. through a range downward; r. into unconsciousness
translation_zh: prep. 在...之下, 低于；a. 下面的, 从属的；adv. 在下面
example: She placed the ladder under (= just lower than) the window.

meaning: n North American republic containing 50 states - 48 conterminous states in North America plus Alaska in northwest North America and the Hawaiian Islands in the Pacific Ocean; achieved independence in 1776; n a base containing nitrogen that is found in RNA (but not in DNA) and derived from pyrimidine; pairs with adenine; n a heavy toxic silvery-white radioactive metallic element; occurs in many isotopes; used for nuclear fuels and nuclear weapons; n the 21st letter of the Roman alphabet
translation_zh: pron. 我们；[经] 美国
example: She gave us a picture as a wedding present.

meaning: n any number of entities (members) considered as a unit; n (chemistry) two or more atoms bound together as a single unit and forming part of a molecule; n a set that is closed, associative, has an identity element and every element has an inverse; v arrange into a group or groups; v form a group or group together
translation_zh: n. 群组, 组；用户组；团体（group的复数形式）
example: The groups plays an important role.

meaning: n. leisure time away from work devoted to rest or pleasure; n. the act of making something legally void; v. spend or take a vacation
translation_zh: n. 假期, 休假；[法] 假期, 停审期, 休庭期
example: They're on vacation in Hawaii right now.

meaning: n a silvery ductile metallic element found primarily in bauxite; n a state in the southeastern United States on the Gulf of Mexico; one of the Confederate states during the American Civil War
translation_zh: [计] 算法语言, 字母, 汇编语言；[医] 铝(13号元素)
example: The al plays an important role.

meaning: n. an open jar of glass or porcelain used as an ornament or to hold flowers
translation_zh: n. 花瓶, 瓶
example: Please put this vase of flowers on the table.

meaning: n. edible seeds or roots or stems or leaves or bulbs or tubers or nonsweet fruits of any of numerous herbaceous plant; n. any of various herbaceous plants cultivated for an edible part such as the fruit or the root of the beet or the leaf of spinach or the seeds of bean plants or the flower buds of broccoli or cauliflower
translation_zh: n. 蔬菜, 植物, 无精打采之人；a. 蔬菜的, 植物的
example: Eating fresh vegetables is good for your health.

meaning: n. the act of going to see some person or place or thing for a short time; n. a meeting arranged by the visitor to see someone (such as a doctor or lawyer) for treatment or advice; n. the act of visiting in an official capacity (as for an inspection); n. the act of going to see some person in a professional capacity
translation_zh: n. 拜访, 访问, 游览, 视察；vt. 拜访, 访问, 参观, 视察, 降临；vi. 访问, 参观, 闲谈
example: We paid a visit to our grandparents.

meaning: n a set of related records (either written or electronic) kept together; n a line of persons or things ranged one behind the other; n office furniture consisting of a container for keeping papers in order; n a steel hand tool with small sharp teeth on some or all of its surfaces; used for smoothing wood or metal; v record in a public office or in a court of law; v smooth with a file; v proceed in line; v file a formal charge against; v place in a container for keeping records
translation_zh: n. 文件；文档（file的复数）
example: The files plays an important role.

meaning: n. a game in which two teams hit an inflated ball over a high net using their hands; n. an inflated ball used in playing volleyball
translation_zh: n. 排球
example: In physical education, we play volleyball or do exercises.

meaning: n. a person whose occupation is to serve at table (as in a restaurant); n. a person who waits or awaits
translation_zh: n. 侍者
example: The waiter brought us the menu.

meaning: n. a woman waiter
translation_zh: n. 女侍者, 女服务员
example: I'll ask the waitress for the bill.

meaning: n. the act of traveling by foot; n. manner of walking; n. the act of walking somewhere; n. a path set aside for walking
translation_zh: n. 走, 散步, 步行, 行走的路程, 竞走, 散步场所；vi. 走路, 步行, 处世；vt. 走过, 遛, 使走, 护送...走
example: Let's go for a walk in the park.

meaning: n. an architectural partition with a height and length greater than its thickness; used to divide or enclose an area or to support another structure; n. anything that suggests a wall in structure or function or effect; n. (anatomy) a layer (a lining or membrane) that encloses a structure; n. a difficult or awkward situation
translation_zh: n. 墙, 墙壁, 垣, 内壁, 分界物, 屏障；a. 墙的；vt. 给...建墙, 禁闭, 用墙围住；[计] 背景墙
example: The room has four walls.

meaning: n a state in northwestern United States on the Pacific; v have the quality of being; (copula, used with an adjective or a predicate noun); v be identical to; be someone or something; v occupy a certain position or area; be somewhere; v have an existence, be extant; v happen, occur, take place; this was during the visit to my parents' house"; v be identical or equivalent to; v form or compose; v work in a specific place, with a specific subject, or in a specific function; v represent, as of a character on stage; v spend or use time; v have life, be alive; v to remain unmolested, undisturbed, or uninterrupted -- used only in infinitive form; v be priced at
translation_zh: be的过去式
example: The was was important for everyone.

meaning: n. a communist nation that covers a vast territory in eastern Asia; the most populous country in the world; n. high quality porcelain originally made only in China
translation_zh: n. 中国, 瓷器；a. 中国的
example: The china plays an important role.

meaning: n. a thin coat of water-base paint; n. the work of cleansing (usually with soap and water); n. the dry bed of an intermittent stream (as at the bottom of a canyon); n. a watercolor made by applying a series of monochrome washes one over the other
translation_zh: n. 洗, 洗涤, 冲洗, 洗的衣服, 冲积物, 洼地；vt. 洗, 洗涤, 洗清, 用水冲洗, 流过, 弄湿, 粉刷, 镀金属薄层于；vi. 洗涤, 洗澡, 被冲蚀, 漂浮
example: Please wash your hands before dinner.

meaning: n. (usually plural) the components needed for making or doing something
translation_zh: n. 制造, (手工)制造业, 制作, 形成, 发展, 要素, 内在因素, 赚头, 制造物
example: We must making this carefully.

meaning: n. a small portable timepiece; n. a period of time (4 or 2 hours) during which some of a ship's crew are on duty; n. a purposeful surveillance to guard or observe; n. the period during which someone (especially a guard) is on duty
translation_zh: n. 观察, 手表, 看守, 守护, 监视, 值班人；vt. 看, 注视, 照顾, 看守, 守护, 监视；vi. 观看, 注视, 守侯
example: Let's watch a movie tonight.

meaning: n. the condition of things generally; n. a course of conduct; n. any artifact consisting of a road or path affording passage from one place to another; n. a journey or passage
translation_zh: n. 路, 路线, 路途, 方法, 道路, 情形, 规模, 习惯, 行业, 方面；adv. 远远地, 非常
example: Which way is the station?

meaning: n a condition requiring relief; n anything that is necessary but lacking; n the psychological feature that arouses an organism to action toward a desired goal; the reason for the action; that which gives purpose and direction to behavior; n a state of extreme poverty or destitution; v require as useful, just, or proper; v have need of; v have or feel a need for; r in such a manner as could not be otherwise
translation_zh: adv. （只与must连用）必须地
example: The needs plays an important role.

meaning: pl.  of I; obj. The plural nominative case of the pronoun of the first; person; the word with which a person in speaking or writing denotes a; number or company of which he is one, as the subject of an action; expressed by a verb.
translation_zh: pron. 我们
example: We've moved to Atlanta.

meaning: n. impairment resulting from long use; n. the act of having on your person as a covering or adornment; v. be dressed in; v. have on one's person
translation_zh: n. 穿着, 戴, 使用, 耗损, 服装, 耐久性；vt. 穿着, 戴, 留(须、发等), 呈现, 磨损, 磨成, 耗损, 使疲乏, 消磨；vi. 磨损, 变旧, 耐久, 渐变, 渐渐消失
example: She likes to wear colorful dresses.

meaning: n. the atmospheric conditions that comprise the state of the atmosphere in terms of temperature and wind and clouds and precipitation; v. face and withstand with courage; v. cause to slope; v. sail to the windward of
translation_zh: n. 天气, 气象, 处境；a. 迎风的；vt. 使受风吹雨打, 侵蚀, 使风化, 经受住；vi. 风化, 受侵蚀, 经受风雨
example: The weather is beautiful today.

meaning: n. the fourth day of the week; the third working day
translation_zh: n. 星期三
example: She started work last Wednesday.

meaning: n. any period of seven consecutive days; n. a period of seven consecutive days starting on Sunday
translation_zh: n. 星期, 周
example: I will see you next week.

meaning: n. a time period usually extending from Friday night through Sunday; more loosely defined as any period of successive days including one and only one Sunday; v. spend the weekend
translation_zh: n. 周末, 周末休假
example: What are your plans for the weekend.

meaning: n. a deep hole or shaft dug or drilled to obtain water or oil or gas or brine; n. a cavity or vessel used to contain liquid; n. an abundant source; n. an open shaft through the floors of a building (as for a stairway)
translation_zh: n. 井, 泉水, 源泉, 好；v. 涌出；a. 健康的, 良好的, 适宜的, 恰当的；adv. 很好地, 适当地, 好意地, 很, 完全；interj. 好啦
example: She sings very well.

meaning: v have the quality of being; (copula, used with an adjective or a predicate noun); v be identical to; be someone or something; v occupy a certain position or area; be somewhere; v have an existence, be extant; v happen, occur, take place; this was during the visit to my parents' house"; v be identical or equivalent to; v form or compose; v work in a specific place, with a specific subject, or in a specific function; v represent, as of a character on stage; v spend or use time; v have life, be alive; v to remain unmolested, undisturbed, or uninterrupted -- used only in infinitive form; v be priced at
translation_zh: be的过去式
example: We're here, Diane.

meaning: n a particular geographical region of indefinite boundary (usually serving some special purpose or distinguished by its people or culture or geography); n a subject of study; n a part of an animal that has a special function or is supplied by a given artery or nerve; n a particular environment or walk of life; n a part of a structure having some specific characteristic or function; n the extent of a 2-dimensional surface enclosed within a boundary
translation_zh: n. 区域, 领域；面积（area的复数形式）
example: The areas plays an important role.

meaning: pron., a., & adv. As an interrogative pronoun, used in asking; questions regarding either persons or things; as, what is this? what; did you say? what poem is this? what child is lost?; pron., a., & adv. As an exclamatory word: -- (a) Used absolutely; or independently; -- often with a question following.; pron., a., & adv. Used adjectively, meaning how remarkable, or; how great; as, what folly! what eloquence! what courage!; pron., a., & adv. Sometimes prefixed to adjectives in an; adverbial sense, as nearly equivalent to how; as, what happy boys!; pron., a., & adv. As a relative pronoun; pron., a., & adv. Used substantively with the antecedent; suppressed, equivalent to that which, or those [persons] who, or those; [things] which; -- called a compound relative.; pron., a., & adv. Used adjectively, equivalent to the . . .; which; the sort or kind of . . . which; rarely, the . . . on, or at,; which.; pron., a., & adv. Used adverbially in a sense corresponding to; the adjectival use; as, he picked what good fruit he saw.; pron., a., & adv. Whatever; whatsoever; what thing soever; --; used indefinitely.; pron., a., & adv. Used adverbially, in part; partly; somewhat;; -- with a following preposition, especially, with, and commonly with; repetition.; n. Something; thing; stuff.; interrog. adv. Why? For what purpose? On what account?
translation_zh: pron. 什么；interj. 怎么, 多么；a. 什么的；adv. 到什么程度
example: What you need is a good meal.

meaning: adv. At what time; -- used interrogatively.; adv. At what time; at, during, or after the time that; at or; just after, the moment that; -- used relatively.; adv. While; whereas; although; -- used in the manner of a; conjunction to introduce a dependent adverbial sentence or clause,; having a causal, conditional, or adversative relation to the principal; proposition; as, he chose to turn highwayman when he might have; continued an honest man; he removed the tree when it was the best in; the grounds.; adv. Which time; then; -- used elliptically as a noun.
translation_zh: conj. 当...的时候；adv. 何时, 什么时候；pron. 什么时侯；n. 时间
example: When do you want to meet?

meaning: pron. & conj. Whether.; adv. At or in what place; hence, in what situation, position,; or circumstances; -- used interrogatively.; adv. At or in which place; at the place in which; hence, in the; case or instance in which; -- used relatively.; adv. To what or which place; hence, to what goal, result, or; issue; whither; -- used interrogatively and relatively; as, where are; you going?; conj. Whereas.; n. Place; situation.
translation_zh: adv. 在哪里；pron. 哪里；n. 地点
example: Where do you live?

meaning: a. Of what sort or kind; what; what a; who.; a.
