A interrogative pronoun, used both substantively and; adjectively, and in direct and indirect questions, to ask for, or refer; to, an individual person or thing among several of a class; as, which; man is it? which woman was it? which is the house? he asked which route; he should take; which is best, to live or to die? See the Note under; What, pron., 1.; pron. A relative pronoun, used esp. in referring to an; antecedent noun or clause, but sometimes with reference to what is; specified or implied in a sentence, or to a following noun or clause; (generally involving a reference, however, to something which has; preceded). It is used in all numbers and genders, and was formerly used; of persons.; pron. A compound relative or indefinite pronoun, standing for; any one which, whichever, that which, those which, the . . . which, and; the like; as, take which you will.
translation_zh: pron. 哪一个, 那一个
example: Houses which overlook the lake cost more.

meaning: n. a member of the Caucasoid race; n. the quality or state of the achromatic color of greatest lightness (bearing the least resemblance to black); n. United States jurist appointed chief justice of the United States Supreme Court in 1910 by President Taft; noted for his work on antitrust legislation (1845-1921); n. Australian writer (1912-1990)
translation_zh: n. 白色, 洁白, 眼白, 白种人, 蛋白；a. 白色的, 纯洁的, 白种的, 苍白的, 空白的, 幸运的
example: The snow is white.

meaning: n a United Nations agency to coordinate international health activities and to help governments improve health services
translation_zh: pron. 谁
example: I wonder who that letter was from.

meaning: n a game played with playing cards; n one of a set of small pieces of stiff paper marked in various ways and used for playing games or for telling fortunes; n a card certifying the identity of the bearer; n a rectangular piece of stiff paper used to send messages (may have printed greetings or pictures); n thin cardboard, usually rectangular; n a witty amusing person who makes jokes; n a sign posted in a public place as an advertisement; n a printed or written greeting that is left to indicate that you have visited; n (golf) a record of scores (as in golf); n a list of dishes available at a restaurant; n (baseball) a list of batters in the order in which they will bat; n a printed circuit that can be inserted into expansion slots in a computer to increase the computer's capabilities; v separate the fibers of; v ask someone for identification to determine whether he or she is old enough to consume liquor
translation_zh: n. (playing cards)(正式)一副纸牌, 一副扑克牌, 纸牌游戏, 打扑克
example: The cards plays an important role.

meaning: pron. The possessive case of who or which. See Who, and Which.
translation_zh: pron. 谁的
example: I wonder whose this is.

meaning: n a state of difficulty that needs to be resolved; n a question raised for consideration or solution; n a source of difficulty
translation_zh: n. 问题；难题（problem的复数）
example: The problems plays an important role.

meaning: n. the cause or intention underlying an action or situation, especially in the phrase `the whys and wherefores'
translation_zh: adv. 为什么；n. 原因, 理由
example: Why are you late.

meaning: n. the capital and largest city of England; located on the Thames in southeastern England; financial and industrial and cultural center; n. United States writer of novels based on experiences in the Klondike gold rush (1876-1916)
translation_zh: n. 伦敦
example: The london plays an important role.

meaning: n. a married woman; a man's partner in marriage
translation_zh: n. 妻子, 太太, 夫人；[法] 妻子, 已婚妇女
example: My wife is a doctor.

meaning: n. the capital of the United States in the District of Columbia and a tourist mecca; George Washington commissioned Charles L'Enfant to lay out the city in 1791; n. a state in northwestern United States on the Pacific; n. 1st President of the United States; commander-in-chief of the Continental Army during the American Revolution (1732-1799)
translation_zh: n. 华盛顿
example: The washington plays an important role.

meaning: n. a framework of wood or metal that contains a glass windowpane and is built into a wall or roof to admit light or air; n. a transparent opening in a vehicle that allow vision out of the sides or back; usually is capable of being opened; n. a transparent panel (as of an envelope) inserted in an otherwise opaque material; n. an opening that resembles a window in appearance or function
translation_zh: n. 窗户, 窗子, 窗口；vt. 给...开窗；[计] 窗口
example: Please close the window, it's cold.

meaning: n. the coldest season of the year; in the northern hemisphere it extends from the winter solstice to the vernal equinox; v. spend the winter
translation_zh: n. 冬季, 萧条期, 衰退期；a. 冬天的；vt. 使度过冬天；vi. 过冬
example: Winter is my favorite season.

meaning: n a unit of radiation exposure; the dose of ionizing radiation that will produce 1 electrostatic unit of electricity in 1 cc of dry air; n (physics) the universal constant in the gas equation: pressure times volume = R times temperature; equal to 8.3143 joules per kelvin per mole; n the 18th letter of the Roman alphabet; n the length of a line segment between the center and circumference of a circle or sphere
translation_zh: abbr. 和的平方根（root-sum square）；[拉]英国皇家学会会员（Regiae Societatis Socius, 等于fellow of the royal society）
example: The rss plays an important role.

meaning: n. See Withe.; prep. With denotes or expresses some situation or relation of; nearness, proximity, association, connection, or the like.; prep. To denote a close or direct relation of opposition or; hostility; -- equivalent to against.; prep. To denote association in respect of situation or; environment; hence, among; in the company of.; prep. To denote a connection of friendship, support, alliance,; assistance, countenance, etc.; hence, on the side of.; prep. To denote the accomplishment of cause, means, instrument,; etc; -- sometimes equivalent to by.; prep. To denote association in thought, as for comparison or; contrast.; prep. To denote simultaneous happening, or immediate succession; or consequence.; prep. To denote having as a possession or an appendage; as, the; firmament with its stars; a bride with a large fortune.
translation_zh: prep. 和...在一起, 以, 由于
example: She lives with her parents.

meaning: n. an adult female person (as opposed to a man); n. a female person who plays a significant role (wife or mistress or girlfriend) in the life of a particular man
translation_zh: n. 女人, 妇女, 女仆；a. 女用的, 女性的, 妇女的；vt. 贬称...为女人, 使成女人腔

meaning: n. the destruction of an enemy plane or ship or tank or missile; v. cause to die; put to death, usually intentionally or knowingly; v. thwart the passage of; v. be fatal

example: 我们需要逐步kill这个方案。

meaning: n. a person who rules or guides or inspires others
translation_zh: n. 领导者, 社论, 指挥, 领袖, 领唱者, 前导字符；[计] 前导字符
example: 这个领导者为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. (physics) electromagnetic radiation that can produce a visual sensation; n. any device serving as a source of illumination; n. a particular perspective or aspect of a situation; n. an illuminated area
translation_zh: n. 光, 光亮, 灯, 日光, 发光体, 光源, 杰出人物, 火花, 眼光；a. 轻的, 少量的, 轻微的, 轻快的, 轻浮的, 明亮的, 淡色的, 容易的；vt. 点燃, 照亮；vi. 点着, 变亮, 突降, 偶然碰到；adv. 轻地
example: Turn on the light, please.

meaning: n. a small amount or duration; a. (quantifier used with mass nouns) small in quantity or degree; not much or almost none or (with `a') at least some; s. (of children and animals) young, immature; s. (of a voice) faint
translation_zh: n. 一点点, 少许, 一会儿, 短时间；a. 小的, 很少的, 幼小的, 琐碎的, 短暂的, 矮小的；adv. 很少, 稍微, 完全不
example: I have a little dog.

meaning: n. people who are still living; a. pertaining to living persons; s. true to life; lifelike; s. (informal) absolute
translation_zh: n. 生活, 生计, 生存；a. 活的, 逼真的, 现存的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常生活的解释。

meaning: n. the bags of letters and packages that are transported by the postal service; n. the system whereby messages are transmitted via the post office; n. a conveyance that transports the letters and packages that are conveyed by the postal system; n. any particular collection of letters or packages that is delivered
translation_zh: n. 邮件, 邮政, 邮递, 盔甲；vt. 邮寄, 给...穿盔甲；[计] 邮件
example: I received a lot of mail today.

meaning: n. an adult person who is male (as opposed to a woman); n. the generic use of the word to refer to any human being; n. a male subordinate; n. an adult male person who has a manly character (virile and courageous competent)
translation_zh: n. 男人, 人类, 人；vt. 为...配备人手, 操纵, 使振奋；[计] 城域网, 手册
example: The man walked quickly.

meaning: n. the month following February and preceding April; n. the act of marching; walking with regular steps (especially in a procession of some kind); n. a steady advance; n. a procession of people walking together
translation_zh: n. 三月, 进行, 行军, 步伐, 长途跋涉, 进行曲, 边界；vi. 进军, 前进, 交界；vt. 使行军, 使行进
example: 这个行走为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. that which is responsible for one's thoughts and feelings; the seat of the faculty of reason; n. recall or remembrance; n. attention; n. your intention; what you intend to do
translation_zh: n. 思想, 愿望, 智力, 记忆, 心理, 情绪, 理智, 主意, 心意；vi. 介意, 注意, 留心；vt. 注意, 留意, 专心于, 照看, 介意
example: 这个心为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a language unit by which a person or thing is known; n. a person's reputation; n. family based on male descent; n. a well-known or notable person
translation_zh: n. 名字, 名称, 姓名, 名义, 名誉, 文件名；vt. 命名, 称呼, 任命, 提名, 列举；a. 姓名的, 据以取名的；[计] 名称, 文件名, 姓名
example: My name is John.

meaning: n. a condition requiring relief; n. anything that is necessary but lacking; v. have or feel a need for
translation_zh: n. 需要, 必须, 缺乏；vt. 需要, 必需；vi. 贫困, 有必要；aux. 需要
example: I need help.

meaning: n. the momentary present; r. in the historical present; at this point in the narration of a series of past events; r. used to preface a command or reproof or request; r. at the present moment
translation_zh: adv. 现在, 刚才, 目前；n. 现在；a. 现在的；conj. 由于
example: I need to leave now.

meaning: n. one skilled in caring for young children or the sick (usually under the supervision of a physician); v. try to cure by special care of treatment, of an illness or injury; v. serve as a nurse; care for sick or handicapped people; v. treat carefully
translation_zh: n. 护士, 保姆, 奶妈；vt. 看护, 照顾, 培养；vi. 喂奶, 看护病人
example: The nurse checked the patient's temperature.

meaning: n. a person authorized to serve in a position of authority on a vessel; v. direct or command as an officer
translation_zh: n. 军官, 主管, 官员, 公务员；vt. 指挥
example: 这个军官为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. (often plural) a command given by a superior (e.g., a military or law enforcement officer) that must be obeyed; n. a degree in a continuum of size or quantity; n. established customary state (especially of society); n. a commercial document used to request someone to supply something in return for payment and providing specifications and quantities
translation_zh: n. 次序, 规则, 命令；vi. 命令, 定货；vt. 整理, 命令, 定购；n. 顺序, 阶数；[计] 顺序, 阶数
example: 这个命令为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. have ownership or possession of; s. belonging to or on behalf of a specified person (especially yourself); preceded by a possessive
translation_zh: n. 自己的；a. 自己的, 嫡亲的, 同胞的；vt. 拥有, 支配, 自认, 承认, 顺从于；vi. 承认, 供认
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常属于自己的自己做的的解释。

meaning: n. a warrant granting release from punishment for an offense; v. grant a pardon to
translation_zh: n. 原谅, 赦免；vt. 宽恕, 原谅
example: 这个赦免为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a person who is a member of a partnership; v. provide with a partner; v. act as a partner
translation_zh: n. 合伙人, 股东, 伙伴, 伴侣；vt. 与...合伙, 组成一对；vi. 做伙伴, 当助手
example: 这个合伙人为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the state prevailing during the absence of war; n. harmonious relations; freedom from disputes; n. the absence of mental stress or anxiety; n. the general security of public places
translation_zh: n. 和平, 和约, 治安, 和睦, 安宁, 静寂；vi. 安静下来, 不作声
example: 这个和平为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the interval taken to complete one cycle of a regularly repeating phenomenon; n. (ice hockey) one of three divisions into which play is divided in hockey games; n. a unit of geological time during which a system of rocks formed; n. the end or completion of something
translation_zh: n. 时期, 节段, 节, 句点, 学时, 周期；a. 当时特有的, 过去某段时期的；interj. 就是这话, 就是这么回事
example: 这个时期为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a visual representation (of an object or scene or person or abstraction) produced on a surface; n. a situation treated as an observable object; n. illustrations used to decorate or explain a text; n. a typical example of some state or quality
translation_zh: n. 图画, 照片, 景色, 美丽如画的人(或物), 化身, 生动的描述, 想像, 形象思维；vt. 画, 拍摄, 用图说明, 描写, 想像；[计] 图象; 形象; 字形
example: I took a picture of the sunset.

meaning: n. any area set aside for a particular purpose; n. an abstract mental location; n. a general vicinity; n. a particular situation
translation_zh: n. 地方, 地点, 位置, 住所, 座位, 地位, 处境, 特权, 空间, 余地, 职务, 位；vt. 放置, 寄予, 认出, 评定, 任命；vi. 名次列前
example: This is a nice place.

meaning: n. (mathematics) an unbounded two-dimensional shape; n. a level of existence or development; n. a power tool for smoothing or shaping wood; n. a carpenter's hand tool with an adjustable blade for smoothing or shaping wood
translation_zh: n. 平面, 扁平物, 机翼, 飞机, 水准, 地位；a. 平的, 平面的；vt. 将...刨平, 刨平, 掠过水面；vi. 翱翔, 乘飞机旅行, 刨掉
example: We took a plane to travel across the country.

meaning: v. give pleasure to or be pleasing to; v. be the will of or have the will (to); v. give satisfaction; r. used in polite request
translation_zh: adv. 请；vt. 使高兴, 合...的心意, 取悦；vi. 使人满意, 讨好, 愿意, 敬请
example: 他请地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a fundamental feeling that is hard to define but that people desire to experience; n. a formal expression; n. an activity that affords enjoyment; n. sexual gratification
translation_zh: n. 快乐, 愉快, 令人高兴的事, 娱乐, 希望；v. (使)高兴
example: 这个快乐为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a sweet drink containing carbonated water and flavoring; n. a sharp explosive sound as from a gunshot or drawing a cork; v. hit a pop-fly; v. make a sharp explosive noise
translation_zh: n. 砰然声, 枪击, 含气饮料, 流行音乐, 通俗艺术；a. 流行的, 热门的, 通俗的；vt. 使发出爆裂声, 开枪打, 突然伸出；vi. 发出爆裂声, 射击, 突然出现, 瞪大；adv. 突然, 砰地；[计] 出现点, 邮局协议
example: 这个发出爆裂声突然离去为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the position where someone (as a guard or sentry) stands or is assigned to stand; n. an upright consisting of a piece of timber or metal fixed firmly in an upright position; n. United States aviator who in 1933 made the first solo flight around the world (1899-1935); n. United States female author who wrote a book and a syndicated newspaper column on etiquette (1872-1960)
translation_zh: n. 柱, 杆, 准星, 邮件, 邮政, 标竿, 职位, 岗位, 哨所, 兵营；vt. 张帖, 邮递, 公布, 登入帐, 使熟悉, 布置；vi. 快速行进；adv. 急速地；[计] 记入; 登记, 上电自检
example: 这个柱为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a male member of a royal family other than the sovereign (especially the son of a sovereign)
translation_zh: n. 王子, 亲王, 国君, 贵族, 诸侯, 有权势的大人物
example: 这个王子为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an instance of questioning; n. the subject matter at issue; n. a sentence of inquiry that asks for a reply; n. an informal reference to a marriage proposal
translation_zh: n. 问题, 询问；v. 询问, 审问, 怀疑；[计] 询问
example: Do you have any questions?

meaning: n. something that results; v. issue or terminate (in a specified way, state, etc.); end; v. come about or follow as a consequence
translation_zh: n. 结果, 成绩, 答案；vi. 产生, 结果, 致使；[计] 结果
example: 这个结果为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an essay or article that gives a critical evaluation (as of a book or play); n. (accounting) a service (less exhaustive than an audit) that provides some assurance to interested parties as to the reliability of financial data; n. a periodical that publishes critical essays on current affairs or literature or art; n. (law) a judicial reexamination of the proceedings of a court (especially by an appellate court)
translation_zh: n. 检讨, 复习, 回顾, 检阅, 评论；vt. 温习, 检讨, 评论, 再检察, 复审；vi. 复习功课, 写评论
example: 这个回顾为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. normal or customary activity of a person in a particular social setting
translation_zh: n. 角色, 职责, 任务；[医] 作用, 功用
example: 这个角色为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an area within a building enclosed by walls and floor and ceiling; n. space for movement; n. opportunity for; n. the people who are present in a room
translation_zh: n. 房间, 空位, 场所；vi. 住宿, 居住；vt. 留宿
example: My room is on the second floor.

meaning: n. hand tool having a toothed blade for cutting; v. cut with a saw
translation_zh: n. 锯子, 谚语；vt. 锯, 锯开, 来回移动；vi. 拉锯, 移动；see的过去式
example: 这个锯子为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a person with advanced knowledge of one or more sciences
translation_zh: n. 科学家；[医] 科学家
example: 这个科学家为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. 1/60 of a minute; the basic unit of time adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites; n. following the first in an ordering or series; n. a 60th part of a minute of arc; n. the official attendant of a contestant in a duel or boxing match
translation_zh: n. 秒, 瞬间, 第二名, 支持者, 助手；a. 第二的, 其次的, 次要的, 附加的, 辅助的；num. 第二；vt. 当...助手, 支持
example: This is my second cup of coffee.

meaning: n. a self-contained part of a larger composition (written or musical); n. a very thin slice (of tissue or mineral or other substance) for examination under a microscope; n. a distinct region or subdivision of a territorial or political area or community or group of people; n. one of several parts or pieces that fit with others to constitute a whole object
translation_zh: n. 区段, 部分, 区域, 节, 截面, 处, 科, 区, 扇区；vt. 把...分段, 把...切片；vi. 被切成片；[计] 扇区
example: 这个章节为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. your consciousness of your own identity; n. a person considered as a unique individual; a. (used as a combining form) relating to--of or by or to or from or for--the self
translation_zh: n. 自己, 自我, 本性, 本质, 私心, 本人；vt. 使近亲繁殖, 使自花授精；vi. 自花授精；a. 同一的
example: 这个自己为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a string of words satisfying the grammatical rules of a language; v. pronounce a sentence on (somebody) in a court of law
translation_zh: n. 句子, 命题, 宣判；vt. 宣判, 判决；[计] 句子
example: 这个宣判为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. move or cause to move back and forth; v. move with or as if with a tremor; v. undermine or cause to waver; v. get rid of
translation_zh: n. 摇动, 震动；vt. 摇动, 动摇, 使震动, 挥舞；vi. 震动, 发抖, 动摇
example: 这个摇动为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a vessel that carries passengers or freight; v. hire for work on a ship; v. travel by ship; v. place on board a ship
translation_zh: n. 船, 舰；vt. 以船运送, 装船, 运送；vi. 上船, 乘船
example: 这个运送为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a mercantile establishment for the retail sale of goods or services; v. do one's shopping; v. shop around; not necessarily buying
translation_zh: n. 商店, 工厂, 车间；vi. 购物, 到处寻找；vt. 选购
example: I need to go to the shop to buy some milk.

meaning: n. the location on a baseball field where the shortstop is stationed; a. primarily temporal sense; indicating or being or seeming to be limited in duration; a. (primarily spatial sense) having little length or lacking in length; a. low in stature; not tall
translation_zh: a. 短的, 近的, 矮的, 短期的, 简短的, 少量的；adv. 简短地, 突然；n. 扼要, 短片, 缺乏；vt. 故意少给, 使短路
example: He is quite short for his age.

meaning: n. the part of the body between the neck and the upper arm; n. a cut of meat including the upper joint of the foreleg; n. a ball-and-socket joint between the head of the humerus and a cavity of the scapula; n. the part of a garment that covers or fits over the shoulder
translation_zh: n. 肩, 肩膀, 衣肩；vt. 肩负, 负担, 担任；vi. 用肩推挤
example: 这个肩为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a plumbing fixture that sprays water over you; n. washing yourself by standing upright under water sprayed from a nozzle; n. a brief period of precipitation; n. a sudden downpour (as of tears or sparks etc) likened to a rain shower
translation_zh: n. 阵雨, 淋浴, 一阵, 展出者, 显示者；vi. 淋浴, 下阵雨；vt. 淋湿, 倾注
example: 这个淋浴器为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a place within a region identified relative to a center or reference location; n. one of two or more contesting groups; n. either the left or right half of a body; n. a surface forming part of the outside of an object
translation_zh: n. 旁边, 侧, 方面, 胁, 侧边, 血统；a. 旁的, 侧的, 次要的；vt. 同意, 支持；vi. 支持, 赞助
example: 这个面为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an instance of visual perception; n. anything that is seen; n. the ability to see; the visual faculty; n. a range of mental vision
translation_zh: n. 景观, 视力, 眼界, 阅读, 见解, 意见；vt. 看见, 瞄准；vi. 瞄准, 观看；a. 即席的, 见票即付的
example: 这个视力为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a perceptible indication of something not immediately apparent (as a visible clue that something has happened); n. a public display of a message; n. (medicine) any objective evidence of the presence of a disorder or disease; n. a gesture that is part of a sign language
translation_zh: n. 符号, 招牌, 征兆, 正负号, 手势；vt. 签名, 打手势表达；vi. 签名；[计] 正负号; 符号; 符号字符
example: 这个符号为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the piece of land on which something is located (or is to be located); n. physical position in relation to the surroundings
translation_zh: n. 位置, 场所, 地点；vt. 给...择址
example: 这个（建筑的）工地为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an ability that has been acquired by training; n. ability to produce solutions in some problem domain
translation_zh: n. 技术, 技巧, 技能, 熟练, 熟练工人；[化] 技能
example: 这个技能为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. become slow or slower; v. cause to proceed more slowly; a. not moving quickly; taking a comparatively long time; a. at a slow tempo
translation_zh: a. 慢的, 缓慢的, 迟缓的, 迟钝的, 冷漠的, 落后的；adv. 慢地, 迟缓地；v. (使)慢下来
example: The internet connection is very slow today.

meaning: n. a kind of pain such as that caused by a wound or a burn or a sore; a. showing mental alertness and calculation and resourcefulness; s. painfully severe; s. quick and brisk
translation_zh: a. 聪明的, 漂亮的, 刺痛的, 剧烈的, 敏捷的, 巧妙的, 伶俐的, 潇洒的；n. 刺痛, 痛苦；vi. 刺痛
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常整洁漂亮的的解释。

meaning: n. the sensation that results when olfactory receptors in the nose are stimulated by particular chemicals in gaseous form; n. the faculty that enables us to distinguish scents; n. the act of perceiving the odor of something; v. inhale the odor of; perceive by the olfactory sense
translation_zh: n. 味道, 气味, 嗅觉, 嗅, 臭味, 气息；vt. 闻, 探出, 察觉, 发出...的气味；vi. 嗅, 散发气味, 发臭
example: I can smell the fresh bread.

meaning: n. a facial expression characterized by turning up the corners of the mouth; usually shows pleasure or amusement; v. change one's facial expression by spreading the lips, often to signal pleasure; v. express with a smile
translation_zh: n. 微笑, 喜色, 笑容；vi. 微笑, 觉得好笑；vt. 微笑着表示
example: Her warm smile made everyone feel welcome.

meaning: n. a cloud of fine particles suspended in a gas; n. a hot vapor containing fine particles of carbon being produced by combustion; n. an indication of some hidden activity; n. something with no concrete substance
translation_zh: n. 烟, 雾气, 烟熏剂, 抽烟, 烟色；vi. 吸烟, 冒烟, 弥漫；vt. 以烟熏, 抽烟而导致...
example: 这个烟为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. precipitation falling from clouds in the form of ice crystals; n. a layer of snowflakes (white crystals of frozen water) covering the ground; n. English writer of novels about moral dilemmas in academe (1905-1980); v. fall as snow
translation_zh: n. 雪, 积雪, 下雪, 雪花形干扰；vi. 下雪, 似雪般落下；vt. 使雪白, 用雪覆盖, 使像雪般落下
example: It started to snow heavily.

meaning: a. relating to human society and its members; a. living together or enjoying life in communities or organized groups; a. relating to or belonging to or characteristic of high society; s. composed of sociable people or formed for the purpose of sociability
translation_zh: a. 社会的, 群居的, 社交的；n. 联欢会
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常社会的的解释。

meaning: n. a special offering (usually temporary and at a reduced price) that is featured in advertising; n. a dish or meal given prominence in e.g. a restaurant; n. a television production that features a particular person or work or topic; s. for a special service or occasion
translation_zh: n. 专辑, 专车, 号外, 特别的东西, 负有特别任务的人员；a. 特别的, 专门的, 特殊的, 额外的, 附加的, 特别亲密的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常专车的解释。

meaning: n. (language) communication by word of mouth; n. something spoken; n. the exchange of spoken words
translation_zh: n. 演讲, 说话, 谈话, 言语, 引语, 民族语言；[医] 言语, 语言
example: 这个演说为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a verbal formula believed to have magical force; v. orally recite the letters of or give the spelling of; v. indicate or signify; v. write or name the letters that comprise the conventionally accepted form of (a word or part of a word)
translation_zh: n. 符咒, 魅力, 轮值, 轮班, 工作时间, 一次发作；vt. 拼写, 拼成, 琢磨, 理解, 招致, 轮换, 迷住；vi. 轮换, 拼字
example: 这个& vi. 拼写为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a short section or illustration (as between radio or tv programs or in a magazine) that is often used for advertising; n. a small contrasting part of something; n. a section of an entertainment that is assigned to a specific performer or performance; n. a business establishment for entertainment
translation_zh: n. 污点, 地点, 斑点, 点, 娱乐场所, 处境, 少量；a. 当场的, 现场的, 现货买卖的, 现金交易的, 抽样的；vt. 点缀, 玷污, 认出, 准确定...的位, 用灯光照射；vi. 玷污, (从空中)侦察敌方目标
example: 这个地点为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the season of growth; n. a metal elastic device that returns to its shape or position when pushed or pulled or pressed; n. a natural flow of ground water; n. a point at which water issues forth
translation_zh: n. 春天, 弹簧, 跳跃, 弹性, 活力, 泉, 源泉；a. 春天的；vi. 跳, 弹跳, 涌出, 生长, 裂开, 高耸；vt. 使跳起, 使爆炸, 突然提出
example: 这个春天为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a large platform on which people can stand and can be seen by an audience; n. the theater as a profession (usually `the stage'); n. a section or portion of a journey or course; n. any scene regarded as a setting for exhibiting or doing something
translation_zh: n. 阶段, 舞台, 场所, 戏剧, 站, 驿站, 级, 层, 脚手架；vt. 上演, 表演, 筹划；vi. 适于上演, 乘驿车旅行
example: 这个阶段为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the position where a thing or person stands; n. a growth of similar plants (usually trees) in a particular area; n. a small table for holding articles of various kinds; n. an interruption of normal activity
translation_zh: n. 站立, 站住, 停顿, 讲台, 看台, 立场, 法院证人席；vi. 站, 立, 坐落, 停滞, 位于, 坚持, 维持原状；vt. 忍受, 使站立, 抵挡
example: Please stand up.

meaning: n. (astronomy) a celestial body of hot gases that radiates energy derived from thermonuclear reactions in the interior; n. any celestial body visible (as a point of light) from the Earth at night; n. an actor who plays a principal role; n. a plane figure with 5 or more points; often used as an emblem
translation_zh: n. 星, 恒星, 星形物, 运气, 明星；vt. 以星状物装饰, 用星号标, 使成为明星；vi. 变成明星
example: 这个星为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a static photograph (especially one taken from a movie and used for advertising purposes); n. an apparatus used for the distillation of liquids; consists of a vessel in which a substance is vaporized by heat and a condenser where the vapor is condensed; v. lessen the intensity of or calm; v. make motionless
translation_zh: n. 蒸馏室, 寂静, 剧照；v. 蒸馏, (使)平静, (使)静止；a. 静止的, 不动的, 静寂的, 不起泡的, 静物摄影的；adv. 仍然, 更, 静止地；conj. 然而, 但是
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常还的解释。

meaning: n. building material consisting of a piece of rock hewn in a definite shape for a special purpose; n. an avoirdupois unit used to measure the weight of a human body; equal to 14 pounds; n. the hard inner (usually woody) layer of the pericarp of some fruits (as peaches or plums or cherries or olives) that contains the seed; n. United States jurist who was named chief justice of the United States Supreme Court in 1941 by Franklin D. Roosevelt (1872-1946)
translation_zh: n. 石头, 宝石, 果核, 纪念碑, 结石；vt. 投扔石子, 铺石头；a. 石的, 石制的, 完全的
example: 这个石头为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a supply of something available for future use; v. keep or lay aside for future use; v. find a place for and put away for storage
translation_zh: n. 商店, 贮藏, 仓库, 备用品, 存储器；vt. 储存, 贮藏, 供给；vi. 贮藏；a. 贮藏的, 现成的；[计] 存储器操作; 存储
example: I bought milk at the store.

meaning: a. being definitely out of the ordinary and unexpected; slightly odd or even a bit weird; s. not known before
translation_zh: a. 奇怪的, 陌生的, 生疏的, 不熟悉的, 不可思议的, 外行的, 外地的, 异乡的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常陌生的的解释。

meaning: a. having strength or power greater than average or expected; s. not faint or feeble; s. of verbs not having standard (or regular) inflection; s. freshly made or left
translation_zh: a. 强壮的, 坚固的, 坚强的, 强烈的, 有力的, 优良的；adv. 强劲地, 有力地, 猛烈地
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常强壮的的解释。

meaning: n. the subject matter of a conversation or discussion; n. something (a person or object or scene) selected by an artist or photographer for graphic representation; n. (grammar) one of the two main constituents of a sentence; the grammatical constituent about which something is predicated; n. a person who is subjected to experimental or other observational procedures; someone who is an object of investigation
translation_zh: n. 科目, 主题, 臣民, 主语, 题目, (事物的)经受者, 学科, 受治疗者, 原因, 理由；a. 服从的, 易患...的, 隶属的, 受支配的；adv. 在...条件下；vt. 使隶属, 使受到；[计] 主题, 主体
example: 这个主题为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. having succeeded or being marked by a favorable outcome
translation_zh: a. 成功的, 一帆风顺的, 顺利的；[经] 成功的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常成功的的解释。

meaning: s. including more than a specified category; s. extremely large
translation_zh: n. 跑龙套角色, 冗员, 特级品, 特大号, 管理人；a. 上等的, 特大的, 超级的, 极好的, 十分的, 过分的；adv. 非常
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常超级的的解释。

meaning: s. physically secure or dependable; s. (of persons) worthy of trust or confidence; s. infallible or unfailing; s. certain not to fail
translation_zh: a. 确信, 必然的, 必定的；adv. 当然, 确实地, 无疑地
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常可靠的的解释。

meaning: n. waves breaking on the shore; v. switch channels, on television
translation_zh: n. 海浪, 拍岸浪；vi. 作冲浪运动
example: 这个作冲浪运动 vt. 在…冲浪 n. 海浪为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the astonishment you feel when something totally unexpected happens to you; n. a sudden unexpected event; n. the act of surprising someone; v. cause to be surprised
translation_zh: n. 惊奇, 奇袭, 诧异；vt. 使惊奇, 撞见, 奇袭
example: 这个惊奇为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a detailed critical inspection; v. consider in a comprehensive way; v. look over carefully or inspect; v. make a survey of; for statistical purposes
translation_zh: n. 纵览, 视察, 测量, 俯瞰, 调查；vt. 审视, 视察, 俯瞰, 通盘考虑；vi. 测量土地
example: 这个民意调查为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. English phonetician; one of the founders of modern phonetics (1845-1912); n. a food rich in sugar; n. the taste experience when sugar dissolves in the mouth; a. having or denoting the characteristic taste of sugar
translation_zh: n. 甜蜜, 糖果, 情人；a. 甜的, 芳香的, 悦耳的, 漂亮的, 和蔼的, 不咸的, 灵活的, 轻快的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常甜的的解释。

meaning: n. a cooperative unit (especially in sports); n. two or more draft animals that work together to pull something; v. form a team
translation_zh: n. 队, 组；vt. 把马(牛)套在同一辆车上, 把...编成一组；vi. 驾驶卡车, 协作
example: 这个队为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the practical application of science to commerce or industry
translation_zh: n. 技术, 工业技术, 术语；[医] 技术学, 工艺学
example: 这个科技(总称)为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. electronic equipment that converts sound into electrical signals that can be transmitted over distances and then converts received signals back into sounds; n. transmitting speech at a distance
translation_zh: n. 电话, 电话机；v. 打电话
example: Can I use your telephone to make a call?

meaning: s causing fear or dread or terror; s exceptionally bad or displeasing; s intensely or extremely bad or unpleasant in degree or quality; s extreme in degree or extent or amount or impact
translation_zh: a. 可怕的, 令人恐惧的, 极坏的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常可怕的的解释。

meaning: n. any standardized procedure for measuring sensitivity or memory or intelligence or aptitude or personality etc; n. the act of undergoing testing; n. the act of testing something; n. a hard outer covering as of some amoebas and sea urchins
translation_zh: n. 测试, 试验, 化验, 检验, 考验, 甲壳；vt. 测试, 试验, 化验；vi. 接受测验, 进行测试
example: I have a math test tomorrow.

meaning: n. the act of throwing (propelling something with a rapid movement of the arm and wrist); n. a single chance or instance; n. the maximum movement available to a pivoted or reciprocating piece by a cam; n. bedclothes consisting of a lightweight cloth covering (an afghan or bedspread) that is casually thrown over something
translation_zh: vt. 投, 掷, 抛, 发射, 摔下, 匆匆穿上(或脱下), 抛弃, 摆脱；vi. 丢, 掷, 抛；n. 投掷, 掷骰子, 冒险
example: 这个抛为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: a. closely constrained or constricted or constricting; s. set so close together as to be invulnerable to penetration; s. affected by scarcity and expensive to borrow; a. of such close construction as to be impermeable
translation_zh: a. 紧的, 密封的, 吝啬的, 严厉的；adv. 紧紧地
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常牢的的解释。

meaning: n. an instance or single occasion for some event; n. a period of time considered as a resource under your control and sufficient to accomplish something; n. an indefinite period (usually marked by specific attributes or activities); n. a suitable moment
translation_zh: n. 时间, 时侯, 时机, 时期, 期限, 次数, 节拍, 暂停, 规定时间；vt. 测定...的时间, 记录...的时间, 计时, 定时；a. 时间的, 记时的, 定时的, 定期的, 分期的；[计] DOS内部命令:用于显示或设定系统的时间
example: What time is it?

meaning: s. mentally and emotionally stable; r. in contact with each other or in proximity; r. assembled in one place; r. in each other's company
translation_zh: adv. 一起, 共同, 彼此
example: 他ad地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. the present or immediately coming night; r. during the night of the present day
translation_zh: n. 今晚, 今夜；adv. 今晚, 今夜
example: I'm going out tonight.

meaning: n. an implement used in the practice of a vocation; v. drive; v. furnish with tools; v. work with a tool
translation_zh: n. 工具, 机床, 傀儡；vt. 用工具加工；vi. 使用工具
example: 这个（尤指手用）工具为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. some situation or event that is thought about
translation_zh: n. 主题, 论题, 话题
example: 这个主题（等于theme）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the event of something coming in contact with the body; n. the faculty by which external objects or forces are perceived through contact with the body (especially the hands); n. a suggestion of some quality; n. a distinguishing style
translation_zh: n. 触觉, 碰, 触, 机灵, 轻触, 格调, 少许, 缺点, 弹力；vt. 接触, 触摸, 触及, 使接触, 达到, 涉及, 影响到, 使轻度受害, 感动；vi. 触摸, 接近, 涉及, 提到
example: 这个接触为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a structure taller than its diameter; can stand alone or be attached to a larger building
translation_zh: n. 塔, 高楼, 堡垒；vi. 高耸, 翱翔
example: 这个塔为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. public transport provided by a line of railway cars coupled together and drawn by a locomotive; n. a series of consequences wrought by an event; n. piece of cloth forming the long back section of a gown that is drawn along the floor; v. create by training and teaching
translation_zh: n. 火车, 列车, 行列, 长队, 一连串的后果, 顺序；vt. 训练, 教育, 对准；vi. 受训练, 锻炼
example: 这个火车为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a journey for some purpose (usually including the return); n. a hallucinatory experience induced by drugs; n. an exciting or stimulating experience; n. a light or nimble tread
translation_zh: n. 旅行, 绊倒, 摔倒, 失足, 差错, 旅程；vt. 使跌倒, 使犯错, 使失败；vi. 轻快地走, 绊倒, 失误, 犯错, 结巴, 旅行, 远足
example: 这个绊倒为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. make an effort or attempt; v. give pain or trouble to; v. test the limits of; v. melt (fat or lard) in order to separate out impurities
translation_zh: n. 尝试, 试验, 审理, 审判；vt. 试, 尝试, 试验, 考验, 审问, 提炼；vi. 尝试, 试图
example: I will try my best.

meaning: n. large gallinaceous bird with fan-shaped tail; widely domesticated for food; n. a Eurasian republic in Asia Minor and the Balkans; on the collapse of the Ottoman Empire in 1918, the Young Turks, led by Kemal Ataturk, established a republic in 1923; n. flesh of large domesticated fowl usually roasted; n. an event that fails badly or is totally ineffectual
translation_zh: n. 火鸡, 无用的家伙, 土耳其
example: 这个土耳其（横跨欧亚两洲的国家）为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a subdivision of a particular kind of thing; n. (biology) the taxonomic group whose characteristics are used to define the next higher taxon; n. printed characters; n. all of the tokens of the same symbol
translation_zh: n. 类型, 样式, 典型, 榜样, 标志, 符号, 型, 式；vi. 打字；vt. 作为代表, 测定类型, 用打字机打；[计] 类型; 键入; DOS内部命令:在屏幕上显示指定文件的内容
example: 这个类型为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. draw a line or lines underneath to call attention to
translation_zh: vt. 在...下面划线, 作...的衬里, 强调；n. 下划线, 图下说明文字；[计] 加下划线; 下划线
example: 这个在…下面画线为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: r under normal conditions
translation_zh: adv. 通常, 大抵
example: 他通常地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. the visible part of a television transmission; n. (computer science) the appearance of text and graphics on a video display
translation_zh: n. 影像, 电视；a. 图像的, 电视的
example: 这个磁带录像为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a choice that is made by counting the number of people in favor of each alternative; n. the opinion of a group as determined by voting; n. a body of voters who have the same interests; n. the total number of voters who participated
translation_zh: n. 投票, 选举, 选票, 表决, 选举权, 得票数；vi. 投票, 选举；vt. 投票选举, 投票决定, 公认, 使投票
example: 这个投票选举为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the wave that spreads behind a boat as it moves forward; n. a vigil held over a corpse the night before burial; v. be awake, be alert, be there; v. make aware of
translation_zh: vt. 叫醒, 激发；vi. 醒来, 醒着, 觉醒, 活跃起来；n. 守侯, 守夜, 尾迹, 痕迹
example: 这个醒来为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the waging of armed conflict against an enemy; n. a legal state created by a declaration of war and ended by official declaration during which the international rules of war apply; n. an active struggle between competing entities; n. a concerted campaign to end something that is injurious
translation_zh: n. 战争, 战争状态, 战术, 军事, 冲突, 斗争, 竞争；vi. 进行战争, 作战, 打仗, 战斗；a. 战争的, 战时用的
example: 这个战争为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: v. get warm or warmer; v. make warm or warmer; a. having or producing a comfortable and agreeable degree of heat or imparting or maintaining heat; a. psychologically warm; friendly and responsive
translation_zh: a. 暖和的, 暖的, 温暖的, 热烈的, 兴奋的, 激烈的, 多情的, 色情的；vt. 使温暖, 弄热, 使兴奋, 使充满仇恨；vi. 变暖和, 变温暖, 取暖, 激动, 同情, 爱好；n. 暖, 保暖物
example: The tea is still warm.

meaning: n. binary compound that occurs at room temperature as a clear colorless odorless tasteless liquid; freezes into ice below 0 degrees centigrade and boils above 100 degrees centigrade; widely used as a solvent; n. once thought to be one of four elements composing the universe (Empedocles); n. a liquid necessary for the life of most animals and plants; v. supply with water, as with channels or ditches or streams
translation_zh: n. 水, 雨水, 海水, 水位, 水面, 流水；vt. 给...浇水, 供以水, 注入水, 使湿；vi. 流泪, 流口水, 加水；a. 水的, 水上的, 水生的, 含水的
example: I need a glass of water.

meaning: n. a simple machine consisting of a circular frame with spokes (or a solid disc) that can rotate on a shaft or axle (as in vehicles or other machines); n. forces that provide energy and direction; n. a circular helm to control the rudder of a vessel; v. change directions as if revolving on a pivot
translation_zh: n. 轮子, 车轮, 轮, 方向盘, 旋转, 机构, 重要人物；vt. 使旋转, 转动, 使转向；vi. 旋转, 转弯, 盘旋
example: 这个轮子为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a fixed and persistent intent or purpose; n. a legal document declaring a person's wishes regarding the disposal of their property when they die; v. decree or ordain; v. determine by choice
translation_zh: n. 意志, 决心, 意愿, 意向, 干劲, 遗嘱；vt. 用意志的力量驱使, 决意, 愿意, 立遗嘱；vi. 下决心, 愿意；aux. 将, 愿意, 必须
example: I will call you later.

meaning: n. air moving (sometimes with considerable force) from an area of high pressure to an area of low pressure; n. a tendency or force that influences events; n. breath; n. empty rhetoric or insincere or exaggerated talk
translation_zh: n. 风, 气息, 气味, 呼吸, 风声, 趋势, 空谈, 卷绕, 弯曲；vt. 使通风, 嗅出, 使喘气, 吹号角, 上发条, 缠绕, 包, 绞起, 吊起, 使弯曲, 使迂回；vi. 嗅出猎物, 吹响号角, 卷曲, 蜿蜒, 迂回, 缠绕
example: 这个风为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a specific feeling of desire; n. an expression of some desire or inclination; n. the particular preference that you have; v. hope for; have a wish
translation_zh: n. 希望, 愿望, 祝愿, 命令, 请求；vt. 愿, 想要, 希望, 祝愿；vi. 希望
example: 这个希望为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s extraordinarily good or great; used especially as intensifiers
translation_zh: a. 令人惊奇的, 奇妙的, 极好的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常极好的的解释。

meaning: n. a person who works at a specific occupation; n. sterile member of a colony of social insects that forages for food and cares for the larvae
translation_zh: n. 工人, 劳动者；[经] 工人, 劳工, 劳动者
example: 这个工人为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a strong feeling of anxiety; v. be worried, concerned, anxious, troubled, or uneasy; v. be concerned with; v. disturb the peace of mind of; afflict with mental agitation or distress
translation_zh: n. 担心, 烦恼, 忧虑, 苦恼, 撕咬；vt. 使烦恼, 使焦虑, 使苦恼, 困扰, 折磨, 撕咬；vi. 烦恼, 担心, 撕咬
example: 这个烦恼为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. writes (books or stories or articles or the like) professionally (for pay); n. a person who is able to write and has written something
translation_zh: n. 作家, 撰稿者, 抄写员；[化] 记录器
example: 这个作家为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. that which is contrary to the principles of justice or law; n. any harm or injury resulting from a violation of a legal right; v. treat unjustly; do wrong to; a. contrary to conscience or morality or law
translation_zh: a. 错误的, 不正当的, 失常的；adv. 错误地
example: That answer is wrong.

meaning: r. up to the present time; r. within an indefinite time or at an unspecified future time
translation_zh: adv. 还, 尚, 仍然, 已经, 然而；conj. 然而
example: 他但是地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: s. having the lower score or lagging position in a contest; r. in or to or toward the rear; r. remaining in a place or condition that has been left or departed from; r. of timepieces
translation_zh: adv. 在后地；prep. 在...背后
example: 他（表示位置）在…的后面地说着，以便把观点表达清楚。

meaning: n. a glass or plastic vessel used for storing drinks or other liquids; typically cylindrical without handles and with a narrow neck that can be plugged or capped; n. the quantity contained in a bottle; n. a vessel fitted with a flexible teat and filled with milk or formula; used as a substitute for breast feeding infants and very young children; v. store (liquids or gases) in bottles
translation_zh: n. 瓶子, 酒瓶；vt. 装瓶, 抑制, 围困
example: Please recycle this plastic bottle.

meaning: n. a collection of things sharing a common attribute; n. a body of students who are taught together; n. people having the same social, economic, or educational status; n. a league ranked by quality
translation_zh: n. 班级, 阶级, 种类, 课；vt. 分类；[计] 类别; 类; 种类; 类程
example: I have a math class at 10 AM.

meaning: n. the quality of being at a refreshingly low temperature; v. make cool or cooler; v. loose heat; v. lose intensity
translation_zh: n. 凉爽, 凉爽的空气；a. 凉爽的, 冷淡的, 冷静的；vi. 冷却, 平息；vt. 使冷却, 使平静
example: It's a cool evening.

meaning: n. the state of affairs that a plan is intended to achieve and that (when achieved) terminates behavior intended to achieve it; n. game equipment consisting of the place toward which players of a game try to advance a ball or puck in order to score points; n. a successful attempt at scoring
translation_zh: n. 目标, 终点, 得分, 球门, 守门员；vi. 攻门, 射门得分
example: 这个目标为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a position to be won or defended in battle (or as if in battle); n. a relatively homogeneous percept extending back of the figure on which attention is focused; n. a connection between an electrical device and a large conducting body, such as the earth (which is taken to be at zero voltage); n. (art) the surface (as a wall or canvas) prepared to take the paint for a painting
translation_zh: n. 土地, 战场, 场地, 地面, 范围；a. 土地的, 地面上的；vt. 放在地上, 使搁浅, 打基础, 给...以训练；vi. 搁浅, 落地, 根据, 基于；a. 磨过的；grind的过去式和过去分词
example: The ball fell to the ground.

meaning: n. any number of entities (members) considered as a unit; n. (chemistry) two or more atoms bound together as a single unit and forming part of a molecule; n. a set that is closed, associative, has an identity element and every element has an inverse; v. arrange into a group or groups
translation_zh: n. 团体, 组, 团, 群；v. 聚合, 成群；[计] 创建组; 组, 用户组
example: We worked in a small group.

meaning: n. a dwelling that serves as living quarters for one or more families; n. the members of a religious community living together; n. the audience gathered together in a theatre or cinema; n. an official assembly having legislative powers
translation_zh: n. 房子, 住宅, 机构, 议院, 家族, 家庭；vt. 给...房子住, 收藏；vi. 住, 躲藏
example: My house is big.

meaning: n. cooking utensil consisting of a wide metal vessel; n. (Greek mythology) god of fields and woods and shepherds and flocks; represented as a man with goat's legs and horns and ears; identified with Roman Sylvanus or Faunus; n. shallow container made of metal; n. chimpanzees; more closely related to Australopithecus than to other pongids
translation_zh: n. 平锅, 浅盘, 盆地, 硬土层, 拍摄全景；v. 上下左右移动, 摇镜头, 淘洗, 淘金
example: Heat the oil in a frying pan.

meaning: r in part; in some degree; not wholly
translation_zh: adv. 部分地, 在一定程度上
example: She spoke partly during the meeting.

meaning: n. the act of passing from one state or place to the next; n. a section of text; particularly a section of medium length; n. a way through or along which someone or something may pass; n. a journey usually by ship
translation_zh: n. 通道, 通过, 移居, 航行, 一段, 走廊；vi. 通过, 经过, 航行, 横渡, 争吵；vt. (使)马以斜横步前进, 使传代
example: A dark narrow passage led to the main hall.

meaning: n. a traveler riding in a vehicle (a boat or bus or car or plane or train etc) who is not operating it
translation_zh: n. 乘客, 旅客；[经] 乘客, 旅客
example: The bus was full of passengers.

meaning: a. not disturbed by strife or turmoil or war
translation_zh: a. 平静的, 和平的, 和平时期的, 爱好和平的, 喜爱安静的；[法] 和平的, 爱好和平的, 和平时期的
example: They hope for a peaceful settlement of the dispute.

meaning: n. someone who takes photographs professionally
translation_zh: n. 摄影师, 摄影者
example: The photographer captured the beautiful sunset.

meaning: r. in accord with physical laws
translation_zh: adv. 按自然规律, 完全地, 实际上, 真正地, 身体上地
example: She spoke physically during the meeting.

meaning: a. affording pleasure; being in harmony with your taste or likings; s. (of persons) having pleasing manners or behavior
translation_zh: a. 愉快的, 可爱的, 活泼的, 亲切的
example: We had a very pleasant evening together.

meaning: n. any likeness of a person, in any medium
translation_zh: n. 肖像, 人像, 半身像, 描写, 竖排格式；[计] 纵向
example: He had his portrait painted in uniform.

meaning: n. a tense of verbs used in describing action that is on-going; a. favoring or promoting progress; s. favoring or promoting reform (often by government action); a. (of taxes) adjusted so that the rate increases as the amount of income increases
translation_zh: n. 改革论者, 进步论者；a. 前进的, 累进的, 进步的
example: Supporters of a progressive income tax argue that it is fairer.

meaning: v. follow in or as if in pursuit; v. carry further or advance
translation_zh: vt. 追赶, 追踪, 追随, 追求, 实行, 继续, 从事；vi. 追赶, 继续
example: We need to pursue this carefully.

meaning: v. manifest or bring back; v. to throw or bend back (from a surface); v. be bright by reflecting or casting light; v. show an image of
translation_zh: vt. 反射, 反映, 招致, 深思；vi. 被反射, 映出, 深思, 考虑, 指责
example: We need to reflect this carefully.

meaning: v. become less tense, rest, or take one's ease; v. make less taut; v. cause to feel relaxed; v. become less tense, less formal, or less restrained, and assume a friendlier manner
translation_zh: vi. 放松, 松懈, 松弛, 变从容, 休息, 休养；vt. 使松弛, 缓和, 使松懈, 使休息
example: After work, I like to relax with a book.

meaning: v. put in the mind of someone
translation_zh: vt. 提醒, 使想起
example: Please remind me to call him.

meaning: n a device that can be used to control a machine or apparatus from a distance; s located far away spatially; s very unlikely; s separate or apart in time; s inaccessible and sparsely populated;; a far apart in relevance or relationship or kinship
translation_zh: a. 遥远的, 偏僻的, 疏远的, 微少的；[计] 远程, 远程访问实用程序
example: The area is remote, mountainous, and roadless.

meaning: n. the act of putting something in working order again; n. a formal way of referring to the condition of something; v. restore by replacing a part or putting together what is torn or broken; v. move, travel, or proceed toward some place
translation_zh: n. 修理, 补救, 修复；vt. 修理, 修补, 补救, 恢复, 补偿；vi. 修理, 修补, 补救, 恢复, 去, 常去, 集合
example: He has had surgery to repair the damage.

meaning: v. take something away by force or without the consent of the owner
translation_zh: v. 抢夺, 抢掠, 剥夺
example: We need to rob this carefully.

meaning: n. small Old World songbird with a reddish breast; n. large American thrush having a rust-red breast and abdomen
translation_zh: n. 旅鸫；[医] 刺槐毒素
example: A robin built a nest in our garden.

meaning: n. the group of languages derived from Latin; n. a novel dealing with idealized events remote from everyday life; v. have a love affair with; v. tell romantic or exaggerated lies
translation_zh: n. 冒险故事, 浪漫史, 传奇文学；vi. 写传奇, 作空想, 虚构
example: They had a whirlwind romance.

meaning: n. a soulful or amorous idealist; a. belonging to or characteristic of Romanticism or the Romantic Movement in the arts
translation_zh: a. 浪漫的, 风流的, 传奇性的, 夸大的, 空想的, 浪漫派的
example: I'm not interested in a romantic relationship.

meaning: n. (botany) the usually underground organ that lacks buds or leaves or nodes; absorbs water and mineral salts; usually it anchors the plant to the ground; n. (linguistics) the form of a word after all affixes are removed; n. a number that, when multiplied by itself some number of times, equals a given number; n. the part of a tooth that is embedded in the jaw and serves as support
translation_zh: n. 根, 根本, 根源, 基础, 底部；vt. 使扎根, 使固定, 根除, 肃清, 搜出, 用鼻拱；vi. 生根, 固定, 源于, 用鼻拱土, 寻找, 捧场, 支持
example: Tree roots can cause damage to buildings.

meaning: n. a form of football played with an oval ball
translation_zh: n. 橄榄球, 橄榄球赛
example: The rugby was important for everyone.

meaning: n. a reason for wanting something done; n. Japanese alcoholic beverage made from fermented rice; usually served hot; n. the purpose of achieving or obtaining
translation_zh: n. 目的, 缘故, 理由
example: Please do it, for David's sake.

meaning: v. meet the requirements or expectations of; v. make happy or satisfied
translation_zh: vt. 使满意, 满足, 符合, 使确信, 赔偿；vi. 令人满意, 替人赎罪
example: We need to satisfy this carefully.

meaning: n. flavorful relish or dressing or topping served as an accompaniment to food; v. behave saucily or impudently towards; v. dress (food) with a relish; v. add zest or flavor to, make more interesting
translation_zh: n. 酱油, 调味汁, 酱；vt. 给...调味, 使增加趣味
example: This pasta needs more tomato sauce.

meaning: n. a written version of a play or other dramatic composition; used in preparing for a performance; n. a particular orthography or writing system; v. write a script for
translation_zh: n. 手迹, 手稿, 正本, 手写体；vt. 改编为演出本；[计] 手写体, 小型程序
example: That line isn't in the original script.

meaning: n a metric unit of length equal to 1000 meters (or 0.621371 miles)
translation_zh: [医] 千米, 公里
example: The distance was 10 km.

meaning: n. a small hard fruit; n. a mature fertilized plant ovule consisting of an embryo and its food source and having a protective coat or testa; v. go to seed; shed seeds; v. help (an enterprise) in its early stages of development by providing seed money
translation_zh: n. 种子, 籽, 萌芽, 子孙, 精液；vt. 在...播种, 催...发育, 脱...籽；vi. 结实, 播种
example: Plant the seeds in fertile soil.

meaning: n. the land along the edge of a body of water; n. a beam or timber that is propped against a structure to provide support; v. serve as a shore to
translation_zh: n. 海岸, 海滨, 斜撑柱；vt. 把...送上岸, 支撑, 支持
example: We walked along the shore at sunset.

meaning: n. a word used for misbehaving children
translation_zh: a. 愚蠢的, 糊涂的
example: Don't be silly, it's not that difficult.

meaning: n. a person who is owned by someone; n. someone who works as hard as a slave; n. someone entirely dominated by some influence or person; v. work very hard, like a slave
translation_zh: n. 奴隶, 从动装置, 卑鄙的人；vi. 拼命工作；[计] 从设备
example: 这个奴隶为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. the act of smoothing; v. make smooth or smoother, as if by rubbing; v. free from obstructions; a. having a surface free from roughness or bumps or ridges or irregularities
translation_zh: a. 平滑的, 平稳的, 流畅的, 和蔼的, 安祥的, 圆滑的, 调匀的, 无毛的；vt. 使光滑, 烫平, 使平和, 消除；vi. 变平滑, 变平静；n. 一块平地, 平滑部分
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常光滑的的解释。

meaning: n. a stolen base; an instance in which a base runner advances safely during the delivery of a pitch (without the help of a hit or walk or passed ball or wild pitch); v. take without the owner's consent; v. move stealthily; v. steal a base
translation_zh: vt. 剽窃；偷偷地做；偷窃；vi. 窃取；偷偷地行动；[棒球]偷垒；n. [口]偷窃；便宜货；偷垒；[篮球]断球
example: Someone tried to steal my bike.

meaning: n. an enlarged and muscular saclike organ of the alimentary canal; the principal organ of digestion; n. an inclination or liking for things involving conflict or difficulty or unpleasantness; n. an appetite for food; v. bear to eat
translation_zh: n. 胃, 食欲, 欲望, 肚子；vt. 吃下, 忍受
example: My stomach hurts after eating too much.

meaning: n. anyone who does not belong in the environment in which they are found; n. an individual that one is not acquainted with
translation_zh: n. 陌生人, 门外汉；[法] 局外人, 非当事人, 第三者
example: Don't talk to strangers.

meaning: n. a lightweight cord; n. a tightly stretched cord of wire or gut, which makes sound when plucked, struck, or bowed; n. a sequentially ordered set of things or events or ideas in which each successive member is related to the preceding; n. a linear sequence of symbols (characters or words or phrases)
translation_zh: n. 线, 细绳, 一串, 字符串；vt. 串起, 成串, 收紧, 缚, 扎；vi. 成一串；[计] 字符串, 串
example: He tied the package with a piece of string.

meaning: a. happening without warning or in a short space of time
translation_zh: n. 突然, 忽然；a. 突然的, 意外的, 快速的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常突然的的解释。

meaning: s. meant or adapted for an occasion or use
translation_zh: a. 适当的, 相配的；[法] 合适的, 适宜的, 适当的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常适当的的解释。

meaning: n. a brief statement that presents the main points in a concise form
translation_zh: n. 摘要, 概要；a. 摘要的, 简略的；[计] 摘要; 概要
example: 这个扼要的为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. an arbitrary sign (written or printed) that has acquired a conventional significance; n. something visible that by association or convention represents something else that is invisible
translation_zh: n. 符号, 象征, 代号, 信条；[计] 符号; 码元
example: 这个符号为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. a device in which something (usually an animal) can be caught and penned; n. drain consisting of a U-shaped section of drainpipe that holds liquid and so prevents a return flow of sewer gas; n. something (often something deceptively attractive) that catches you unawares; n. a device to hurl clay pigeons into the air for trapshooters
translation_zh: n. 圈套, 陷阱, 诡计, 存水弯；vi. 设圈套, 设陷阱；vt. 诱捕, 诱骗, 抓住, 使受限制；[计] 俘获; 陷井
example: 这个（捕捉动物的）陷阱为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: n. clothing of distinctive design worn by members of a particular group as a means of identification; v. provide with uniforms; a. always the same; showing a single form or character in all occurrences; s. evenly spaced
translation_zh: n. 制服；a. 统一的, 一律的, 始终如一的
example: 她在演讲中给出了非常制服的解释。

meaning: n. accumulated knowledge or erudition or enlightenment; n. the trait of utilizing knowledge and experience with common sense and insight; n. ability to apply knowledge or experience or understanding or common sense and insight; n. the quality of being prudent and sensible
translation_zh: n. 智慧, 明智行为, 学识, 名言, 贤人
example: 这个智慧为讨论提供了宝贵的见解。

meaning: s. made or consisting of (entirely or in part) or employing wood; s. lacking ease or grace
translation_zh: a. 木制的, 呆笨的, 木然的
example: She bought a beautiful wooden table.
